Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

CVE-2026-116312.description: Inconsistent transition-capture state in PostgreSQL MERGE allows a table data modifier to make an AFTER trigger process the wrong new row, via a partitioned table MERGE that performs an INSERT before an UPDATE. Within major versions 15-18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, and 15.20 are affected. Versions before PostgreSQL 15 are unaffected.

CVE-2026-116313.description: Untrusted search path in PostgreSQL vacuumdb allows a database owner to execute arbitrary SQL as the database user running vacuumdb, via shadowing operators used in the --missing-stats-only catalog query. The pg_upgrade documentation recommends an affected vacuumdb invocation. Within major version 18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7 are affected. Versions before PostgreSQL 18 are unaffected.

CVE-2026-116314.description: Improper input validation in PostgreSQL pg_restore allows a non-plain archive provider to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running pg_restore, via a crafted archive. Note a contrast: crafted archive data may legitimately cause arbitrary SQL to execute at the restore destination, but it does not legitimately confer arbitrary code execution in the pg_restore OS process. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
CVE-2026-116314.summary_ko: PostgreSQL의 pg_restore 입력 검증 취약점으로, 일반 텍스트가 아닌 형식의 아카이브 제공자가 pg_restore를 실행하는 운영체제 사용자 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-116314.background_ko: pg_restore가 일반 텍스트가 아닌 형식의 아카이브 입력을 적절히 검증하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-116315.description: Heap-based buffer overflow in PostgreSQL tsvector_delete() allows a database user to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via a tsvector whose lexeme data uses a nonstandard but valid ordering that requires additional alignment padding in the result. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
CVE-2026-116315.summary_ko: PostgreSQL의 tsvector_delete()에 힙 기반 버퍼 오버플로 취약점이 있어 데이터베이스 사용자가 데이터베이스를 실행하는 운영체제 사용자 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-116315.background_ko: 유효하지만 비표준적인 어휘소 데이터 순서를 가진 tsvector를 처리할 때 결과에 추가 정렬 패딩이 필요해 힙 기반 버퍼 오버플로가 발생한다.

CVE-2026-116316.description: Improper protection of alternate path in PostgreSQL security-restricted operations allows an object creator to execute arbitrary SQL as the operation's caller, via a domain, enum, or range type created in pg_temp. The victim session must later run a query containing an unqualified type name, e.g. "SELECT '1'::bigint"; autovacuum and other common security-restricted operation users do not do so, so they are unaffected. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

CVE-2026-116317.description: Heap-based buffer overflow in PostgreSQL ts_rank_cd() may allow a database user to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via an invalid tsvector containing duplicate positions. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

CVE-2026-116318.description: SQL injection in PostgreSQL pg_dump allows an object creator to execute arbitrary SQL as the user restoring the dump, via an inherited column having a child-local not-null constraint whose name requires quoting. Within major version 18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7 are affected. Versions before PostgreSQL 18 are unaffected.

CVE-2026-116319.description: Use after free in PostgreSQL plperl allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via reentrant return_next() calls. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

CVE-2026-116320.description: Use after free in PostgreSQL plperl allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via dropping the final reference to a Perl array or hash while PostgreSQL is converting that object. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

CVE-2026-116321.description: Improper null termination in PostgreSQL array element assignment allows a database user to disclose server memory, via changing the final byte of a fixed-length name value to a nonzero byte and passing it to code that treats the value as a C string. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

CVE-2026-116322.description: Improper locking in PostgreSQL startup processing allows an unauthenticated network client to trigger a server restart, via arranging for authentication_timeout to arrive while it holds a spinlock during cancel handling. Within major version 18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7 are affected. Versions before PostgreSQL 18 are unaffected.

CVE-2026-116323.description: Use after free in PostgreSQL pltcl allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via a domain CHECK that re-enters the Tcl interpreter and frees or changes a string still used by the outer result conversion. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

CVE-2026-116325.description: SQL injection in PostgreSQL reindexdb allows an object creator to execute arbitrary SQL as the database user running reindexdb, via a crafted index name embedded in the parallel catalog query for --jobs with --index. Within major versions 17-18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7 and 17.12 are affected. Versions before PostgreSQL 17 are unaffected.

CVE-2026-116326.description: Uncaught exceptions in PostgreSQL plperl allow an object creator to cause use of a stale sigjmp_buf, via a tied Perl object, or a Perl object whose overloaded conversion throws while plperl is handling another error. We have not ruled out arbitrary code execution on some platform. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

CVE-2026-116327.description: Exposure of sensitive information in PostgreSQL security_barrier processing allows a database user to infer values hidden by a security_barrier view, via applying a leaky function to a CASE test value or internal parameter that indirectly represents a protected column. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

CVE-2026-116328.description: Integer wraparound in PostgreSQL generation memory contexts allows a database user to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via freeing an allocation larger than 1 GB and causing its block to be reused for smaller chunks whose back-pointer offset cannot represent that position. Within major versions 16-18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, and 16.16 are affected. Versions before PostgreSQL 16 are unaffected.
CVE-2026-116328.summary_ko: PostgreSQL의 generation 메모리 컨텍스트에 정수 래핑 취약점이 있어, 데이터베이스 사용자가 데이터베이스를 실행하는 운영체제 사용자 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다. PostgreSQL 16 미만은 영향을 받지 않는다.
CVE-2026-116328.background_ko: 1GB를 초과하는 할당을 해제한 블록이 작은 청크에 재사용될 때, 역방향 포인터 오프셋이 해당 위치를 표현하지 못하면서 정수 래핑이 발생한다.

CVE-2026-116329.description: Type confusion in PostgreSQL statistics import allows a table maintainer to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via nested SET DATA TYPE during conversion of values to import. Within major version 18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7 are affected. Versions before PostgreSQL 18 are unaffected.

CVE-2026-116330.description: Untrusted data inclusion in PostgreSQL pg_dump tar-format restore.sql allows a compromised origin server to execute arbitrary code as the client operating system account running psql, via the predictable restriction key in restore.sql. This is a gap in the fix for CVE-2025-8714. restore.sql is undocumented. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
CVE-2026-116330.summary_ko: PostgreSQL pg_dump의 tar 형식 restore.sql에 신뢰할 수 없는 데이터가 포함되는 취약점이 있다. 침해된 원본 서버가 psql을 실행하는 클라이언트 운영체제 계정 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-116330.background_ko: pg_dump의 tar 형식 restore.sql에 예측 가능한 제한 키가 사용돼 신뢰할 수 없는 데이터가 포함될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-116331.description: Type confusion in PostgreSQL min/max aggregate optimization allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via a user-defined aggregate whose SORTOP option causes the planner to treat the aggregate's input and result as the same type when they differ. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
CVE-2026-116331.summary_ko: PostgreSQL의 최솟값·최댓값 집계 최적화에 타입 혼동 취약점이 있어, 객체 생성자가 데이터베이스를 실행하는 운영체제 사용자 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-116331.background_ko: 사용자 정의 집계의 SORTOP 옵션 때문에 플래너가 서로 다른 입력 타입과 결과 타입을 같은 타입으로 취급한다.

CVE-2026-116332.description: Use after free in PostgreSQL portal setup allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via running user-defined code during planning or executor startup that closes the portal currently being prepared. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
CVE-2026-116332.summary_ko: PostgreSQL의 포털 설정 과정에 해제 후 사용 취약점이 있어, 객체 생성자가 데이터베이스를 실행하는 운영체제 사용자 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-116332.background_ko: 계획 수립이나 실행기 시작 중 실행되는 사용자 정의 코드가 준비 중인 포털을 닫으면서 해제 후 사용이 발생한다.

CVE-2026-116333.description: Buffer over-read in PostgreSQL parallel B-tree scans allows an object creator to read attacker-chosen server-memory addresses, via a function incorrectly marked PARALLEL SAFE or STABLE to make participating workers build different scan-key arrays. Within major versions 17-18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7 and 17.12 are affected. Versions before PostgreSQL 17 are unaffected.

CVE-2026-116335.description: Type confusion in PostgreSQL operator commutator and negator links allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via linking operators having different result types or creating inconsistent reciprocal links. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
CVE-2026-116335.summary_ko: PostgreSQL 연산자의 교환자·부정자 연결에 타입 혼동 취약점이 있어, 객체 생성자가 데이터베이스를 실행하는 운영체제 사용자 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-116335.background_ko: 결과 타입이 다른 연산자가 연결되거나 상호 연결 관계가 일관되지 않게 구성되면서 타입 혼동이 발생한다.

CVE-2026-116336.description: Operation on a dropped index in PostgreSQL REINDEX CONCURRENTLY allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via an index expression that issues DROP INDEX. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
CVE-2026-116336.summary_ko: PostgreSQL의 REINDEX CONCURRENTLY가 삭제된 인덱스에 작업을 수행하는 취약점이 있어, 객체 생성자가 데이터베이스를 실행하는 운영체제 사용자 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-116336.background_ko: 인덱스 표현식에서 인덱스를 삭제하면서 이미 삭제된 인덱스에 대한 작업이 발생한다.

CVE-2026-120139.description: Integer wraparound in PostgreSQL in-memory tuple-size calculations allows a database user to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via oversized tuple data. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
CVE-2026-120139.summary_ko: PostgreSQL의 메모리 내 튜플 크기 계산에 정수 래핑 취약점이 있어 데이터베이스 사용자가 데이터베이스를 실행하는 운영체제 사용자 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-120139.background_ko: 과도하게 큰 튜플 데이터로 인해 메모리 내 튜플 크기 계산에서 정수 래핑이 발생한다.

CVE-2026-120141.description: Type confusion in PostgreSQL materialized set-returning functions allows a database user to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via returning rows having different dynamic RECORD return types. json_populate_recordset() is one affected function. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
CVE-2026-120141.summary_ko: PostgreSQL의 구체화 방식 집합 반환 함수에 타입 혼동 취약점이 있어 데이터베이스 사용자가 데이터베이스를 실행하는 운영체제 사용자 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다. json_populate_recordset()도 영향을 받는다.
CVE-2026-120141.background_ko: 집합 반환 함수가 서로 다른 동적 RECORD 반환 타입을 가진 행을 반환할 때 타입 혼동이 발생한다.

CVE-2026-120142.description: Type confusion in PostgreSQL anonymous RECORD types allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via row types having dropped attributes in the same positions but with different widths or alignments. Within major versions 17-18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7 and 17.12 are affected. Versions before PostgreSQL 17 are unaffected.

CVE-2026-120143.description: Use after free in PostgreSQL trigger functions allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via a cursor over a transition table. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
CVE-2026-120143.summary_ko: PostgreSQL의 트리거 함수에 해제 후 사용 취약점이 있어, 객체 생성자가 데이터베이스를 실행하는 운영체제 사용자 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-120143.background_ko: 전이 테이블을 대상으로 하는 커서 사용 과정에서 해제 후 사용이 발생한다.

CVE-2026-120144.description: Type confusion from incomplete PostgreSQL type-cache invalidation allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via a composite type change while its cache entry is being populated. Within major version 18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7 are affected. Versions before PostgreSQL 18 are unaffected.

CVE-2026-120145.description: Missing authorization in PostgreSQL logical replication allows a compromised publisher to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the superuser-owned subscription, via naming a system catalog as a replication target. Only subscriptions owned by a superuser are vulnerable. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
CVE-2026-120145.summary_ko: PostgreSQL 논리 복제의 권한 검사 누락으로 침해된 게시자가 슈퍼유저 소유 구독을 실행하는 운영체제 사용자 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다. PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, 14.25 이전 버전이 영향받으며, 슈퍼유저 소유 구독만 취약하다.
CVE-2026-120145.background_ko: 논리 복제 기능에서 필요한 권한 검사가 누락됐다.

CVE-2026-120146.description: Missing authorization in PostgreSQL REASSIGN OWNED allows a role granted INHERIT but not SET to transfer objects to the granted role. It also allows reassignment of database ownership without the CREATEDB privilege. The equivalent ALTER ... OWNER commands block this. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

CVE-2026-120147.description: Use after free in the PostgreSQL dblink extension allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via type conversion code that re-enters dblink and closes a connection whose results an outer dblink call is reading. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

CVE-2026-120148.description: Type confusion in PostgreSQL extended statistics allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via a statistics expression of an anonymous RECORD type whose backend-local type identifier denotes a different row type in another session. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

CVE-2026-120149.description: Heap-based buffer overflow in PostgreSQL foreign batch inserts allows a foreign server to execute arbitrary code, via reporting that it inserted more rows than the server supplied. postgres_fdw can legitimately encounter this when a rule on the remote table expands an INSERT into additional rows. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
CVE-2026-120149.summary_ko: PostgreSQL의 외부 테이블 일괄 삽입 기능에 힙 기반 버퍼 오버플로 취약점이 있어, 외부 서버가 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-120149.background_ko: 외부 서버가 제공받은 행 수보다 더 많은 행을 삽입했다고 보고할 때 힙 기반 버퍼 오버플로가 발생한다.

CVE-2026-120150.description: Use after free in PostgreSQL expanded-record domain checks allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via repeated checks of a domain over a composite type that cause reuse of a dangling memory-context pointer. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
CVE-2026-120150.summary_ko: PostgreSQL의 확장 레코드 도메인 검사에 해제 후 사용 취약점이 있어, 객체 생성자가 데이터베이스를 실행하는 운영체제 사용자 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-120150.background_ko: 복합 타입을 기반으로 한 도메인 검사를 반복하면서 해제된 메모리 컨텍스트를 가리키는 포인터가 재사용된다.

CVE-2026-120151.description: Type confusion in PostgreSQL plpgsql record-field assignment allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via a reentrant domain CHECK that changes a RECORD variable's row type while a value is being cast. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
CVE-2026-120151.summary_ko: PostgreSQL의 PL/pgSQL 레코드 필드 대입에 타입 혼동 취약점이 있어, 객체 생성자가 데이터베이스를 실행하는 운영체제 사용자 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-120151.background_ko: 값의 형 변환 중 재진입한 도메인 CHECK가 RECORD 변수의 행 타입을 바꾸면서 타입 혼동이 발생한다.

CVE-2026-120152.description: Use after free in PostgreSQL pg_show_all_settings() allows a database user to retrieve memory contents, via loading a module while the function is scanning custom-variable placeholders that the module replaces and frees. Within major versions 16-18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, and 16.16 are affected. Versions before PostgreSQL 16 are unaffected.

CVE-2026-120153.description: SQL injection in PostgreSQL extension-script substitutions allows an attacker with database-level CREATE privilege to execute arbitrary code as the bootstrap superuser, via a schema or owner name containing newlines or other special substrings. This is similar to CVE-2023-39417, but it requires a non-bundled extension with a vulnerable script pattern. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

CVE-2026-120154.description: Improper protection in PostgreSQL INSERT ... ON CONFLICT allows an attacker having INSERT, UPDATE, and applicable SELECT privileges on the table to read every row despite row security policies, via iterated INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE. Unlike CVE-2026-16237, this does not facilitate improper writes. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

CVE-2026-123790.description: ComfyUI-Easy-Use version 1.3.6 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the `save_preview()` handler for POST `/easyuse/save/{name}`. The handler checks the source directory before appending a user-supplied filename and allows the request to select the `custom_nodes` directory as a copy destination. An unauthenticated attacker who can reach the ComfyUI server can overwrite an installed custom node’s Python entry point with an uploaded file. When ComfyUI restarts and loads the modified node, the attacker’s code runs with the privileges of the ComfyUI process.
CVE-2026-123790.summary_ko: ComfyUI-Easy-Use 1.3.6의 save_preview() 처리기에 경로 순회 취약점이 있다. 서버에 접근 가능한 비인증 공격자가 설치된 사용자 정의 노드의 Python 진입점을 덮어쓸 수 있으며, 재시작 후 변경된 노드를 불러오면 ComfyUI 프로세스 권한으로 공격자의 코드가 실행된다.
CVE-2026-123790.background_ko: 처리기가 사용자 제공 파일명을 결합하기 전에 원본 디렉터리를 검사하고, custom_nodes 디렉터리를 복사 대상으로 선택하도록 허용한다.

CVE-2026-126996.description: A vulnerability was determined in SakanaAI text-to-LoRA 0.0.1. Affected by this issue is the function get_tokenizer of the file src/hyper_llm_modulator/utils/model_loading.py of the component Checkpoint Loading. Executing a manipulation of the argument base_model_name_or_path can lead to path traversal. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-126997.description: A vulnerability was identified in JeecgBoot up to 3.9.6. This affects the function RestTemplate.exchange of the file org/jeecg/modules/airag/flow/c/a.class of the component flow-run Endpoint. The manipulation leads to server-side request forgery. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
CVE-2026-126997.summary_ko: JeecgBoot 3.9.6 이하의 flow-run 엔드포인트에서 RestTemplate.exchange 함수와 관련된 서버 측 요청 위조(SSRF) 취약점이 발견됐다. 원격 악용이 가능하며, 익스플로잇이 공개돼 있다.

CVE-2026-126998.description: A security flaw has been discovered in JeecgBoot up to 3.9.5. This vulnerability affects the function OpenApiController.call of the file /openapi/call of the component Authentication Filter. The manipulation results in server-side request forgery. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
CVE-2026-126998.summary_ko: JeecgBoot 3.9.5 이하의 인증 필터 구성요소에 있는 OpenApiController.call 함수에 서버 측 요청 위조(SSRF) 취약점이 있다. 원격 악용이 가능하며, 익스플로잇이 공개돼 있다.

CVE-2026-14661.description: External control of file name in PostgreSQL dblink and CREATE/ALTER SUBSCRIPTION allows a user to achieve persistent denial of service, via appending invalid data to a chosen file. Specifically, the "sslkeylogfile" connection parameter appends data, in NSS keylog format, to a file of the user's choosing. This "sslkeylogfile" mechanism cannot add arbitrary bytes. Within major version 18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7 are affected. Versions before PostgreSQL 18 are also affected if libpq version 18 or later is installed and in use by the server.

CVE-2026-16237.description: Improper protection in PostgreSQL INSERT ... ON CONFLICT on auto-updatable views allows an attacker having INSERT and UPDATE privileges on the view to read and modify every row in the view's base table, via iterated INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE. This bypasses the view's WHERE condition, whether or not the view is a security_barrier view. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

CVE-2026-16240.description: Use of externally-controlled format string in PostgreSQL pg_basebackup allows an attacker having already compromised a server to achieve disclosure from pg_basebackup memory, via backup manifest bytes. The vulnerability does not return the improperly-read bytes back to the attacker's server, so a successful attack would need separate implementation-specific secrets for that. Integrity impact is unlikely; in particular, the applicable formatter does not support %n. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

CVE-2026-18447.description: Type confusion in PostgreSQL SQL-language functions allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via an output parameter of type "any". Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
CVE-2026-18447.summary_ko: PostgreSQL의 SQL 언어 함수에 타입 혼동 취약점이 있어, 객체 생성자가 데이터베이스를 실행하는 운영체제 사용자 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-18447.background_ko: any 타입의 출력 매개변수를 처리하면서 타입 혼동이 발생한다.

CVE-2026-6460.description: Type confusion in PostgreSQL allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via ALTER ... SET DATA TYPE primarily. Other DDL attack routes exist, such as "ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN; ROLLBACK; ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN". The system had inadequate tracking of typed values, and values were not self-identifying. Stale values could appear in data dictionary entries, PL/pgSQL variables, and many other parts of the system. PostgreSQL Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
CVE-2026-6460.summary_ko: PostgreSQL의 타입 혼동 취약점으로 객체 생성자가 데이터베이스를 실행하는 운영체제 사용자 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-6460.background_ko: 타입이 있는 값의 추적이 불충분하고 값 자체에 타입 식별 정보가 없어 시스템 여러 영역에 오래된 값이 남을 수 있다.

CVE-2026-6467.description: Uncontrolled search path element in PostgreSQL CREATE EXTENSION allows an attacker with database-level CREATE privilege to execute arbitrary code as the bootstrap superuser, via ALTER SCHEMA ... RENAME or CREATE EXTENSION ... SCHEMA "$user". ALTER EXTENSION was also affected. A trusted-extension script located the wrong object and executed arbitrary SQL of the attacker's choice. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

CVE-2026-126329.description: Docker Sandboxes reuses existing state and configuration directories without verifying their ownership. If sbx or sandboxd is run as root with HOME or, on Linux, XDG_STATE_HOME pointing to an attacker-controlled location, a local unprivileged user can substitute control-plane sockets and configuration trusted by the root process, potentially executing commands as root. Exploitation requires a privileged invocation with an attacker-influenced environment. The issue affects Linux and macOS and is fixed in version 0.53.0.
CVE-2026-126329.summary_ko: Linux와 macOS의 Docker Sandboxes에서 공격자가 영향을 준 환경으로 root 실행이 이뤄지면, 로컬 비특권 사용자가 root 권한으로 명령을 실행할 수 있다. 이 문제는 0.53.0에서 수정됐다.
CVE-2026-126329.background_ko: Docker Sandboxes가 기존 상태 및 설정 디렉터리의 소유권을 확인하지 않고 재사용한다.

CVE-2026-126330.description: Docker Sandboxes can silently republish a sandbox service after an operator removes its automatically assigned host-port mapping. The daemon removes the active binding but retains the original publication request, allowing a later port change or sandbox restart to publish the service again on a new host port. An attacker able to reach the restored endpoint may regain access to the service. Both TCP and UDP mappings are affected. Exposure is limited to the original bind address, which defaults to loopback. The issue is fixed in version 0.53.0.

CVE-2026-127109.description: A code injection vulnerability in promzard’s template-loading functionality allows an attacker who can control property names in the context object (ctx) to execute arbitrary code with the privileges of the Node.js process. The library inserts context property names into a generated function’s parameter list without validation or escaping and evaluates the resulting source using `vm.runInThisContext()`. A crafted property name can escape the parameter list and inject JavaScript code, even when the template file is fully trusted.
CVE-2026-127109.summary_ko: promzard의 템플릿 로딩 기능에 코드 삽입 취약점이 있어, 컨텍스트 객체(ctx)의 속성 이름을 제어하는 공격자가 Node.js 프로세스 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다. 템플릿 파일이 신뢰할 수 있는 경우에도 영향받는다.
CVE-2026-127109.background_ko: 컨텍스트 속성 이름을 검증·이스케이프 없이 생성 함수의 매개변수 목록에 삽입하고, 생성된 소스를 vm.runInThisContext()로 평가한다.

CVE-2026-127111.description: SOGo before 5.12.13 contains an improper restriction of excessive authentication attempts vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reset account passwords by repeatedly guessing secret-question answers via the passwordRecoveryCheck endpoint without lockout or rate limiting. Attackers can submit unlimited candidate answers to obtain a valid recovery JWT, then use it to change the account password without the old credential and log in via the connect endpoint, achieving full account takeover on accounts without TOTP enabled.
CVE-2026-127111.summary_ko: SOGo 5.12.13 이전 버전은 비밀번호 복구 인증 시도를 적절히 제한하지 않아 미인증 공격자가 계정 비밀번호를 재설정할 수 있다. TOTP가 활성화되지 않은 계정은 완전히 탈취될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-127111.background_ko: passwordRecoveryCheck 엔드포인트에 잠금이나 요청 속도 제한이 없어 비밀 질문 답변을 무제한으로 추측할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-127121.description: SOGo before 5.12.13 contains an improper cryptographic signature verification vulnerability that allows remote attackers to replace a victim's contact S/MIME certificate by sending a spoofed multipart/signed message with a mismatched signature and an impersonated From address. Attackers can deliver a crafted CMS signedData object containing their own self-signed certificate, which SOGo's UIxMailView stores on the contact card without validating signature authenticity or certificate identity, enabling subsequent encrypted communications to be decrypted with the attacker's private key.

CVE-2026-127131.description: SOGo before 5.12.13 contains a missing rate limiting vulnerability in its web login TOTP verification that allows attackers who already possess a victim's password to brute-force the second-factor code without triggering any lockout. Attackers can send repeated POST requests to /SOGo/connect with wrong verification codes at high speed since failed TOTP attempts never increment the failed-login counter and SOGoMaximumFailedLoginCount does not apply, enabling indefinite guessing across 30-second code windows to bypass two-factor authentication.
CVE-2026-127131.summary_ko: SOGo 5.12.13 미만에서는 피해자의 비밀번호를 이미 아는 공격자가 웹 로그인 TOTP 코드를 무제한 추측해 계정 잠금 없이 2단계 인증을 우회할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-127131.background_ko: TOTP 검증에 시도 횟수 제한이 없고, 검증 실패가 로그인 실패 횟수에 반영되지 않아 로그인 실패 제한이 적용되지 않는다.

CVE-2026-127135.description: SOGo before 5.12.13 contains a Sieve script injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject arbitrary Sieve directives by inserting unescaped notification address values into a generated Sieve script. Attackers can embed Sieve redirect or discard statements within the notificationAddress preference to bypass the administrator-configured forwarding-domain constraint and redirect or discard incoming mail.

CVE-2026-127141.description: SOGo before 5.12.13 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to exhaust all worker processes by configuring an auxiliary IMAP mail account pointing to a controlled host that accepts a TCP connection but never sends an IMAP greeting response. Attackers can issue concurrent GET requests to the mail view of this account to hold workers indefinitely without an effective timeout, occupying every SOGo worker and denying service to all users for approximately five minutes until the watchdog kills and respawns the stuck workers.

CVE-2026-127145.description: SOGo before 5.12.13 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to make the server connect to arbitrary internal host:port destinations by supplying a user-controlled URL to the Calendar/addWebCalendar endpoint. Attackers can trigger a reload of the subscribed web calendar via the reload endpoint and distinguish response outcomes such as connection failures, timeouts, authentication prompts, or invalid content to probe the internal network from the server's position.

CVE-2026-19809.description: The user-mode system call verifier z_vrfy_charger_get_prop() in drivers/charger/charger_handlers.c declares an uninitialized union charger_propval k_val on the kernel (privileged) stack, passes it to the charger driver back end via z_impl_charger_get_prop(), and then copies the full sizeof(union charger_propval) back into the calling user thread's buffer with k_usermode_to_copy(). That discloses kernel stack contents on two paths: On error. The copy-out ignores the driver's return code. In-tree back ends return an error without writing through the value pointer for properties they do not implement: charger_gpio_get_prop() returns -ENOTSUP unconditionally, and bq24190_get_prop() has a default: return -ENOTSUP; arm that never touches val. The whole union is then stack residue. On success. A back end writes only the one union member the requested property selects (for example sbs_charger.c writes the one-byte val->present for CHARGER_PROP_PRESENT and returns 0), yet the handler still copies the whole union, so every byte beyond that member is uninitialized. The handler is compiled only when CONFIG_USERSPACE=y and is reachable by any user-mode thread that has been granted access to a charger device object. K_SYSCALL_DRIVER_CHARGER() validates only the device object and its API pointer, not the property identifier, so an unprivileged thread can choose prop freely: an unimplemented property forces the error path, a narrow one the success path, and the call can be repeated at will. Each call discloses up to the size of the union (12 bytes on a 32-bit target, 16 bytes on 64-bit targets where the function-pointer members widen it) of supervisor-stack memory. The bytes are residue of earlier kernel-side frames on the thread's privileged stack and can contain kernel object addresses and saved return addresses, which an unprivileged thread cannot otherwise observe and which help defeat address-layout assumptions when exploiting a separate memory-safety defect. There is no integrity or availability impact. Two commits fix it, and both are needed. 5054384e983c skips the copy-out when the back end reports an error. c31cac727d02 zeroes the union before the driver call, so the bytes copied out on success are driver-written data or zeros. A tree carrying only the first still leaks on every successful call.

CVE-2026-70642.description: ToolJet before 3.21.94, fixed in commit e5f387a, contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the app environments init endpoint that allows authenticated users to read app version metadata belonging to other workspaces. Attackers can send GET requests to /api/app-environments/init with an editing_version_id from another workspace to retrieve the version name, description, status, current environment ID, and app ID, because the lookup is not scoped to the caller's organization.

CVE-2026-91007.description: The user-mode syscall verifiers for the charger driver API in drivers/charger/charger_handlers.c did not inspect the prop argument before copying union charger_propval across the user/kernel boundary. Two members of that union are function pointers — status_notification (CHARGER_PROP_STATUS_NOTIFICATION) and online_notification (CHARGER_PROP_ONLINE_NOTIFICATION), declared in include/zephyr/drivers/charger.h — and z_vrfy_charger_set_prop() forwarded the caller-supplied union verbatim to the driver's set_property callback for any property. z_vrfy_charger_get_prop() had the mirror defect and copied the stored kernel callback address back out to user memory. With CONFIG_USERSPACE enabled, any user-mode thread that has been granted a charger device object could call charger_set_prop() with CHARGER_PROP_STATUS_NOTIFICATION or CHARGER_PROP_ONLINE_NOTIFICATION and an arbitrary pointer value. Drivers that implement these properties — drivers/charger/charger_max20335.c, drivers/charger/charger_pf1550.c and drivers/charger/charger_bq2518x.c — store the pointer in device data and later invoke it from their interrupt work handlers, which run in supervisor mode, on any charger state change such as a cable plug/unplug. The result is a control-flow hijack at kernel privilege from an unprivileged thread, defeating the isolation that CONFIG_USERSPACE is meant to provide; the read path additionally disclosed a kernel code address to user mode, and clearing a notifier installed by a supervisor thread let user mode suppress charger notifications. Supervisor-mode callers of charger_set_prop()/charger_get_prop() are unaffected. The fix makes both verifiers reject the two notifier properties outright — including when the supplied callback is NULL, since the notifiers are device state — and adds a BUILD_ASSERT on CHARGER_PROP_COMMON_COUNT so that new properties force a re-review of the union's user-mode safety.

CVE-2025-10698.description: Incorrect default permissions and Product released in Non-Release configuration vulnerability in OpenText Identity Console on Windows, Linux, and 64 bit allows Retrieve Embedded Sensitive Data. This issue affects Identity Console: from 1.8 through 25.2.

CVE-2026-121876.description: A flaw was found in the interaction between systemd-gpt-auto-generator and confidential computing guest VM images in OpenShift Sandboxed Containers (confidential peer pods). systemd-gpt-auto-generator automatically discovers and mounts GPT partitions by type GUID at boot with no user confirmation. In the confidential computing threat model, where the host/hypervisor is the adversary, a malicious host can inject partitions into the guest's virtual disk. Most critically, injecting a swap partition causes the guest kernel to page out TEE-encrypted memory to a host-controlled block device, breaking the confidentiality guarantee of the hardware TEE (AMD SEV-SNP, Intel TDX). The PodVM images use a GPT-partitioned disk with dm-verity on the root partition. However, the roothash= kernel parameter only disables root auto-discovery — non-root partitions (swap, /home, /var, /srv, /var/tmp) are still auto-discovered and mounted. The generator is shipped unmasked in the RHEL systemd-udev subpackage, and no kernel command line parameter in the measured UKI addon disables it. Additionally, the PodVM measurement script captures PCRs 3, 9, 11, and 12, but not PCR 5 (GPT partition table), so partition table modifications are not detected by remote attestation.
CVE-2026-121876.summary_ko: OpenShift Sandboxed Containers의 기밀 피어 포드 VM과 systemd-gpt-auto-generator의 상호작용에 취약점이 있다. 악성 호스트가 삽입한 스왑 파티션에 TEE로 보호된 게스트 메모리가 기록되어 AMD SEV-SNP·Intel TDX의 기밀성 보장이 깨질 수 있다.
CVE-2026-121876.background_ko: 비루트 GPT 파티션이 사용자 확인 없이 자동 탐지·마운트되고, 원격 증명 측정에서 GPT 파티션 테이블에 해당하는 PCR 5가 누락된다.

CVE-2026-124691.description: In Progress Kendo UI for jQuery Gantt, the task editor's Parent dropdown renders task titles as HTML. An attacker who can influence a task title shown in the dropdown can cause attacker-controlled markup to execute as JavaScript when a user opens or interacts with the task editor. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality and integrity of data available in the user's browser context. The first affected version is 2020.3.915; the latest vulnerable version is 2026.3.1015. The issue is fixed in version 2026.4.1111.

CVE-2026-124695.description: In Progress Kendo UI for jQuery Form, the items[].hint option is documented as a string but is rendered as HTML. An attacker who can influence a Form item's hint can cause attacker-controlled markup to execute as JavaScript when a user views the rendered form. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality and integrity of data available in the user's browser context. The first affected version is 2020.2.513; the latest vulnerable version is 2026.3.1015. The issue is fixed in version 2026.4.1111.

CVE-2026-124696.description: In Progress Kendo UI for jQuery, Spreadsheet sheet names are inserted into the SheetsBar menu button's data-sheet-name attribute without encoding. An attacker who can influence a sheet name can inject an event-handler attribute and execute JavaScript when a user hovers over the menu button. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality and integrity of data available in the user's browser context. The first affected version is 2024.4.1112; the latest vulnerable version is 2026.3.1015. The issue is fixed in version 2026.4.1111.

CVE-2026-124697.description: In Progress Kendo UI for jQuery, Chart shared-tooltip rendering treats bound category and series-name values as raw HTML. An attacker who can influence values consumed by an affected Chart can inject markup that executes as JavaScript when a user displays the shared tooltip. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality and integrity of data available in the user's browser context. Version 2016.2.607 or earlier may be affected, but earlier releases have not been verified. The latest vulnerable version is 2026.3.1015; the issue is fixed in version 2026.4.1111.

CVE-2026-124698.description: In Progress Kendo UI for jQuery, the Chart default tooltip renders point values as raw HTML. An attacker who can influence a string point value can inject markup that executes as JavaScript when a user hovers over the point. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality and integrity of data available in the user's browser context. Version 2016.2.607 or earlier may be affected, but earlier releases have not been verified. The latest vulnerable version is 2026.3.1015; the issue is fixed in version 2026.4.1111.

CVE-2026-126189.description: Soup Sieve is a CSS selector library designed to be used with Beautiful Soup 4. Prior to 4.0.1, Soup Sieve repeatedly searches descendant subtrees for each candidate evaluated by :has() and repeatedly reevaluates a parent containing :has(> ...) for each child, causing quadratic matching on deeply nested or wide attacker-influenced HTML or XML. Applications using ordinary fixed selectors through select(), select_one(), or Beautiful Soup CSS APIs against untrusted documents can have a worker occupied for seconds or minutes, while applications that process only trusted documents are not affected. Selectors compiled with NOCACHE continue to use the old uncached behavior. This issue is fixed in version 4.0.1.

CVE-2026-126190.description: Soup Sieve is a CSS selector library designed to be used with Beautiful Soup 4. Prior to 4.0, Soup Sieve repeatedly walks the same ancestors while matching descendant combinators, and each additional descendant combinator raises the polynomial degree of the work on deeply nested attacker-influenced HTML or XML. Applications using selectors such as section div div through select(), select_one(), or Beautiful Soup CSS APIs against untrusted documents can have a worker occupied for seconds or minutes, while trusted-only document processing is not affected. Selectors compiled with NOCACHE continue to use the old uncached behavior. This issue is fixed in version 4.0.

CVE-2026-126191.description: Soup Sieve is a CSS selector library designed to be used with Beautiful Soup 4. Prior to 3.0, the CSS_ESCAPES and IDENTIFIER regular-expression subpatterns can backtrack exponentially on runs of ambiguous digit escapes in an attribute-name or tag position of an otherwise valid selector. The failure occurs during selector compilation through soupsieve.compile() or Beautiful Soup select() before SELECTOR_LIMIT is applied, so an application that accepts untrusted selector strings can have a worker stalled by a short input. This issue is fixed in version 3.0.

CVE-2026-126192.description: Soup Sieve is a CSS selector library designed to be used with Beautiful Soup 4. Prior to 2.10, matching a developer-authored selector that places the general sibling combinator inside :has() repeatedly scans each candidate element's following siblings when the right-hand side is absent, producing quadratic work on attacker-controlled HTML. Applications that evaluate a fixed selector such as div:has(a ~ b) over untrusted markup can have a worker occupied for minutes by a small document, while the adjacent sibling form and trusted-only document processing are not affected in the same way. This issue is fixed in version 2.10.

CVE-2026-126193.description: Soup Sieve is a CSS selector library for Beautiful Soup. From 0.4 until 3.0, deeply nested CSS pseudo-class selectors can cause recursive parsing to exceed Python’s recursion limit and raise RecursionError . Applications accepting untrusted selectors may experience failure of the affected request or task if the exception is not handled. The demonstrated behavior is recoverable and does not establish an interpreter crash or persistent service-wide denial of service. This vulnerability is fixed in version 3.0.

CVE-2026-126835.description: The MongoDB Node.js driver does not consistently enforce its permitted-host restriction during OIDC authentication. A bearer token produced by the embedding application's own login callback may therefore be transmitted to a host outside the configured set of permitted hosts, which may result in unintended disclosure of that credential. No database account is required; the party supplying the connection configuration needs only to influence the settings the application passes to the driver.
CVE-2026-126835.summary_ko: MongoDB Node.js 드라이버의 OIDC 인증에서 애플리케이션 로그인 콜백이 생성한 베어러 토큰이 허용 목록 밖의 호스트로 전달돼 유출될 수 있다. 데이터베이스 계정 없이도 애플리케이션이 드라이버에 전달하는 연결 설정에 영향을 줄 수 있는 공격자가 악용할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-126835.background_ko: OIDC 인증 과정에서 설정된 허용 호스트 제한을 일관되게 적용하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-126837.description: A validation flaw in the DNS SRV host discovery of the MongoDB Node.js driver may cause the driver to connect to a host outside the expected domain. For a mongodb+srv:// connection string, the driver checks each host name in the DNS SRV response against the domain of the connection string. The driver then builds the connection address from the original name, in which certain characters end the host name early. An unauthenticated party who can forge or change the DNS SRV response may redirect the connection to a host of their choice. TLS does not prevent this, because the driver verifies the server certificate against the redirected host name. This may result in unintended disclosure of application data and authentication credentials, and in altered query results. Applications that use mongodb:// connection strings are not affected.
CVE-2026-126837.summary_ko: MongoDB Node.js 드라이버의 DNS SRV 검증 결함으로 연결이 예상 도메인 밖으로 리디렉션되어 애플리케이션 데이터·인증정보가 노출되거나 쿼리 결과가 변조될 수 있다. mongodb:// 연결 문자열을 사용하는 애플리케이션은 영향받지 않는다.
CVE-2026-126837.background_ko: DNS SRV 호스트 이름을 검증한 뒤 원래 이름으로 연결 주소를 구성하는데, 특정 문자가 호스트 이름을 조기에 끝내 검증 대상과 실제 연결 대상이 달라진다.

CVE-2026-127029.description: A flaw was found in freeradius's Extensible Authentication Protocol Method for Subscriber Identity Module (EAP-SIM) module. When handling authentication requests, the server copies a client-supplied identity into an internal structure without properly checking its length against a fixed-size buffer. An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this issue by sending specially crafted EAP-SIM messages, triggering a stack buffer overflow that crashes the service and results in a Denial of Service (DoS).
CVE-2026-127029.summary_ko: freeradius의 EAP-SIM 모듈에 스택 버퍼 오버플로 취약점이 있어, 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 서버를 중단시켜 서비스 거부를 일으킬 수 있다.
CVE-2026-127029.background_ko: 클라이언트가 제공한 식별자를 내부 구조체에 복사할 때 고정 크기 버퍼에 맞는지 길이를 적절히 검사하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-127030.description: A flaw was found in freeradius. An improper length validation in the EAP-FAST module allows a stack-based buffer overflow during session ticket processing. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can exploit this flaw by sending a specially crafted handshake request, causing the server process to crash and resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS).
CVE-2026-127030.summary_ko: freeradius의 EAP-FAST 모듈에 세션 티켓 처리 중 발생하는 스택 기반 버퍼 오버플로 취약점이 있다. 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 서버 프로세스를 중단시켜 서비스 거부를 일으킬 수 있다.
CVE-2026-127030.background_ko: EAP-FAST 모듈이 세션 티켓을 처리할 때 길이를 적절히 검증하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-127202.description: MLflow before 3.18.0 using the FileStore backend contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to write files outside the intended run directory by supplying a malicious model_id parameter to the log outputs API. Attackers can exploit the unvalidated model_id containing ../ sequences via the POST /api/3.0/mlflow/runs/outputs endpoint to create directories and write a meta.yaml file at arbitrary filesystem locations, limited only by the server account's permissions. FileStore was the default backend before 3.7.0 and is opt-in afterward through MLFLOW_ALLOW_FILE_STORE.

CVE-2026-127203.description: AppFlowy Cloud through 0.9.64 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated workspace members to upload blobs with unvalidated Content-Type values that are later served inline without a Content-Disposition header or authentication on the retrieval route. Attackers can upload a text/html or image/svg+xml blob via put_blob_handler, which is then rendered as an active same-origin document through the unauthenticated get_blob_handler endpoint and cached immutably for one year, enabling persistent script execution against any visitor who accesses the URL.

CVE-2026-16052.description: The http.cookies.Morsel class allows separator semicolons in attribute values and includes them verbatim in all output formats. An attacker who can control these values could use this to relax the cookie's Domain or SameSite restrictions.

CVE-2026-82977.description: The Plesk GoAccess statistics integration in Plesk Obsidian for Linux, versions 18.0.77 to 18.0.81.7, 18.0.82 to 18.0.82.2, allows cross-subscription information disclosure.

CVE-2026-106146.description: In Progress® Telerik® UI for ASP.NET MVC versions `2012.2.710` through `2026.3.1015`, server-side filter processing does not properly validate descriptor types, null values, or stack state in FilterNodeVisitor and does not catch FilterParserException within the affected assembly. An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this if the application exposes an endpoint reachable without authentication that accepts crafted filter parameters. Affected requests can trigger uncaught cast, null-reference, or empty-stack exceptions and return HTTP 500. The report does not demonstrate worker-process termination or disruption of unrelated requests. The issue is fixed in version `2026.4.1111`.

CVE-2026-106154.description: In Progress® Telerik® UI for ASP.NET Core versions `2015.1.318` through `2026.3.1015`, the server-side FilterParser processes nested expressions in untrusted filter parameters through recursive parsing without a recursion-depth limit, while FilterLexer does not enforce an input-length limit. An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this if the application exposes an endpoint using DataSourceRequest model binding that is reachable without authentication. Deeply nested filters can trigger parsing errors during model binding or cause `StackOverflowException`. This issue is fixed in version `2026.4.1111`.

CVE-2026-106472.description: Grafana's Prometheus data source passes the resource path supplied by the caller to the configured Prometheus server without restricting it to the supported API endpoints [missing path allowlist]. A user with permission to query the data source can read responses from other endpoints on that server using the data source's credentials.

CVE-2026-106475.description: The Elasticsearch data source resource proxy forwards the request method and path to Elasticsearch using the data source's own credentials, without restricting them to the operations the plugin needs. A user who can query the data source can alter index mappings or reach other indices on the cluster. [Improper authorization / path validation]
CVE-2026-106475.summary_ko: Elasticsearch 데이터 소스 리소스 프록시의 권한 및 경로 검증 미흡으로, 데이터 소스를 조회할 수 있는 사용자가 인덱스 매핑을 변경하거나 클러스터의 다른 인덱스에 접근할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-106475.background_ko: 프록시가 요청 메서드와 경로를 플러그인에 필요한 작업으로 제한하지 않고 데이터 소스의 자격 증명으로 Elasticsearch에 전달한다.

CVE-2026-107365.description: A user with query access to a Google Cloud Monitoring data source can use its resource proxy to send requests to other Cloud Monitoring API paths with the data source's credentials, and read data from any project those credentials can reach. When the data source forwards the user's OAuth identity or uses Workload Identity Federation, the impact depends on that credential's permissions. Fixed in Google Cloud Monitoring plugin 12.6.7.

CVE-2026-117543.description: Joomla Extension - jdownloads.com - SSRF via external download URL field jDownloads < 4.1.8 - HTTP redirects when retrieving external download URLs could bypass validation of the original destination. This allowed server-side requests to internal or otherwise prohibited destinations and disclosure of their responses (SSRF).

CVE-2026-117550.description: Joomla Extension - jdownloads.com - Publishing of files without approval in jDownloads < 4.1.8 - Manipulated frontend submission parameters could bypass the intended publication and ownership rules. In particular, submissions could be published despite automatic publication being disabled, and ownership could be assigned contrary to the intended policy.

CVE-2026-117551.description: Joomla Extension - jdownloads.com - RCE through file upload in jDownloads < 4.1.8 - Insufficient validation of frontend thumbnail uploads allowed users with upload permission to place executable files on the server. This results in PHP code execution.
CVE-2026-117551.summary_ko: Joomla 확장인 jDownloads 4.1.8 미만에 파일 업로드 취약점이 있어 업로드 권한이 있는 사용자가 서버에서 PHP 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-117551.background_ko: 프런트엔드 썸네일 업로드 검증이 불충분해 업로드 권한이 있는 사용자가 실행 가능한 파일을 서버에 저장할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-118495.description: Joomla / WordPress Extension - acymailing.com - Exposure of sensitive information to an unauthorized actor in AcyMailing 6.0.0 - 11.1.1 - Exposure of sensitive information to an unauthorized actor in AcyMailing 6.0.0 through 11.1.1. An unauthenticated attacker who knows a subscriber's email address can read that subscriber's record, including the per-subscriber secret key that authorises the subscription management links. Holding that key, the attacker can act as that subscriber on those endpoints, which includes triggering the GDPR data export and the GDPR account deletion where those options are enabled.
CVE-2026-118495.summary_ko: Joomla·WordPress 확장 AcyMailing 6.0.0~11.1.1에서 가입자 이메일 주소를 아는 비인증 공격자가 비밀 키를 포함한 가입자 기록을 읽을 수 있다. 이 키로 가입자를 사칭해 구독 관리 기능을 사용하고, 활성화된 경우 GDPR 데이터 내보내기와 계정 삭제를 실행할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-119275.description: Akaunting 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the XLSX invoice-import workflow. An authenticated Manager can import a child invoice whose invoice number contains HTML and is linked to a recurring invoice. When a victim opens that recurring invoice, Akaunting raw-renders the stored child number in an anchor, causing attacker-controlled markup to execute in the victim's browser.

CVE-2026-120466.description: Joomla / WordPress Extension - acymailing.com - Missing authorization on subscription changes in AcyMailing 1.0.0 - 11.1.1 - An unauthenticated attacker who knows a subscriber's email address can unsubscribe that subscriber from one mailing list or from every mailing lists, without proving that the address is theirs. The affected feature also lets an attacker determine whether a given email address belongs to a subscriber of the site.

CVE-2026-120468.description: Joomla Extension - acymailing.com - Unauthenticated disclosure of mailing list metadata in AcyMailing 1.0.0 - 11.1.1 - An unauthenticated attacker can retrieve every mailing list of the site, including lists that are not publicly visible and lists restricted to an access level, together with their descriptions, access levels, owning user account and subscriber counts. The WordPress plugin is not affected.

CVE-2026-120469.description: Joomla / WordPress Extension - acymailing.com - Open redirect on the subscription and unsubscription endpoints in AcyMailing 1.0.0 - 11.1.1 - On a default configuration, an attacker can craft a link on the affected site that redirects the visitor to an arbitrary external site, which is usable for phishing under the trusted domain.

CVE-2026-120470.description: Joomla / WordPress Extension - acymailing.com - Online version of an email readable without the visibility check in AcyMailing 1.0.0 - 11.1.1 - An unauthenticated attacker can read the online version of campaigns that were never made public, including campaigns unpublished after being sent and campaigns sent to a restricted audience.

CVE-2026-120471.description: Joomla Extension - acymailing.com - Site modules rendered outside their access level in AcyMailing 1.0.0 - 11.1.1 - An unauthenticated visitor can cause a site module to be rendered regardless of the Joomla access level that module is restricted to, which discloses content reserved for a higher view level. The WordPress plugin is not affected.

CVE-2026-124700.description: In Telerik UI for WinForms, versions prior to 2026.4.1111, an untrusted URL redirection vulnerability exists that allows an attacker to launch arbitrary operating system protocol handlers with attacker-controlled arguments via crafted documents and hyperlinks with a non-allowlisted URI scheme that the user opens.

CVE-2026-124702.description: In Telerik UI for WPF, versions prior to 2026.4.1110, an untrusted URL redirection vulnerability exists that allows an attacker to launch arbitrary operating system protocol handlers with attacker-controlled arguments via crafted documents and hyperlinks with a non-allowlisted URI scheme that the user opens.

CVE-2026-126196.description: pgEdge Postgres MCP Server enables SQL queries against PostgreSQL databases through Model Context Protocol compatible clients. Prior to 1.1.0, query_database on a read_only connection could send unrecognized statements through pgx Exec without bind parameters, selecting PostgreSQL's simple query protocol and allowing multiple semicolon-separated statements in one request. A caller could combine transaction or session state changes with database writes, and pooled session state could leave later calls writable, when the connecting role held write privileges. The flaw affected deployments relying on read_only as a safety boundary, could compromise integrity and availability, and did not add confidentiality impact beyond the reads already permitted by the connection. This issue is fixed in 1.1.0.
CVE-2026-126196.summary_ko: pgEdge Postgres MCP Server 1.1.0 이전 버전에서 연결 역할에 쓰기 권한이 있으면 query_database의 읽기 전용 제한을 우회해 데이터를 변경할 수 있다. 후속 호출에도 쓰기 가능 상태가 남아 무결성과 가용성에 영향을 줄 수 있으며, 1.1.0에서 수정됐다.
CVE-2026-126196.background_ko: query_database가 읽기 전용 연결에서 인식하지 못한 구문을 바인드 매개변수 없이 pgx Exec로 전달해, 여러 구문을 허용하는 단순 쿼리 프로토콜이 사용된다.

CVE-2026-126197.description: pgEdge Postgres MCP Server enables SQL queries against PostgreSQL databases through Model Context Protocol compatible clients. Prior to 1.1.0, custom pl-do tools interpolated JSON arguments into a PostgreSQL DO block delimited by fixed dollar-quote tags. An argument containing $mcp_custom_tool$ could terminate the block and inject arbitrary SQL statements, while $mcp_args$ could inject procedural code into a plpgsql block. Because the statement used the simple query protocol, injected text could include additional statements and transaction control, bypassing read_only and accessing data or modifying resources available to the connecting role. The issue requires at least one pl-do custom tool; sql and pl-func tools pass arguments as bind parameters and are not affected by this injection mechanism. This issue is fixed in 1.1.0.
CVE-2026-126197.summary_ko: pgEdge Postgres MCP Server 1.1.0 이전 버전의 pl-do 사용자 정의 도구에 SQL 삽입 취약점이 있다. 연결 역할의 권한 범위에서 읽기 전용 제한을 우회해 데이터에 접근하거나 리소스를 변경할 수 있으며, 1.1.0에서 수정됐다.
CVE-2026-126197.background_ko: pl-do 도구가 JSON 인수를 고정된 달러 인용 구분자의 DO 블록에 직접 삽입하고, 단순 쿼리 프로토콜을 사용해 추가 SQL 구문 실행을 허용한다.

CVE-2026-126198.description: pgEdge Postgres MCP Server enables SQL queries against PostgreSQL databases through Model Context Protocol compatible clients. Prior to 1.1.0, the bundled clients, including the CLI and web client, decided whether to request write confirmation by checking only for the query_database tool name instead of server-published write annotations. Custom pl-do, pl-func, and writing sql tools therefore ran without confirmation on allow_writes connections, including when a model followed instructions in retrieved content. The affected control is a bundled-client warning rather than a server authorization boundary, and other MCP clients do not inherit that prompt. This issue is fixed in 1.1.0.

CVE-2026-126199.description: pgEdge Postgres MCP Server enables SQL queries against PostgreSQL databases through Model Context Protocol compatible clients. Prior to 1.1.0, the bundled CLI and web clients classified query_database statements only by their first keyword before deciding whether to display a write confirmation. SELECT INTO, data-modifying common table expressions beginning with WITH, and EXPLAIN ANALYZE of a write were treated as reads and could execute without confirmation on an allow_writes connection. Read-only connections remain protected by PostgreSQL transaction access mode, and EXPLAIN without ANALYZE and SELECT FOR UPDATE remain classified as reads. This issue is fixed in 1.1.0.

CVE-2026-126831.description: A flaw was found in cpio. A local user can cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by triggering a stack-based buffer overflow when creating archives in tar or ustar formats. When archiving files owned by users or groups with names exceeding 32 characters, cpio copies these names into fixed-size memory without verifying their length. This unbounded copy corrupts stack memory and causes the application to crash.

CVE-2026-127063.description: The third-party RMM+ extension for ConnectWise ScreenConnect uses a static API secret by default. The value can be changed by an administrator; however, environments retaining the default value may allow unauthorized access to extension API functionality, including the ability to send commands to managed agents. This issue is specific to the third-party extension and does not affect the ScreenConnect server or client. Scope: This issue affects the third-party RMM+ extension for ConnectWise ScreenConnect. Deployments without the extension are not affected. ScreenConnect server or client software are not impacted.
CVE-2026-127063.summary_ko: ConnectWise ScreenConnect용 타사 RMM+ 확장에서 기본 API 비밀값을 유지하면 비인가자가 관리 대상 에이전트에 명령을 보내는 등 확장 API 기능에 접근할 수 있다. ScreenConnect 서버와 클라이언트 자체는 영향받지 않는다.
CVE-2026-127063.background_ko: 타사 RMM+ 확장이 기본적으로 고정된 API 비밀값을 사용한다.

CVE-2026-127099.description: A flaw was found in SSSD's conversion of X.509 certificate RSA public keys to SSH keys. Missing size checks before copying RSA components into fixed-size stack buffers can cause a stack buffer overflow. An attacker able to supply a certificate with oversized RSA components that passes the configured certificate checks can cause denial of service and corrupt SSH responder memory.

CVE-2026-127100.description: A flaw was found in SSSD's PAM responder on builds with the JSON PAM extension enabled. A local attacker can submit a crafted authentication request containing a non-string OAuth2 code value. Missing JSON type validation leads to a NULL pointer dereference, terminating the PAM responder and disrupting SSSD-backed authentication.

CVE-2026-127101.description: A flaw was found in SSSD's PAM responder. A local attacker can send an authentication request without first negotiating the client protocol version. The responder dereferences a NULL protocol-version pointer and crashes, disrupting SSSD-backed authentication. Repeated crafted requests can sustain the denial of service.

CVE-2026-127204.description: WooCommerce PayPal Pro Payment Gateway plugin before 4.1.1 contains an unauthenticated payment bypass vulnerability that allows remote attackers to mark unpaid orders as paid by exploiting the pp_capture_order AJAX handler, which is gated only by a public checkout nonce and fails to properly validate the PayPal capture response status. Attackers can supply a valid _paypal_order_id to trigger payment_complete() without verifying the capture status or amount, causing the store to fulfill goods or services that were never paid for and resulting in direct financial loss to the merchant.
CVE-2026-127204.summary_ko: WooCommerce PayPal Pro Payment Gateway 4.1.1 미만에 인증 없는 결제 우회 취약점이 있다. 원격 공격자가 미결제 주문을 결제 완료로 표시해 상품이나 서비스가 대금 없이 제공되고 판매자에게 금전적 손실이 발생할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-127204.background_ko: pp_capture_order AJAX 처리기가 공개 결제 nonce만으로 접근을 허용하고 PayPal 결제 처리 응답의 상태와 금액을 제대로 검증하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-71363.description: A flaw was found in AWX. The debug API endpoints (/api/debug/task_manager/, /api/debug/dependency_manager/, /api/debug/workflow_manager/) are registered unconditionally in the URL configuration and use AllowAny permission class with _ignore_model_permissions=True. This allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to repeatedly invoke scheduler operations that acquire database advisory locks and open transactions, potentially leading to resource exhaustion and degraded service availability.

CVE-2026-81843.description: Grafana is an open-source platform for monitoring and observability. When an Elasticsearch data source is configured with a time-based index pattern, Grafana generated one index name for every interval in the requested query time range without any upper limit. A user with permission to query the data source, which includes users holding only the Viewer role in a default configuration, could submit a single small query with an extreme time range and cause the server to allocate memory until it was terminated. The allocation occurred before any request was sent to Elasticsearch, so the condition applied whether or not the Elasticsearch cluster was reachable. Data sources configured with a static index name are not affected.
CVE-2026-81843.summary_ko: Grafana에서 시간 기반 인덱스 패턴을 사용하는 Elasticsearch 데이터 소스에 조회 권한자가 메모리 고갈로 서버를 종료시킬 수 있는 취약점이 있다. 기본 설정의 Viewer 역할도 해당하며, 정적 인덱스 이름을 사용하는 데이터 소스는 영향받지 않는다.
CVE-2026-81843.background_ko: 요청 시간 범위의 각 구간에 대해 상한 없이 인덱스 이름을 생성해 Elasticsearch 요청 전부터 메모리를 할당한다.

CVE-2024-21954.description: Improper exception handling in IOMMU could allow an invalidate command to be sent to PCIe devices that do not support Address Translation Cache (ATC), potentially resulting in denial of service.

CVE-2025-54501.description: Improper access control on an internal debug interface could allow a high privileged attacker to bypass memory access controls potentially resulting in a loss of SEV-SNP guest memory integrity.

CVE-2026-0004.description: A transient execution vulnerability in some AMD processors may allow an attacker with the ability to execute code on the system to infer data in the L1D cache, potentially resulting in the leakage of sensitive information across privileged boundaries.
CVE-2026-0004.summary_ko: 일부 AMD 프로세서의 일시적 실행 취약점으로 시스템에서 코드를 실행할 수 있는 공격자가 L1D 캐시의 데이터를 추론할 수 있다. 이로 인해 권한 경계를 넘어 민감한 정보가 유출될 가능성이 있다.

CVE-2026-0101.description: Improper validation of specified quantities in input within AMD Power Management Firmware (PMFW) could allow a local attacker to pass unsanitized input, potentially resulting in a system crash or denial of service.

CVE-2026-0436.description: Insufficient parameter sanitization in the AMD Secure Processor (ASP) trusted execution environment (TEE) SPDM driver could allow an attacker to supply malicious input, potentially resulting in loss of platform integrity, memory leakage, or denial of service.

CVE-2026-117542.description: Joomla Extension - jdownloads.com - Authenticated path traversal in jDownloads < 4.1.8 - A manipulated `update_file` form parameter could bypass the intended server-file selection restrictions and move files from outside the permitted selection directory or assign them to a download. This could expose file contents and remove source files from their original locations.

CVE-2026-117544.description: Joomla Extension - jdownloads.com - IDOR allowing restricted file downloads in jDownloads < 4.1.8 - The `other_file_id` parameter could reference another download’s file without fully enforcing the target download’s access restrictions. This allowed files to be delivered to users who were not authorised to access the target download.

CVE-2026-120033.description: In FRRouting 10.1 and later, bgpd does not correctly close a BGP session when the Send Hold Timer (RFC 9687) expires, i.e. when a neighbor has stopped accepting data from the router for twice the hold time. The connection is closed, but bgpd still considers the session to be up. A BGP neighbor that keeps sending KEEPALIVEs but stops reading from its connection, at a time when the router has a large amount of data to send to it (for example while sending it a full routing table), can trigger this. If the neighbor announced Graceful Restart support, bgpd crashes shortly after the session is closed, taking down all BGP sessions on the router, and the neighbor can repeat this each time bgpd restarts. Otherwise, the session stays stuck in the Established state: the neighbor's routes stay installed and keep being advertised to other peers, and the neighbor cannot reconnect until an operator clears the session manually. The neighbor does not need to be malicious; an overloaded or stuck peer can trigger the same behavior. No special configuration is required: any established BGP neighbor can trigger the issue, and Graceful Restart helper mode, which leads to the crash, is enabled by default.
CVE-2026-120033.summary_ko: FRRouting 10.1 이상에서는 BGP 세션 종료 처리 오류로, 상대가 Graceful Restart 지원을 알린 경우 bgpd가 중단돼 모든 BGP 세션이 끊길 수 있다. 그 외에는 세션이 Established 상태에 고착돼 경로가 유지·재광고되고 수동으로 세션을 지우기 전까지 재연결이 차단될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-120033.background_ko: Send Hold Timer 만료로 연결이 닫혀도 bgpd가 BGP 세션을 여전히 활성 상태로 인식한다.

CVE-2026-120467.description: Joomla / WordPress Extension - acymailing.com - Subscriber identity not bound to the record acted upon in AcyMailing 1.0.0 - 11.1.1 - An authenticated user of any privilege level can subscribe or unsubscribe any other subscriber to or from any mailing list of the site.

CVE-2026-121619.description: The Symfony FrameworkBundle framework.trusted_proxies option and the HttpFoundation Request::setTrustedProxies() method trust remote clients as reverse proxies when the private_ranges shortcut is used, allowing remote attackers to spoof the client IP address, host and scheme in Symfony FrameworkBundle versions 7.1 prior to 7.4.23 and 8.x prior to 8.1.11, and HttpFoundation versions 7.2 prior to 7.4.23 and 8.x prior to 8.1.11. The private_ranges and PRIVATE_SUBNETS keywords resolved to IpUtils::PRIVATE_SUBNETS, the deny list of NoPrivateNetworkHttpClient, which lists the private and special-purpose prefixes a server must not connect to. Since the fix for CVE-2026-48736 (7.4.13 and 8.0.13), this list also covers the IPv6 prefixes that embed an IPv4 address: IPv4-mapped (::ffff:0:0/96), IPv4-compatible (::/96), 6to4 (2002::/16), Teredo (2001::/32) and NAT64 (64:ff9b::/96). The IPv4-mapped entry has been in the list since the private_ranges shortcut was introduced, in 7.1 for framework.trusted_proxies and in 7.2 for Request::setTrustedProxies(). Over-blocking is safe for a deny list, but when the same entries are used as the allow list of trusted proxies, they trust remote clients. A client whose connection arrives with such a source address is treated as a reverse proxy, and the X-Forwarded-For, X-Forwarded-Host, X-Forwarded-Proto, X-Forwarded-Port and X-Forwarded-Prefix headers it sends are honoured. For example, with Request::setTrustedProxies(['private_ranges'], ...), a request with REMOTE_ADDR set to ::ffff:203.0.113.7 and the headers X-Forwarded-For: 10.0.0.9, X-Forwarded-Host: evil.example.com and X-Forwarded-Proto: https makes getClientIp() return 10.0.0.9, getHost() return evil.example.com and isSecure() return true. Two kinds of deployments are exposed: a server listening on the IPv6 wildcard address without IPV6_V6ONLY reports every IPv4 client in the IPv4-mapped form, so every client is trusted, and a server reachable over IPv6 trusts any client sourcing from 6to4 or Teredo space, which is globally routed, whatever its listener. A spoofed client address defeats IP allow lists, rate limiting and audit logs; a spoofed host poisons the URLs written into password reset and login link e-mails and into shared caches; a spoofed scheme satisfies requires_channel: https over plain HTTP. Symfony 6.4 does not point any trusted proxy setting at IpUtils::PRIVATE_SUBNETS and is not affected by default, but an application that passes that constant to Request::setTrustedProxies() itself could be exposed in the same way on any version. This issue is fixed in 7.4.23 and 8.1.11.

CVE-2026-126203.description: Loofah is a general library for manipulating and transforming HTML/XML documents and fragments, built on top of Nokogiri. From 2.21.0 until 2.25.3, Loofah's HTML5 APIs Loofah.html5_fragment, Loofah.html5_document, and the scrub_html5_* methods can emit sanitized output that a browser reparses as different markup when used with Nokogiri before 1.19.5, because those Nokogiri versions do not escape angle brackets in attribute values. MathML can place markup inside an allowed attribute so the reparsed output becomes live HTML. The :strip scrubber is affected in every browser, while :prune and :escape are affected in WebKit browsers. Loofah's HTML4 APIs, Loofah::Helpers.sanitize, :whitewash, rails-html-sanitizer's default configuration, and JRuby are not affected. This issue is fixed in version 2.25.3.

CVE-2026-126204.description: express-rate-limit is a basic rate-limiting middleware for Express. From 8.6.0 until 8.7.2, the built-in MemoryStore returns a Client whose mutable resetTime object is retained by middleware using skipFailedRequests or skipSuccessfulRequests. When a later request resets the client window, MemoryStore.resetClient mutates that same Date, so an earlier request that finishes or disconnects after the reset can pass the stale-window guard and decrement the current window's count. A client able to keep requests in flight across the boundary can obtain a bounded extra burst of up to one additional configured limit in the new window; the behavior does not increase the sustained rate. Stores that return a fresh Date are not affected. This issue is fixed in version 8.7.2.

CVE-2026-126838.description: A MongoDB Rust Driver component that holds client-side field level encryption settings includes key management service credential material in its diagnostic formatting output without redaction. An application that records or displays this formatted output may place that material where a party with read access to the application's diagnostic output can see it, which may result in unintended disclosure of key material.

CVE-2026-127119.description: Unverified ownership of the default cluster log location in the EMR module in AWS SDK for pandas (awswrangler) from 1.1.0 before 3.18.0 might allow remote actors to read Amazon EMR cluster logs, including job step output, via a pre-created S3 bucket. To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to version 3.18.0 or later. Users who can't upgrade immediately should pass an explicit log location, or create the default EMR log bucket in their own account in each region they use.

CVE-2026-127235.description: A reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability exists in the web user interface of multiple versions of OpenNMS Meridian and Horizon. Several web UI pages copy request parameter values into the HTML response without correct contextual output encoding. A remote attacker can craft a link that runs arbitrary JavaScript in the OpenNMS origin when an authenticated user opens it. The script runs in the victim's browser with the victim's session, so the attacker can read page data and send same-origin requests as the victim. The fix encodes the affected request values. On pages that use AngularJS, the fix also stops client-side template evaluation of the reflected values. The solution is to upgrade to Meridian 2024.3.15, 2025.0.12, 2026.0.2 and Horizon 36.0.6 or newer. Meridian and Horizon installation instructions state that they are intended for installation within an organization's private networks and should not be directly accessible from the Internet.

CVE-2026-127236.description: An argument injection vulnerability exists in the ad-hoc RRD graph feature of multiple versions of OpenNMS Meridian and Horizon. The ad-hoc graph endpoint (GET /graph/graph.png?adhoc=true) copies request parameters into the rrdtool command line without validation. A low-privileged authenticated user (ROLE_USER or ROLE_DASHBOARD) can insert extra rrdtool arguments. An injected --daemon argument makes the server connect to an attacker-chosen address, which is a server-side request forgery. An injected DEF statement reads a local RRD file by absolute path. The command runs through exec with an argument array and no shell, so arbitrary operating system command execution is not possible. The fix validates the ad-hoc graph parameters against allowlists. The solution is to upgrade to Meridian 2024.3.15, 2025.0.12, 2026.0.2 and Horizon 36.0.6 or newer. Meridian and Horizon installation instructions state that they are intended for installation within an organization's private networks and should not be directly accessible from the Internet.

CVE-2026-18379.description: A flaw was found in yggdrasil-worker-package-manager. An authenticated attacker can exploit this issue to achieve arbitrary file modification or potential privilege escalation. The vulnerability exists because repository management operations fail to sanitize directory traversal sequences (such as '../') within repository names. By supplying a crafted repository name, an attacker can manipulate the root-level worker process into creating or deleting files outside the intended directory, compromising host system integrity.

CVE-2024-21963.description: An out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the IOMMU could allow a malicious guest to corrupt hypervisor (HV) pages and potentially cause a host crash leading to loss of availability.

CVE-2024-36344.description: Insufficient parameter sanitization in AMD Secure Processor (ASP) TEE DrvSys could allow an attacker with local access to the Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) interface or Trusted Application (TA) to cause an out-of-bounds write, potentially resulting in a loss of platform integrity or denial of service.

CVE-2025-0043.description: Incorrect directory permissions within AMD Vivado™ Lab Solutions could allow a local user-privileged attacker to escalate their privileges, potentially resulting in arbitrary code execution.

CVE-2025-54507.description: Improper validation of consistency within input in AMD SEV (Secure Encrypted Virtualization) firmware could allow an attacker with administrative privileges to create multiple RMP entries for the same guest physical address, potentially resulting in loss of guest integrity.

CVE-2026-0455.description: The Versal™ AI Edge Series Gen 2 Peripheral Protection Unit (XPPU) for the inter-processor interrupt (IPI) buffers does not block unauthorized access as expected. This allows processors in the SoC with any IPI channel access the ability to both read and write to the entire IPI buffer register space as well as the IPI no-buffer register control space.

CVE-2026-0460.description: Improper authentication in Bootgen could result in the use of a fixed salt value for RSA padding instead of a randomly generated salt, potentially impacting data integrity.

CVE-2026-107152.description: An improper authentication vulnerability has been found in the task console in the smart_proxy_dynflow package. The console accepts any client certificate signed by the capsule's certificate authority. It does not check the list of servers the capsule trusts. A low-privileged network attacker or user must already hold such a certificate. They can open the console and read job details. Those details include passwords when a job was given them. They can also cancel a running task.

CVE-2026-107360.description: A flaw was found in rubygem-safemode. Compound assignment expressions in sandboxed code are evaluated without mediating method calls through the Jail allow-list. An authenticated attacker who can supply template content can invoke arbitrary no-argument methods on objects exposed to the template renderer without Jail mediation, including destructive operations such as host deletion and disclosure of non-allow-listed object state.
CVE-2026-107360.summary_ko: rubygem-safemode의 샌드박스에서 Jail 허용 목록을 우회할 수 있다. 템플릿 내용을 제공할 수 있는 인증된 공격자가 노출된 객체의 인자 없는 임의 메서드를 호출해 호스트를 삭제하거나 허용되지 않은 객체 상태를 노출할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-107360.background_ko: 샌드박스 코드의 복합 대입식을 평가할 때 메서드 호출에 Jail 허용 목록 검사를 적용하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-107443.description: A flaw was found in Foreman. An authenticated user with view_hosts privileges can retrieve rendered provisioning template content for a host via the hosts template API endpoint, disclosing sensitive data such as the host root password. This is an incomplete fix of CVE-2026-96659, which hardened the web UI preview path but left the API host-template render path authorized for Viewer-level users.
