CVE-2026-126403.description: Coder 2.26.0 before 2.29.24, 2.30.0 before 2.34.16, 2.35.0 before 2.36.11, 2.37.0 before 2.37.8, and 2.38.0 before 2.38.4 contains an improper authorization flaw in the external agent credentials endpoint, which returns the workspace agent token to users with only workspace read access rather than ssh permission. Authenticated users with roles such as Template Admin or Organization Admin can use the token to read the owner's private Git SSH key and Git provider OAuth tokens, and impersonate the agent to receive the owner's sessions.

CVE-2026-126404.description: Coder 2.28.0 before 2.29.24, 2.30.0 before 2.34.16, 2.35.0 before 2.36.11, 2.37.0 before 2.37.8, and 2.38.0 before 2.38.4 does not restrict new API keys to the creating token's scopes, allow list, or expiry. A scoped API key or OAuth2 token holding key-creation permission can call POST /api/v2/users/{user}/keys/tokens to mint longer-lived coder:all keys, gaining the user's full privileges.

CVE-2026-126405.description: Coder 2.21.0 before 2.29.24, 2.30.0 before 2.34.16, 2.35.0 before 2.36.11, 2.37.0 before 2.37.8, and 2.38.0 before 2.38.4 reads Web Push endpoint responses in webpushSend with io.ReadAll, without a size limit or client timeout. Any authenticated user can register a subscription via POST /api/v2/users/{user}/webpush/subscription pointing to a server returning an endless body, exhausting coderd memory and crashing the API, dashboard, and workspace connections.

CVE-2026-126406.description: The wasmtime-wasi-http p2 implementation in Wasmtime before 36.0.20, 37.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 can send conflicting content-length headers, or ones not matching the body, in outgoing requests. A guest that reuses a received response's headers resource to send a bodyless request can enable request smuggling against non-compliant servers, potentially bypassing embedder destination access controls.

CVE-2026-126407.description: Wasmtime before 36.0.20, 37.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 allocates untracked host memory when a component receives a borrow of a resource it defines itself, bypassing the per-store handle limit. A malicious guest component can repeatedly transfer such borrowed resources to consume arbitrary host memory, causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-126408.description: Wasmtime 47.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 contains an insufficient type-check in the TypedFunc embedder API for I31, Option<I31>, and Option<NoneRef> parameter or result types, reaching an unreachable!() path. A malicious guest module exporting a function that uses another anyref-hierarchy type can panic the host embedding, causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-126409.description: Wasmtime 47.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 contains a cross-engine type confusion vulnerability because StructType::with_finality_and_supertype does not validate that the supplied supertype belongs to the same Engine. Embedders using multiple engines that create a GC struct type with another engine's supertype can trigger runtime panics or GC heap corruption, causing denial of service; guest WebAssembly cannot trigger it.

CVE-2026-126410.description: Wasmtime's wasmtime-wasi crate 48.0.0 before 48.0.8, 49.0.0 before 49.0.5, and 50.0.0 before 50.0.1 contains a time-of-check/time-of-use race in the wasip3 wasi:sockets udp-socket host implementation that lets guests bypass socket_addr_check send restrictions. A malicious guest can race udp-socket.send against udp-socket.connect to deliver attacker-controlled datagrams to addresses the policy permits only for receiving.

CVE-2026-126411.description: Frappe HRMS 16.0.0 before 16.50.0 lacks authorization checks on certain HR workflow endpoints, letting authenticated users access records they are not permitted to view. Any logged-in user, including one with only the Employee role, can read candidate record details and employee email addresses, and cause emails to be sent to employees.

CVE-2026-126412.description: Frappe HRMS 15.0.0 before 15.64.1 and 16.0.0 before 16.19.0 lacks a write permission check on a bulk record processing action, allowing users with only read access to the related setup record to modify data. Authenticated users with the default Employee role can run the action to create and submit records for every covered employee.

CVE-2026-126413.description: Frappe HRMS 15.x before 15.64.1 and 16.x before 16.19.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an endpoint that returns file information, allowing authenticated users to read details of files attached to records they cannot access. Any logged-in user, including one with only the Employee role, can query it to view attachment details on any document type and confirm record existence.

CVE-2026-126414.description: Frappe HRMS 15.0.0 before 15.64.2 and 16.0.0 before 16.20.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in certain record update endpoints that lack an ownership check. Authenticated users with the Employee role can call these endpoints to modify records belonging to other employees, beyond their permitted role.

CVE-2026-126415.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Patient Validation module that allows any authenticated user to retrieve patient demographic records. Attackers can send direct requests with wildcard mf_lname or empty mf_ parameters to the patientvalidation endpoint to enumerate the entire patient_data table.

CVE-2026-126416.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in patient_tracker_status.php that allows low-privilege authenticated users to modify other patients' tracker entries by supplying arbitrary tracker_id values. Attackers can post statustype and roomnum parameters with a valid CSRF token to alter patient-flow status, room assignments, and linked calendar appointment state.

CVE-2026-126417.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an access control flaw in get_claim_file.php: with location=tmp, it serves any file in the shared temporary directory without verifying the file is a claim for the caller. Users with acct/eob or acct/bill write access can request key=ccda.xml to download the most recently validated patient's complete C-CDA clinical document.

CVE-2026-126418.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in interface/billing/sl_eob_invoice.php, which escapes billing codes for HTML attributes but not for JavaScript strings in an inline onkeyup handler. Clinicians with encounter coding access can save crafted billing codes through diagnosis.php that execute script when a Back Office user enters a payment, exposing patient and financial data or performing actions as that user.

CVE-2026-126419.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the esign_form_submit handler of library/ESign/Form/Controller.php that verifies only the caller's password, not access to the patient, encounter, or form type. Authenticated core users can supply arbitrary formId, formDir, and encounterId values to sign and lock any patient's clinical form, creating unauthorized approval records and blocking normal editing.

CVE-2026-126420.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the FaxSMS module's utility.php that allows read-only demographics users to create patient charts. Attackers can submit the form_create request with chosen identity fields to create fictitious or duplicate patients with employer, history, and insurance records.

CVE-2026-126421.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows authenticated users with patients/med access to exhaust PHP workers via an unbounded count parameter. Attackers can send print_labels requests to labs_ajax.php with huge counts, forcing mPDF page and barcode generation that makes OpenEMR unavailable.

CVE-2026-126422.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in library/ajax/lists_touch.php that allows restricted authenticated users to mark another patient's clinical lists as reviewed. Attackers can submit arbitrary patient_id and type values to falsely record "None known" allergy, medication, or problem lists, misleading clinicians and skewing quality-measure calculations.

CVE-2026-126423.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in four ZIP upload paths that read uncompressed entries into memory without size or ratio checks. Authenticated billing or Carecoordination users can upload highly compressed ZIP archives to exhaust PHP memory and worker pools, making OpenEMR unavailable.

CVE-2026-126424.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows users with admin/superbill write permission to inject HTML into SNOMED code descriptions via superbill_custom_full.php. When a clinician selects the malicious code, the Functional and Cognitive Status form or fee-sheet forms assign it to innerHTML, executing JavaScript in the clinician's session to read patient data and perform actions.

CVE-2026-126425.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored SQL injection vulnerability in which History layout field identifiers saved through edit_layout.php, including HIS fields and LBF source-H fields, are placed unvalidated into an INSERT statement for patients without a history_data row. Users with admin/super and patients/med write access can trigger history_save.php or LBF saves to execute SQL functions like SLEEP, tying up database workers or accessing data beyond their privileges.

CVE-2026-126426.description: OpenEMR 5.0.2 before 8.5.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in mfa_registrations.php and mfa_u2f.php that allows session hijackers to delete MFA factors or register U2F keys without password re-entry. Attackers holding a victim's authenticated session can remove all second factors or add their own U2F key, bypassing MFA at later logins with the password.

CVE-2026-126427.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a session expiration vulnerability that prevents automatic logoff because the Eye Exam form's read-only poll omits skip_timeout_reset. Attackers with physical access to an unattended workstation can use the still-active session to view patient health information, since update_READONLY() resets the idle timer every 15 seconds.

CVE-2026-126428.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows authenticated billing users to store attacker-controlled PHP by uploading a malformed ERA file to era_payments.php. Attackers with a database-write primitive such as SQL injection can register a background_services row whose require_once loads the stored .edi file, executing PHP as the web-server user.

CVE-2026-126429.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 passes authenticated user-controlled HTML from the doc_lib.php content parameter to mPDF, which resolves local files and nested SVG resources. Authenticated patients or core users can submit crafted CSS imports or php://filter SVG references to read arbitrary server files including credentials and OAuth keys.

CVE-2026-126430.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows any authenticated core user to inject SQL by supplying crafted patient_data field names to the CCR revandapprove controller. Attackers can embed scalar subqueries in the UPDATE patient_data SET clause to read staff password hashes and portal reset values, alter arbitrary patient demographics, and take over patient-portal accounts.

CVE-2026-126431.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a second-order sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated Carecoordination users to store malicious C-CDA field identifiers through the savedata action. Attackers can inject SQL into the IN clause built by fetchFormValues() during C-CDA generation to extract password hashes, portal reset values, and patient records.

CVE-2026-126432.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in interface/orders/list_reports.php that allows read-only users to transmit lab orders because the patients/med check ignores write permission. Authenticated attackers can submit form_xmit with arbitrary procedure order IDs to send HL7 orders containing SSNs, insurance, and diagnoses to laboratories and mark them transmitted.

CVE-2026-126433.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in interface/drugs/dispense_drug.php, which checks only for admin/drugs view permission instead of write permission before dispensing medication. Authenticated users with read-only drug administration access can send GET requests with drug_id, quantity, fee, and encounter parameters to create false dispensing records and decrement inventory.

CVE-2026-126434.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in interface/forms/procedure_order/common.php that allows authenticated accounts lacking patients/lab permission to read and modify other patients' procedure orders. Attackers can request a global order id to disclose clinical history, or select the target patient in their session and submit bn_save to falsify diagnoses, instructions, and order status.

CVE-2026-126435.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in interface/orders/order_manifest.php, which checks patients/med without requiring write access or applying patient squad restrictions. Users with only patients/med view permission can request any order ID to read squad-restricted patient data and submit bn_save and form_omit parameters, without a CSRF token, to set do_not_send flags that suppress ordered lab procedures.

CVE-2026-126436.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows OAuth2 clients to use unregistered grant types because oauth_clients.grant_types is never enforced. Attackers can request tokens with grant_type=password to bypass the user consent screen, and disabled clients can redeem authorization codes using JWT client assertions.

CVE-2026-126437.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in portal/lib/download_template.php that allows any authenticated core user to render documents for arbitrary patients by setting isModule. Attackers can submit arbitrary pid and template_id values to disclose patient names, birth dates, chart IDs, addresses, allergies, medications, and problem lists despite ACL and squad restrictions.

CVE-2026-126438.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in interface/patient_file/rules/patient_data.php that allows read-only patients/med users to modify clinical-rule records. Attackers can submit a global form_entryID row ID to overwrite completion date, state, and result, including records of patients outside their configured squad.

CVE-2026-126439.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in ccdaservice/ccda_gateway.php that fails to enforce the patients/pat_rep permission, accepting any authenticated core session. Authenticated users without patient-report permission can request the report_ccd_view action to retrieve the selected patient's C-CDA clinical summary, including diagnoses, medications, laboratory results, and identifiers.

CVE-2026-126440.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization flaw in the Care Coordination CCDA and CCR import controllers, which move a document named by the document_id parameter into the import category without checking access to the source document. Authenticated non-administrators with Care Coordination access can recategorize protected patient documents and then download them through normal ACL-checked retrieval.

CVE-2026-126441.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the CAMOS rx_print.php printer that allows authenticated users to read other patients' prescriptions. Attackers can submit forged chrx_ parameters with global prescription IDs to disclose drug names, dosages, directions, and refill counts without medication permissions.

CVE-2026-126442.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in create_portallogin.php that allows low-privilege authenticated users to replace patient portal credentials without ACL checks. Attackers can select a victim patient in session and post replacement credentials to take over portal accounts, read PHI, and lock patients out.

CVE-2026-126443.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in dynamic_finder_ajax.php that allows authenticated users without patients/demo permission to query patient demographics. Attackers can supply arbitrary patient_data columns via the sColumns parameter to enumerate names, dates of birth, contact details, and Social Security numbers across the practice.

CVE-2026-126444.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Ensora eRx integration that allows authenticated staff without patients/rx permission to access prescription data by directly requesting eRx.php. Attackers can expose selected patients' demographic, medication, and allergy data in the vendor XML and trigger eRx synchronization state changes.

CVE-2026-126445.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated core user to modify arbitrary Patient Flow Board trackers without the patients/appt permission. Attackers can submit a victim tracker_id to patient_tracker_status.php or drug_screen_completed.php to falsify check-in status, rooms, drug-screen completion, and tracker history.

CVE-2026-126446.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated core user to retrieve destroyed-drug records because destroyed_drugs_report.php lacks the admin/drugs or inventory/reporting ACL check. Attackers can submit the report refresh form with a chosen date range to obtain drug names, NDC, lots, quantities, destruction methods, witnesses, and notes.

CVE-2026-126447.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in trusted-messages-ajax.php that allows any authenticated core user to send Direct messages without the patients/notes permission. Attackers with zero-ACL accounts can submit chosen recipients and message bodies sent via the clinic's phiMail credentials, impersonating the clinic to deliver fraudulent clinical communications.

CVE-2026-126448.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users lacking nationnotes/nn_configure to modify shared Nation Notes templates by calling mutation endpoints directly. Attackers can send requests to ajax_code.php or add_context.php, which lack ACL and CSRF checks, to tamper with clinical-note templates and assignments.

CVE-2026-126449.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in immunizations.php, diagnosis_full.php, and billing_process.php that lets low-privileged users bypass ACL checks. Authenticated Front Office users can reuse their session CSRF token to add or delete immunizations, write encounter billing codes, and invoke the billing processor.

CVE-2026-126450.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject scripts by placing payloads in the patient External ID field. The payload executes when other users open the patient's prescriptions via View Printable Version (HTML), running script in their browser sessions.

CVE-2026-126451.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows portal patients to run JavaScript in staff sessions by injecting javascript: URLs into document template_data. Attackers can submit an encounterForm value rendered unsanitized into an iframe src by DocumentTemplateRender, letting the script read PHI and CSRF tokens and call staff or admin endpoints.

CVE-2026-126452.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in diagnosis_full.php that allows authenticated users to delete or clear any billing record by ID. Attackers can supply a target billing ID in the id parameter with delete or clear mode to deactivate other patients' charges and corrupt financial records.

CVE-2026-126453.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an inverted comparison in Document::has_expired() that causes the FHIR Binary download endpoint to treat time-limited PHI documents as unexpired after their one-hour lifetime. Authenticated users still authorized for a Binary/{id} resource can download expired bulk export NDJSON files and $docref CCDs indefinitely.

CVE-2026-126454.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 lacks rate limiting or lockout on TOTP submission, allowing attackers with a valid password to brute-force the 6-digit MFA code. Attackers can script repeated POST requests to main_screen.php or the OAuth2 authorization flow with re-submitted hidden credentials to bypass two-factor authentication.

CVE-2026-126455.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains multiple missing authorization and SQL injection defects across report, portal, transaction, and immunization components. Low-privileged Front Office clerks can chain these to read arbitrary database tables including users_secure hashes, hijack patient portal identities, and forge approved clinical records.

CVE-2026-126456.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Fee Sheet notecodes field, which is escaped with the wrong context. Attackers with clinician access can inject a payload that breaks out of the single-quoted value attribute and executes in higher-privileged users' browsers.

CVE-2026-126457.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in InstallerController that allows any authenticated user to modify module administration settings without the admin/manage_modules permission. Low-privileged users such as Front Office clerks can POST to saveConfig, DeleteAcl, DeleteHooks and nickName actions to reconfigure or partially disable installed modules.

CVE-2026-126458.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in authorizations_full.php that allows any authenticated staff user to authorize arbitrary patients' clinical records. Attackers can send a mode=authorize request with an attacker-chosen pid and their own CSRF token to set authorized=1 on billing, forms, pnotes, and transactions records, bypassing provider review.

CVE-2026-126460.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a persistent SQL injection vulnerability in SLEOB::slInvoiceNumber(), where the CLP01 claim control number from uploaded X12 835 ERA files is concatenated unescaped into a query. Attackers with billing write access can upload a crafted .edi file via sl_eob_search.php that is stored on the server and re-executes a time-based payload whenever it is reprocessed through sl_eob_process.php, extracting patient health information.

CVE-2026-126461.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in library/ajax/user_settings.php that lets any authenticated user persist arbitrary global configuration overrides. Attackers can POST global:-prefixed keys to re-point external service hosts like CouchDB, eRx, phiMail, or SMTP to attacker-controlled servers, exfiltrating system credentials and patient PHI.

CVE-2026-126462.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users with Eye Exam edit permission to inject scripts via the Next Visit Orders PLAN[] field. Attackers can store a payload closing the textarea in view.php, executing JavaScript when another user opens the Eye Exam editor to steal session identifiers or clinical data.

CVE-2026-126463.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains multiple sql injection vulnerabilities that allow authenticated users to inject payloads through ERA CLP01, form_facility, form_icd_codes, and POST key names. Attackers can perform UNION, blind, and error-based injection to read users_secure password hashes and patient PHI, and overwrite patient_data fields.

CVE-2026-126464.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in PatientPortalPDFDocumentCreator::createPdfObject() that allows authenticated patients to make the server issue HTTP GET requests. Attackers can submit img src, inline style url(), or reinserted unpurified style blocks via the content parameter of portal/lib/doc_lib.php to probe internal ports and cloud metadata endpoints.

CVE-2026-126465.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the patient portal api/onsiteactivityviews endpoint that allows any authenticated staff user to inject SQL through unquoted Id_BitwiseAnd Criteria values. Attackers can close the bitwise parenthesis and append OR or UNION SELECT clauses to read patient PHI, staff password hashes, MySQL authentication strings, and API tokens.

CVE-2026-126466.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to create patient records and enumerate patients by omitting aclCheckCore() checks. Attackers can POST to new_comprehensive_save.php to create patients with insurance PHI, or query new_search_popup.php and patient_select.php to leak names, SSNs and DOBs.

CVE-2026-126467.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a mass assignment vulnerability in ObservationController::processEnhancedFormSave() that allows authenticated low-privilege users to forge authorization flags through an incomplete field blacklist. Attackers can submit authorized=1 or override the id field alongside observation_id to mark observations as Provider-signed and overwrite clinical fields of other observations within the same patient encounter.

CVE-2026-126468.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated low-privilege user to access reports, dated reminders, and batch reminder endpoints lacking AclMain::aclCheckCore() checks. Attackers can request patient_list.php, amc_full_report.php, dated_reminders_add.php, or batch_reminders.php directly to export patient PHI, send unauthorized reminders, and trigger batch reminder processing.

CVE-2026-126469.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in several custom/ scripts that rely only on session authentication and never call AclMain::aclCheckCore(). Any authenticated low-privilege user can request export_labworks.php, chart_tracker.php, or export_registry_xml.php to disclose patient SSN, DOB, and insurance data or provider NPI/tax IDs, and forge chart-tracker records.

CVE-2026-126470.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the Carecoordination module that allows authenticated users with send_to_hie permission to access any patient's CCDA/CCR/QRDA documents. Attackers can supply arbitrary document or patient IDs to download, transmit, or export patient health records, inject falsified clinical data, and delete audit records.

CVE-2026-126471.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in print_referral.php and trend_form.php that allows low-privileged Front Office users to access patient PHI without patients:med permission. Attackers can directly request these endpoints with arbitrary patient_id values to retrieve patient demographics, insurance data, and vitals history, enumerating IDs to expand disclosure.

CVE-2026-126472.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in ccdaservice/ccda_gateway.php that allows any authenticated low-privilege staff user to retrieve other patients' C-CDA documents. Attackers can request the view or dl action with sequential pid values and their own CSRF token to enumerate and exfiltrate medications, problems, allergies, and immunizations.

CVE-2026-126473.description: OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains OAuth scope canonicalization and containment flaws that allow unauthenticated attackers to obtain unapproved system-level FHIR access. Attackers can register a colon-form system:Patient.read client that bypasses approval, then request unregistered system/Patient.write scope to read, modify, and create Patient records.

CVE-2026-126474.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in the ACL module that allows attackers to execute JavaScript in authenticated sessions via the module_id parameter. Attackers can deliver crafted acl/index or acl/acl links that inject unencoded input into inline script blocks, stealing non-HttpOnly session cookies and modifying ACL configuration.

CVE-2026-126475.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to execute JavaScript by injecting payloads into the searchEleNo POST parameter of the application/index/search endpoint. Attackers can break out of unencoded HTML attributes in auto-suggest.phtml to inject event handlers that fire on DOM insertion, stealing non-HttpOnly session cookies and patient data.

CVE-2026-126476.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Application module's auto-suggest endpoint, which echoes the searchMode POST parameter unencoded into a single-quoted onClick attribute. Attackers can induce an authenticated user to submit a single-quote payload to application/index/search, executing arbitrary JavaScript in that user's session to steal session cookies or disclose patient data.

CVE-2026-126477.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Eye Exam (eye_mag) module that allows administrators to inject JavaScript through unencoded Eye_defaults list option titles. Attackers can store a crafted title via edit_list.php that breaks out of a jQuery string in eye_base.php, executing script in any authenticated user's session when they click Defaults.

CVE-2026-126478.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the Syndromic Surveillance report because the form_icd_codes[] POST array is concatenated into an unquoted numeric IN() clause without integer validation. Authenticated users can submit quote-free payloads that bypass add_escape_custom to perform blind or UNION-based injection and exfiltrate patient health information.

CVE-2026-126479.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in five Module Manager InstallerController actions that lack the admin/manage_modules ACL check and CSRF validation. Low-privilege users such as Front Office accounts can POST to saveConfig or SaveHooks to overwrite any module's configuration, retarget CCDA and HIE settings, and delete module hooks.

CVE-2026-126480.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability in CcrTable::insertApprovedData() that allows authenticated users to inject SQL through request parameter names used as column names. Attackers can send crafted patient_data-*-sel parameters to the revandapprove route, lacking ACL and CSRF checks, to copy password hashes into patient fields or corrupt records.

CVE-2026-126481.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in era_payments.php and sl_eob_search.php that allows authenticated billing users to write files outside the ERA directory. Attackers can embed traversal sequences in the GS04 element of an uploaded X12 835 file to overwrite .edi or .835 files with attacker-controlled content anywhere writable by the web server.

CVE-2026-126482.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in SLEOB::slInvoiceNumber() in src/Billing/SLEOB.php, which concatenates the CLP01 claim identifier from uploaded X12 835 ERA files into a query without escaping or parameter binding. Authenticated users with billing permissions, or a malicious payer whose ERA file a clerk uploads, can execute arbitrary SQL to read any table, including users_secure password hashes, and modify data.

CVE-2026-126483.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated report users to manipulate queries by supplying a crafted form_facility value to interface/reports/ippf_statistics.php. Attackers can close the string literal in the facility_id WHERE clause and use boolean or time-based payloads to read sensitive database contents.

CVE-2026-126484.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in printed_fee_sheet.php that allows authenticated portal patients to inject script by setting unescaped appointment comments (pc_hometext). Attackers can submit HTML payloads via the form_comments field in add_edit_event_user.php that execute when staff open the patient's fee sheet, acting within the staff session.

CVE-2026-126485.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in ObservationController::deleteAction that allows attackers to delete observation form records without a CSRF token. Attackers can lure a logged-in clinician to a page issuing a GET to delete.php with guessed id values, soft-deleting observations in the victim's open encounter.

CVE-2026-126486.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in portal/import_template.php, where several portal document template modes lack admin/forms ACL and CSRF checks. Any authenticated staff user can send mode=save_profiles to delete all template profile assignments, use other unguarded modes to push templates to patients or change categories, and read template bodies via mode=get or getPdf.

CVE-2026-126487.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to override system-wide global configuration values by storing global-prefixed keys through library/ajax/user_settings.php. Attackers can submit lab or target parameters with global: prefixed setting names to disable audit logging, weaken password policies, or alter security-sensitive settings persistently for their sessions.

CVE-2026-126488.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the patient portal OnsiteDocument.Query endpoint, where mass-assigned _BitwiseAnd criteria parameters are placed unquoted into SQL with only quote-character escaping. Authenticated portal patients can inject SQL outside their per-patient scope to read the entire database, including other patients' demographics and users_secure password hashes.

CVE-2026-126489.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a second-order SQL injection vulnerability in the IPPF contraceptive issue feature because issue_ippf_con_save concatenates layout_options field_id values into a REPLACE INTO query as column names. Authenticated administrators can add a malicious field_id via edit_layout.php, then trigger issue_ippf_con_save through add_edit_issue.php to execute arbitrary SQL.

CVE-2026-126490.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains active debug code in interface/fax/fax_view.php that executes passthru("groups") and discloses the web server's Unix group memberships. Authenticated attackers with fax module access can supply a nonexistent jid value to reveal groups such as adm or shadow, aiding privilege escalation planning.

CVE-2026-126491.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored SQL injection vulnerability in getByPatientDemographics() where layout_options field_id values are concatenated into the patient search WHERE clause. Attackers with Layout Editor access can plant a malicious field_id, allowing any authenticated low-privilege user to exfiltrate data from patient_data and users_secure tables.

CVE-2026-126492.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a second-order sql injection vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to store malicious SQL via library/ajax/addlistitem.php. Attackers can persist a SQL fragment in the recent_patient_columns option_id value, which dynamic_finder.php concatenates into a SELECT query and executes as SQL.

CVE-2026-126493.description: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows low-privileged patient portal users to inject JavaScript via the tableArgs field of the onsiteportalactivity API. Attackers can store a payload with spaces that breaks out of an unquoted data-delete-id attribute, executing script when providers click the delete button on the audit review page.

CVE-2026-126494.description: OpenEMR before 8.4.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in ScopeRepository::finalizeScopes() that allows read-only SMART/OAuth clients to obtain write scopes because ScopeEntity::containsScope() ignores registered permissions. Attackers with a client registered for user/<resource>.read can request user/<resource>.write to create, update, and delete appointments or patient data.

CVE-2026-126936.description: Zipline before 4.7.0 contains a race condition vulnerability that allows users to bypass invitation usage limits, upload storage quotas, and shortened-URL quotas through concurrent requests. Attackers can send overlapping registration, upload, or URL creation requests that pass checks against stale state, creating extra accounts and exceeding administrator-configured resource quotas.

CVE-2026-126937.description: Zipline before 4.6.5 contains a TOCTOU race condition in the POST /api/setup endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to create multiple SUPERADMIN accounts by racing concurrent requests before the firstSetup flag is reset. Attackers can send simultaneous requests with spoofed X-Forwarded-For headers during the argon2 hashing window to gain full administrative control of the instance.

CVE-2026-126938.description: Zipline before 4.6.4 contains a resource allocation vulnerability that allows authenticated users to bypass chunked-upload size and quota checks by forging Content-Range offsets and totals. Attackers can send tiny chunks to the partial upload endpoint with large declared offsets, causing the server to create oversized files and exhaust disk space.

CVE-2026-126939.description: Zipline before 4.6.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in GET /api/server/folder/:id that allows unauthenticated attackers to list files in non-public upload-only folders. Attackers who know the folder UUID can supply the page query parameter to bypass the metadata-only early return and enumerate file names, IDs, MIME types, sizes, and view counts.

CVE-2026-126940.description: Zipline before 4.6.4 contains a rate limit bypass vulnerability that allows remote attackers to evade request limits by varying query strings or supplying the x-zipline-p-filename header. Attackers can append differing query parameters to login and file or short-link password verification endpoints to perform credential guessing beyond the intended rate limits.

CVE-2026-126941.description: Zipline through 4.6.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to read superadmin secrets because GET /api/users and GET /api/users/:id lack the canInteract check. Attackers can retrieve plaintext totpSecret and OAuth tokens to bypass 2FA and take over superadmin accounts, while any authenticated user can enumerate other users' folders via GET /api/user/folders.

CVE-2026-126942.description: Zipline before 4.6.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in POST /api/user/folders that allows authenticated users to reparent other users' files by supplying their file IDs. Attackers can harvest file IDs from public folders and create a folder seeded with them, disclosing victims' file URLs and removing those files from their folder views.

CVE-2026-126943.description: Zipline from 4.2.0 before 4.6.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that logs sensitive environment variable values, such as OAUTH_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET, without redaction at startup. Attackers with access to system journal or docker logs can obtain OAuth2 client secrets and use them to exchange intercepted OAuth2 callbacks for valid tokens.

CVE-2026-126944.description: Zipline before 4.6.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability in LocalDatasource that allows SUPERADMIN users to read or delete files outside the upload directory by importing records with traversal filenames. Attackers can trigger the unchecked range-read path with byte-range requests or set expired deletion times to delete files accessible to the Zipline process.

CVE-2026-126945.description: Zipline before 4.5.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the HighlightCode component that renders unescaped file content before highlight.js finishes loading. Authenticated attackers can upload text files containing HTML/JavaScript payloads that execute in viewers' browsers, enabling API calls such as account changes on the victim's behalf.

CVE-2026-126946.description: Zipline from 4.3.0 before 4.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privilege users to inject HTML through unescaped embed settings in SSR meta tags. Attackers can set malicious embedTitle, embedDescription, embedSiteName, or embedColor values via PATCH /api/user to execute JavaScript in browsers of visitors opening their file view pages.

CVE-2026-126947.description: Zipline before 4.5.0 contains a stored open redirect vulnerability that allows authenticated users to set arbitrary short URL destinations by abusing missing scheme validation in POST /api/user/urls. Attackers can store javascript: URIs or attacker-controlled URLs as destinations, causing visitors of the trusted short link to be redirected to phishing or malware pages.

CVE-2026-126948.description: Zipline before 4.5.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability caused by missing ownership verification in the PATCH and DELETE handlers for /api/user/folders/:id. Authenticated attackers can supply another user's folder ID to rename it, make it public, enable uploads, or delete it.

CVE-2026-126949.description: Zipline through 4.4.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the PATCH /api/user/files/:id rename endpoint that allows authenticated users to overwrite existing uploads by supplying unsanitized names. Attackers can submit names like ../uploads/victim.txt that bypass the raw-string database uniqueness check but normalize via path.join(), causing fs.rename() to replace other files' contents.

CVE-2026-126950.description: Zipline through 4.4.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to delete arbitrary server files by injecting traversal sequences via the x-zipline-file-extension header. Attackers can upload a file with a poisoned stored name and short expiry so LocalDatasource deletion removes chosen files, causing denial of service or data loss.

CVE-2026-126951.description: Zipline through 4.4.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read arbitrary server files by abusing a fallback treating the :id parameter as a datasource key. Attackers can send encoded traversal sequences in the :id of GET /api/user/files/:id/raw to escape the Local datasource uploads directory and read files like /etc/shadow.

CVE-2026-126952.description: Zipline through 4.4.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the WebAuthn login endpoint that creates sessions for a supplied registered credential ID without verifying the assertion. Attackers who obtain a target's passkey credential ID can impersonate that account without its authenticator, potentially gaining administrative control over SUPERADMIN accounts.

CVE-2026-126953.description: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows a malicious or compromised ACS to execute commands as root by supplying an unvalidated InternetGatewayDevice.User.{i}.Username value. Attackers can send a SetParameterValues request with shell metacharacters that set_UserUsername() in obuspa_system.lua passes to os.execute(), gaining root command execution.

CVE-2026-126954.description: Glance from 0.7.9 before 0.8.8 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows malicious extension endpoints to inject javascript: URLs via the Widget-Title-URL response header. Attackers controlling an extension endpoint can execute script when users click the widget title, reading dashboard pages through same-origin requests and exfiltrating content.

CVE-2026-126955.description: Glance from 0.8.0 before 0.8.8 contains an observable response discrepancy in handlePageRequest and handlePageContentRequest that allows unauthenticated attackers to enumerate configured page slugs. Attackers can request candidate names against /{page} or /api/pages/{page}/content/ and compare 303/401 versus 404 status codes to discover hidden page names.

CVE-2026-127073.description: OpsTree BuildPiper before 2.7.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows project users to gain Kubernetes cluster-admin rights by submitting unrestricted manifests through the Additional Manifest feature. Attackers can deploy a ClusterRoleBinding binding a service account to cluster-admin, which the pipeline applies with cluster-wide credentials, granting control over all workloads and secrets.

CVE-2026-127074.description: OpsTree BuildPiper before 2.7.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users with build configuration permission to read files on the build worker by supplying unvalidated dockerfile_path and build context values. Attackers can set traversal or absolute paths such as /etc/passwd via the CI configuration endpoint, then trigger a build to disclose file contents in the build log.

CVE-2026-127075.description: OpsTree BuildPiper before 2.7.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read arbitrary files by supplying traversal sequences in Additional Manifest file paths. Attackers can enter paths like ../../../../etc/passwd so the renderer embeds file contents in generated manifests and logs, exposing configuration files and service-account tokens.

CVE-2026-127076.description: OpsTree BuildPiper before 2.7.0 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows authenticated users to list and build from Git repositories restricted to other projects. Attackers can enumerate repositories via GET /api/v1/git_repo/?all=true and submit any git_repo_id to the ci endpoint, cloning other projects' source code, manifests, and committed secrets.

CVE-2026-127077.description: OpsTree BuildPiper before 2.7.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to create environments on unassigned Kubernetes clusters by tampering with cluster_id and namespaces values. Attackers can modify requests to POST /api/v1/project/{project_id}/env/ to target another project's cluster, then trigger builds and deployments into it, bypassing project isolation.

CVE-2026-127078.description: OpsTree BuildPiper before 2.7.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to attach another application's environment to their service by supplying a foreign project_env_id. Attackers can configure CI and trigger builds and deployments through the component env endpoints using the other application's configuration, registries and deployment infrastructure.

CVE-2026-127079.description: OpsTree BuildPiper before 2.7.0 lacks rate limiting on password-reset OTP verification, allowing unauthenticated attackers to brute force 6-digit OTPs. Attackers can initiate a reset and submit unthrottled guesses to the check_otp endpoint, resetting the target's password and taking over the account.

CVE-2026-127080.description: OpsTree BuildPiper before 2.7.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated deploy users to define arbitrary Kubernetes hostPath volumes without allow-list or policy checks. Attackers can set the host path to / in the Define HostPath Volume configuration to mount the worker node root filesystem read-write, breaking container isolation and enabling node and cluster compromise.

CVE-2026-127081.description: OpsTree BuildPiper before 2.7.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to link pipeline stages to environments of other projects by supplying a foreign project_env_id. Attackers can submit another project's environment identifier to the POST /api/v1/pipeline/{pipeline_id}/stages/ endpoint, persisting cross-project associations that bypass project separation.

CVE-2026-127082.description: Huginn before 2026.11.09 contains an information exposure vulnerability in JqAgent that allows authenticated users to read the server process environment because the jq child process inherits it. Attackers who can create, configure or dry-run a JqAgent can supply a filter using env or $ENV to disclose APP_SECRET_TOKEN, database, SMTP and OAuth secrets.

CVE-2026-127083.description: Huginn from 2026.09.09 before 2026.11.09 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability because OutboundProxy.configure! applies the egress proxy only to Faraday and Typhoeus. Authenticated users can configure JiraAgent or WeiboPublishAgent to send HTTParty, open-uri or Net::HTTP requests directly to internal services, with JiraAgent returning response data as events.

CVE-2026-127084.description: Teable before 2026-10-12T12-45-53Z.3331 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to upload SVG or HTML attachments with an attacker-chosen content type. Attackers can send the same-origin /api/attachments/read URL, served inline with an empty Content-Security-Policy, to run script with the victim's session and perform API actions.

CVE-2026-127085.description: Ryot before 10.5.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to remove entries from other users' collections by supplying arbitrary collectionName and creatorUserId values. Attackers can obtain user ids from the usersList query and target fixed collection names like Watchlist to delete collection_to_entity rows belonging to other users.

CVE-2026-127086.description: Ryot before 10.5.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to take over other users' collections by supplying an updateId to the createOrUpdateCollection GraphQL mutation. Attackers who know a collection id can trigger ownership reassignment without checks, read its items, rewrite metadata, and evict the original owner and collaborators.

CVE-2026-127087.description: Ryot before 10.5.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to revoke other users' access links by supplying an arbitrary accessLinkId. Attackers can obtain access link ids from public share URLs and revoke them without ownership checks, breaking shared access for all link users.

CVE-2026-127088.description: 2FAuth before 9.0.1 contains a weak password recovery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to poison reset links by forging the HTTP Host header. Attackers can request password or WebAuthn recovery emails with an attacker-controlled host, capture the victim's token, and take over accounts exposing stored TOTP/HOTP secrets.

CVE-2026-127090.description: Jadaptive Maverick Synergy Server before 3.0.33 and 3.1.x before 3.1.7, and Maverick Legacy Server before 1.8.1, contain an authentication bypass vulnerability in SSH public key authentication that reuses cached key authorization decisions across usernames. Attackers holding a key authorized for one account can authenticate it, then send a signed SSH_MSG_USERAUTH_REQUEST with a different username on the same connection to log in as that account.

CVE-2026-127091.description: Jadaptive Maverick Synergy Server before 3.0.33 and 3.1.x before 3.1.7, and Maverick Legacy Server before 1.8.1, contain an improper path equivalence flaw in VirtualFileFactory.canonicalisePath that bypasses mount-level access policy. Authenticated users can supply paths with duplicate separators or dot segments to route operations to a less restrictive parent mount and read or write files the child mount denies.

CVE-2026-127092.description: BuildAdmin 1.0.1 through 2.3.9 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to store javascript: URLs in the admin operation log via the X-Rewrite-URL header. When an administrator clicks the log entry's url open button, the script runs in the backend origin and steals the adminInfo token from localStorage, enabling account takeover.

CVE-2026-127093.description: Rustrak before 0.26.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows users with integrations update permission to send requests to arbitrary destinations by supplying routing_override.url to POST /api/integrations/{id}/test. Attackers can target loopback, private-network and cloud metadata addresses with custom headers and redirects followed, reading non-2xx response bodies returned in the API response.

CVE-2026-127094.description: Pagelayer 2.1.7 before 2.2.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in Abilities API abilities registered in main/abilitiesregister.php that only require the edit_posts capability. Contributor-level attackers can overwrite, publish, delete, or duplicate other users' private posts and pages to read them, and modify site-wide theme templates like headers and footers.

CVE-2026-128014.description: FrankenPHP standalone static binaries 1.8.0 before 1.13.2 bundle the PHP brotli extension statically linked with Brotli 1.2.0, whose decoder contains an out-of-bounds write (CVE-2026-111497). Unauthenticated remote attackers can send crafted data to applications that pass it to brotli_uncompress_add() to crash the entire FrankenPHP process, and possibly cause memory disclosure or code execution.

CVE-2026-128015.description: FrankenPHP before 1.13.4 contains a use-after-free vulnerability that leaves a dangling pointer to a freed environment table when putenv() is called during request shutdown. Attackers triggering putenv() in shutdown functions, destructors, or session handlers can crash the process on the next getenv() call or leak previous request environment values.

CVE-2026-128016.description: FrankenPHP before 1.13.4 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in worker mode that frees internal streams of SplTempFileObject or SplFileObject on php://temp instances surviving across requests. Remote clients can send requests reaching code that uses such persisted objects, causing reads of freed memory that leak garbage data or crash the process.

CVE-2026-128017.description: FrankenPHP before 1.13.4 contains a double free vulnerability in worker mode that frees SG(request_info).content_type_dup twice when a worker script ends its loop after a non-form POST request. Unauthenticated attackers can send repeated JSON POST requests until the worker loop ends, aborting the whole process when USE_ZEND_ALLOC=0 is set.

CVE-2026-128018.description: FrankenPHP before 1.13.4 contains a denial of service vulnerability in worker mode where frankenphp_handle_request() returns false without finishing the dequeued request after a fatal error during request startup. Attackers who trigger startup fatal errors against worker scripts that keep calling frankenphp_handle_request() can leave client requests hanging indefinitely while the worker continues running.

CVE-2026-128019.description: FrankenPHP before 1.13.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in worker mode that leaks per-request environment variables into later requests on the same PHP thread. Attackers can read values set via env directives with request placeholders or WithRequestEnv() through getenv() or $_SERVER, causing applications to act on another user's routing, tenant, or authorization values.

CVE-2026-128020.description: FrankenPHP before 1.13.2 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in its PHP-to-Go array converter that fails to detect circular references in PHP arrays. Passing a self-referential array to frankenphp_log() or returning one from a worker callback triggers a fatal Go stack overflow, terminating the entire server process.

CVE-2026-128021.description: FrankenPHP before 1.13.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows later clients to read earlier clients' libxml errors because worker mode never resets LIBXML(error_list) between requests. Attackers sending requests to the same worker thread can call libxml_get_errors() or libxml_get_last_error() to obtain other clients' parsed-document fragments and server filesystem paths.

CVE-2026-128022.description: FrankenPHP before 1.13.2 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows unauthenticated clients to tie up PHP threads because queued requests are not cancelled when clients disconnect. Attackers can send many requests and close connections immediately, forcing handleRequestWithRegularPHPThreads and worker handlers to execute them and delay all clients sharing the thread pool.

CVE-2026-128023.description: FrankenPHP before 1.13.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to spoof trusted headers by sending dot-form header names that PHP rewrites to underscores. Attackers can send headers like X.Authenticated.User or X.Forwarded.For that map to $_SERVER keys, spoofing user identity, client IP, or scheme.

CVE-2026-128024.description: FrankenPHP before 1.13.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in goArray() that allows remote attackers to abort the server process via arrays with null integer-keyed elements. Attackers can send crafted JSON passed to frankenphp_log() or returned from worker callbacks, triggering an unrecovered cgo panic that terminates every vhost and in-flight request.

CVE-2026-128025.description: FrankenPHP before 1.13.0 contains a path-split interpretation conflict in splitPos in cgi.go that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute protected PHP scripts by embedding .php inside a filename component. Attackers can request paths like /uploads/a.php.txt/b.php to execute uploads/a.php despite route-level or WAF deny rules and forge PATH_INFO, SCRIPT_NAME, and PHP_SELF values.

CVE-2026-128026.description: FrankenPHP from 1.5.0 before 1.13.0 contains an incomplete environment sandbox vulnerability in which putenv writes to the process-wide OS environment via os.Setenv, leaking values across concurrent requests. Attackers reaching a request path that spawns child processes with the default environment through proc_open or exec can read secrets such as database passwords set by other requests.

CVE-2026-128027.description: FrankenPHP Docker images before 1.1.11 were rebuilt only when new base image tags were created, so security fixes that Alpine, PHP, and Go applied under existing tags were not propagated. Remote attackers could exploit known flaws in the stale system libraries, such as CVE-2025-15467 in libcrypto3, to execute code.

CVE-2026-128028.description: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Mage_Catalog_Model_Product_Option_Type_File, which accepts guest SVG, XHTML, or XML uploads through product File custom options with an empty allowed-extension list. Unauthenticated attackers can send the file URL under media/custom_options/ to victims, executing script in the store origin and exposing administrator sessions when the admin panel shares that origin.

CVE-2026-128029.description: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Dataflow profile run page, which inserts catalog product import row errors into the page without escaping. Unauthenticated attackers can place markup in the store, type, or attribute_set columns of an import file to run script in the session of the administrator who imports it.

CVE-2026-128030.description: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains an insufficient session expiration vulnerability because Mage_Api_Model_Session::_renewBySessId() never checks api_user.is_active and REST OAuth authorization never checks whether the admin user is active. Attackers holding an existing SOAP/XML-RPC session or OAuth access token retain API access after deactivation or API key rotation, reading and modifying customer, order and catalog data.

CVE-2026-128031.description: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability because admin controllers' _isAllowed() checks fall back to, or only check, parent ACL resources instead of finer per-action permissions. Authenticated restricted administrators can mass cancel or hold orders, rewrite order shipping addresses, export customer report data, or create REST roles despite their role denying those permissions.

CVE-2026-128032.description: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 accepts the free (No Payment Information Required) payment method on orders with a non-zero total because the zero-total check runs only when payment data is imported. An API user with cart permissions can select free via cart_payment.method while the total is zero, raise it with cart_coupon.remove, and submit cart.order to place an unpaid full-price order.

CVE-2026-128033.description: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in Mage_Rss_Model_Resource_Order::getAllCommentCollection(), which omits the is_visible_on_front filter for invoice, shipment and credit-memo comments. Authenticated customers can open the /rss/order/status feed for their order to read internal staff comments, such as fraud-review and payment notes.

CVE-2026-128040.description: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because admin pages render Dataflow profile link variables, tax rate titles, OAuth consumer names, and PayPal certificate filenames without escaping. An administrator restricted to one affected area can store script that runs when another administrator, including a full administrator, opens the page, reading the form key and performing actions with that administrator's privileges.

CVE-2026-128041.description: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 serves RSS feeds with a text/html content type and does not escape feed entry data, leading to stored cross-site scripting. An unauthenticated guest can submit a product review with script in the nickname, title or text that executes when an administrator opens the pending-reviews feed, enabling admin account takeover.

CVE-2026-128042.description: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.19.0 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a race condition in shopping cart price rule usage limits, because Mage_SalesRule_Model_Validator checks coupon limits without locking and the usage counters are later incremented non-atomically. Unauthenticated attackers, including guest shoppers, can submit concurrent checkouts to redeem a limited coupon more times than its cap allows.

CVE-2026-128043.description: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.19.0 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in PayPal cancel and decline return handlers that trust only the checkout session without verifying the request came from PayPal. Attackers can lure a shopper into a cross-site GET to paypal/standard/cancel to cancel their recent uninvoiced order, void pending authorizations, and restore items to the cart.

CVE-2026-128044.description: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.x before 21.0.0-beta3 validates OAuth 1.0a oauth_callback URLs with a string-prefix check and falls back to accepting any well-formed URL. Attackers holding a leaked consumer key and secret can supply host-suffix, userinfo, or arbitrary callback URLs to capture an approving administrator's or customer's request token and verifier, then obtain an access token with the victim's API privileges.

CVE-2026-128045.description: OpenMage Magento-LTS before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains an authorization bypass in the /rss/order/status feed because its URL key is unsigned Base64-encoded JSON of the order, increment, and customer ids. Unauthenticated attackers can forge keys from enumerated sequential ids to read other customers' names, items, prices, totals, and status comments when order-status RSS is enabled.

CVE-2026-128046.description: OpenMage magento-lts 20.17.0 before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability because the general/file/protected_extensions blocklist omits phar, php8, and phps. Unauthenticated attackers can upload a .phar file through a product File custom option to a predictable media/custom_options path and request it directly to execute code on servers that map .phar to PHP and serve that directory.

CVE-2026-128047.description: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta pre-releases before 21.0.0-beta3 generate customer email-confirmation keys with md5(uniqid()) and customer and administrator password-reset tokens with the non-cryptographic uniqHash(). Unauthenticated attackers can brute-force the roughly 20-bit confirmation key via the unrate-limited confirmAction endpoint to log in as pending customers, or predict administrator reset tokens after recovering generator state.

CVE-2026-128048.description: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 lets restricted administrators read decrypted configuration secrets because the store.getConfig email template directive's encrypted-path check missed config.xml-declared paths, case variants of the getConfig method name, and parent paths. Administrators with Transactional Emails access can preview a crafted template to expose PayPal, payment gateway, and carrier credentials.

CVE-2026-128049.description: OpenMage Magento LTS before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the admin and storefront OAuth confirm and confirmSimple actions, which accept GET requests without form-key validation. Attackers holding OAuth consumer credentials can lure a logged-in administrator or customer to a crafted confirm URL that authorizes the attacker's request token, then exchange it at /oauth/token for a persistent REST API access token bound to the victim.

CVE-2026-128051.description: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because storefront MSRP/MAP popup and Qty Increments notice templates output product names without proper escaping. Attackers with admin product-edit rights can store a malicious product name that executes script when shoppers view product, category, or wishlist pages.

CVE-2026-128052.description: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.19.0 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the template filter's {{layout}} directive, which renders arbitrary layout handles without enforcing the admin/block whitelist that the {{block}} directive applies. Administrators with rights to edit email, CMS, widget or newsletter content can embed {{layout}} with arbitrary handles to render disallowed blocks and disclose limited information.

CVE-2026-128053.description: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in its error pages, which print SCRIPT_NAME-derived URLs built by errors/processor.php without escaping. Unauthenticated attackers can craft links that trigger uncaught exceptions on servers deriving SCRIPT_NAME from the request path, executing script in the storefront origin within victims' browsers.

CVE-2026-128237.description: Scapy before 2.8.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in BER_num_dec() and BERcodec_OID.do_dec() that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU by supplying oversized OID arcs. Attackers can send ASN.1/BER data with many base-128 continuation bytes to cause quadratic CPU consumption or an uncaught ValueError crash on Python 3.11+.

CVE-2026-128238.description: Scapy before 2.8.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in the BER/ASN.1 decoder in scapy/asn1/ber.py that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to crash parsing applications. Attackers can send a single 833-byte packet with 250 nested ASN.1 SEQUENCE structures to trigger an unhandled RecursionError, terminating TLS, SNMP, X.509, or LDAP parsers even with safe=True.

CVE-2026-128239.description: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in the MPEG-4 Form spatial-constraint handlers in src/compositor/mpeg4_form.c that lets attackers crash the process via unchecked group lookups. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene whose Form constraints reference a non-existent group, crashing tools like MP4Box during chapter import for denial of service.

CVE-2026-128240.description: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_del() in src/scenegraph/vrml_proto.c because gf_sg_reset() frees unregistered prototypes still referenced by scene commands. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT/BT scene declaring prototypes via commands, processed by MP4Box -chap, to trigger freed memory access and crash the process.

CVE-2026-128241.description: The xmlwf tool in libexpat through 2.10.0 contains a symlink following vulnerability because -d output mode opens files with fopen("wb"), which follows symbolic links. Local attackers with write access to the output directory can plant a symlink at the expected output name to truncate or overwrite files writable by the xmlwf user.

CVE-2026-128242.description: actix-http before 3.20.1 and actix-web before 4.18.2 contain an unbounded decompression vulnerability in encoding::Decoder that lets remote attackers exhaust memory and CPU via compressed bodies. Attackers can send small highly compressed gzip, deflate, Brotli or zstd request bodies to Json, Form, Bytes or String extractors, or serve them to awc clients, causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-128328.description: Dokploy 0.28.0 before 0.31.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated organization members to list tracked files of any git repository by supplying an arbitrary repoPath to patch.readRepoDirectories. Attackers with read access to one service can enumerate file and directory names of other tenants' application and compose source trees on the host or managed servers.

CVE-2026-128329.description: Dokploy 0.28.0 before 0.31.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated organization members to read arbitrary files by supplying ../ sequences in the filePath of patch.readRepoFile. Attackers with service read permission can read /etc/shadow, SSH private keys, and secret environment files on the Dokploy host or managed remote servers.

CVE-2026-128330.description: Miniflux before 2.3.5 contains an insufficient session expiration vulnerability that allows attackers to retain account access because password changes do not revoke existing web sessions. Attackers holding a leaked password or copied session cookie keep access for up to 30 days, reading integration credentials, creating API keys, or registering passkeys.

CVE-2026-128331.description: Miniflux before 2.3.5 contains an unverified password change vulnerability that allows holders of a signed-in session to change the account password without supplying the current password. Attackers with a stolen session cookie or unattended device can submit new password fields via updateSettings to lock out the owner and take over the account.

CVE-2026-128332.description: Listmonk 6.0.0 before 7.0.0-beta.2 contains a 2FA bypass vulnerability that allows attackers with a valid password to brute-force TOTP codes because the attempt counter resets on every new password login. Attackers can repeatedly submit credentials to POST /admin/login to obtain fresh tokens, each allowing 15 more guesses, gaining sessions for 2FA-protected accounts including Super Admin.

CVE-2026-128333.description: listmonk 6.0.0 before 7.0.0-beta.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in doResetPassword that skips TOTP verification after a password reset. Attackers who can complete a reset, such as by reading the victim's reset email, obtain fully authenticated sessions including Super Admin without the TOTP code.

CVE-2026-128334.description: listmonk 6.2.0 before 7.0.0-beta.2 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to submit Azure Event Grid bounce webhooks when no shared secret is configured. Attackers can POST forged EmailDeliveryReportReceived events with Bounced status to /webhooks/service/azure to blocklist, unsubscribe, or delete arbitrary subscribers.

CVE-2026-128335.description: Contao 4.6.0 before 5.3.54, 5.4.0-RC1 before 5.7.17, and 6.0.0-RC1 before 6.0.6 fails to invalidate existing user sessions when two-factor authentication is enabled or disabled. Because Contao\User::isEqualTo() and serialized session data omit two-factor state, attackers already holding a session keep it after the owner changes 2FA settings.

CVE-2026-128336.description: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows attackers to add numeric keys to Object.prototype through a crafted defined name referencing a __proto__ sheet. Attackers can supply an xlsx whose xl/workbook.xml definedName range targets __proto__, causing CellMatrix to write empty arrays onto Object.prototype process-wide when workbook.xlsx.load() runs.

CVE-2026-128337.description: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in mergeConditionalFormattings that allows attackers to modify Object.prototype by supplying an x14:cfRule id of __proto__. Attackers can craft an xlsx file that, when loaded with xlsx.load(), sets properties such as type, direction, border and cfvo on every object in the process until it restarts.

CVE-2026-128338.description: exceljs through 4.4.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying a worksheet col element with an unbounded max attribute. Attackers can craft a small workbook with a huge max value, causing xlsx.load() to allocate hundreds of millions of Column objects and abort the process with an uncatchable heap out-of-memory error.

CVE-2026-128339.description: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in Worksheet._parseMergeCells that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying unbounded mergeCell ranges. Attackers can craft a small workbook with a mergeCell ref like A1:XFD1048576, causing xlsx.load() to create billions of Row and Cell objects and abort the process.

CVE-2026-128340.description: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying a workbook with an oversized defined-name range. DefinedNames.addEx expands ranges such as S!$A$1:$XFD$1048576 from xl/workbook.xml cell by cell, causing an uncatchable fatal heap out-of-memory error during xlsx.load().

CVE-2026-128341.description: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in data-validations-xform.js that allows attackers to exhaust CPU and memory by supplying unbounded sqref ranges. Attackers can provide a small crafted workbook with a sqref of A1:XFD1048576 to make xlsx.load() iterate billions of addresses, blocking the event loop and crashing the process with an uncatchable out-of-memory error.

CVE-2026-128342.description: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows attackers to block the event loop by supplying an unbounded sheetId in xl/workbook.xml. Attackers can provide a workbook with a huge sheetId, making the sparse worksheet array walk stall worksheets, getWorksheet and writeBuffer for seconds.

CVE-2026-128343.description: exceljs through 4.4.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows attackers to block the event loop by supplying unbounded row r attributes parsed in row-xform.js. Attackers can craft an XLSX file with a row numbered far beyond Excel's limit, making getSheetValues(), workbook writes and CSV export consume time proportional to that number.

CVE-2026-128344.description: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying a workbook with an unbounded image anchor column in the drawing part. Attackers can set an anchor column such as 300000000 in xl/drawings/drawing1.xml so reading getImages() anchor positions makes Worksheet.getColumn allocate millions of Column objects and abort with a heap out-of-memory error.

CVE-2026-128345.description: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a regular expression denial of service vulnerability in slideFormula in lib/utils/shared-formula.js when translating shared formulas to child cells. Attackers can supply a crafted spreadsheet with very long master formulas, such as runs of hyphens, causing quadratic regex backtracking that blocks the Node.js event loop.

CVE-2026-128346.description: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a resource leak vulnerability in the streaming WorkbookReader.parse that leaves temporary files and open descriptors when sheet parsing fails or iteration stops early. Attackers can repeatedly upload malformed multi-sheet workbooks with worksheets placed before xl/sharedStrings.xml to fill the temporary directory and exhaust file descriptors.

CVE-2026-128347.description: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability in the streaming WorkbookWriter that allows attackers to read local files by supplying crafted image filenames to addImage. Attackers can inject ../ path segments into user-controlled image paths, causing addMedia to embed any file readable by the Node.js process under xl/media in the generated workbook.

CVE-2026-128348.description: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a formula injection vulnerability in the totals row formula getter in lib/doc/table.js that fails to escape [, ], # and ' characters in structured reference column names. Attackers can supply column names containing ] via untrusted input like imported CSV headers to inject formulas such as HYPERLINK that exfiltrate cell values when users open and click the generated workbook.
