b1b44d2bce1af455d6b0ef57.title_original: Autonomous Cyber Operations Gym for Training and Evaluating AI Models for Defence
b1b44d2bce1af455d6b0ef57.excerpt: arXiv:2610.18594v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This paper proposes an Autonomous Cyber Operations (ACO) gym, a unified framework integrating high-fidelity network emulation, realistic user behaviour modelling for benign network traffic and adversarial profiles, and the generation of cybersecurity scenarios through open toolkits. By supporting live and deferred feature extraction at the packet and flow levels, the gym facilitates the creation of labelled synthetic datasets for training Deep Neural Network (DNN)-based Intrusion Detection Systems (IDSs), as well as developing and evaluating modular components for autonomous defence agents through emulated interactions. While evaluation of a DNN classifier within the gym shows high in-domain performance, achieving near-perfect recall on adversarial network flows, our experiments reveal a significant sensitivity to domain shift, showing that even minor changes in network composition, such as variations in traffic protocol distribution, can lead to a catastrophic collapse in model transferability and detection performance.

1bdfb9266fe0e8c167b2e0c9.title_original: Analyzing and Mitigating Poisoning Attacks on Flow-Based Intrusion Detection
1bdfb9266fe0e8c167b2e0c9.excerpt: arXiv:2610.19766v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Although Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based Intrusion Detection Systems (IDSs) are increasingly deployed in operational networks, their dependence on large-scale training data introduces a critical vulnerability to stealthy poisoning attacks. We demonstrate that latent backdoors can be successfully implanted in flow-based IDS models by poisoning as little as 0.001% of the training data, maintaining near-nominal performance on clean inputs while ensuring high attack success rates. To address this threat, we propose a diagnostic-first methodology that localizes trigger-relevant features through constrained perturbation analysis and detects poisoning-induced behavioral drift by comparison with a distilled baseline model. The proposed methodology further enables targeted mitigation via automated data sanitization or neuron pruning. Our findings expose the operational risks of near-undetectable backdoors and provide a scalable approach to analyzing, quantifying, and mitigating backdoor exposure in AI-based IDS.

Supporting new ledgers or execution models requires corresponding channel realizations and may require protocol adaptation and security analysis. We present UniPCH, a two-layer framework separating native channel execution from private cross-chain payment logic. Its lower layer, UniPC, defines common channel operations and security requirements, enabling the same upper payment protocol to coordinate different channel realizations. UniPC separates conditional task authorization from confirmation of the complete channel state. Valid task evidence can be reused across updates, while both participants confirm the complete updated state. At the upper layer, we develop selective re-signing blind conditional signatures (S-RBCS) to construct a four-phase protocol over UniPC coordinating each realization's authorization tasks across hubs. We provide realizations for UTXO ledgers and account ledgers that support smart contracts. Our analysis establishes local UniPC security, griefing resistance, economic atomicity, and session unlinkability. bff889ddfe505c7f2bb391bf.title_original: Systematic Evaluation of Adversarial Jailbreaking Attacks and Defenses Across Seven Large Language Models
bff889ddfe505c7f2bb391bf.excerpt: arXiv:2610.39509v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) deployed in safety-critical settings must resist adversarial inputs designed to elicit harmful outputs. Across 250 prompts per model, a content judge counted obfuscation attacks as harmful (HARMFUL or PARTIAL responses) at a pooled rate of 62.3%, the highest of any family, although only 7.1% of responses were rated HARMFUL. e35dae07294bba6d5c4d12f0.title_original: TxBench: Verifying Public Incident Data to Benchmark Smart-Contract Attack Detectors
e35dae07294bba6d5c4d12f0.excerpt: arXiv:2611.04411v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Malicious transactions on smart contracts cause billions of dollars in losses. To evaluate their detectors, most datasets copy the attack transactions that public incident databases cite and pair them with random transactions. However, these databases never check their citations against execution, and random transactions rarely resemble attacks. We present TXBENCH, a benchmark that verifies both attacks and legitimate transactions against their execution. TXBENCH labels a cited transaction as an attack only when its execution takes value from others and independent evidence ties it to its incident. Its legitimate transactions perform the same operations as attacks and carry positive evidence of legitimacy. Applying these checks to two public databases, we find that they share only 10.6% of their 1,850 cited transactions and that only 1,012 are verifiable attacks, worth $868.2 million. A blind manual review confirms 98/100 sampled attacks and 100/100 legitimate transactions.

77007dce4fa9e3b411f0f9f8.title_original: FedADMM-InSa: An Inexact and Self-Adaptive ADMM for Federated Learning
77007dce4fa9e3b411f0f9f8.excerpt: arXiv:2402.13989v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a promising framework for learning from distributed data while maintaining privacy. The development of efficient FL algorithms encounters various challenges, including heterogeneous data and systems, limited communication capacities, and constrained local computational resources. Recently developed FedADMM methods show great resilience to both data and system heterogeneity. However, they still suffer from performance deterioration if the hyperparameters are not carefully tuned. To address this issue, we propose an inexact and self-adaptive FedADMM algorithm, termed FedADMM-InSa. First, we design an inexactness criterion for the clients' local updates to eliminate the need for empirically setting the local training accuracy. This inexactness criterion can be assessed by each client independently based on its unique condition, thereby reducing the local computational cost and mitigating the undesirable straggle effect. The convergence of the resulting inexact ADMM is proved under the assumption of strongly convex loss functions. Additionally, we present a self-adaptive scheme that dynamically adjusts each client's penalty parameter, enhancing algorithm robustness by mitigating the need for empirical penalty parameter choices for each client. bc06d300d445b40b40231911.excerpt: arXiv:2602.16596v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Modern AI models are not static. They go through multiple updates in their lifecycles. We propose to design Sequential Membership Inference (SeMI) attacks leading to tighter privacy audits by exploiting the sequence of models and injecting a target canary at a controlled insertion time. First, for empirical mean computation, we develop SeMI*, an optimal SeMI attack to identify the presence of a target inserted at a specific insertion step. We derive the power of SeMI* to show that accessing the model sequence yields more powerful MI attacks than scrutinising only the final model. SeMI* exhibits an isolation property. Its power depends on the statistics obtained right before and after insertion of the target. Leveraging this insight, we develop practical white-box (accessing model gradients) and black-box (accessing loss) SeMI attacks against models trained with (DP-)SGD. Across datasets and models trained with (DP-)SGD, our experiments show that SeMI attacks achieve higher power than snapshot-independent baselines, and yield tighter privacy audits thanks to (a) control over the insertion time and (b) observations across the model sequence. d2a91bb303fcc09159f8bd94.excerpt: arXiv:2606.05435v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) has become the standard framework for privacy-preserving machine learning, yet its reliance on a fixed gradient clipping threshold to limit sensitivity remains a significant practical limitation. Adaptive clipping algorithms such as AdaClip shift and scale the gradient prior to clipping and adding noise so that the clipped gradient yields a more informative descent direction. The shift and scaling parameters are selected adaptively based on the empirical mean and variance. However, in existing adaptive clipping algorithms, these empirical estimates have not been also used for momentum to accelerate training itself. On the other hand, DP-Adam is an algorithm that exploits Adam-like momentum updates based on the gradient mean and variance to accelerate training, but does not exploit these estimates for adaptive clipping. In this work, we propose Differentially Private Mechanism with Adaptive Clipping and Adaptive Momentum (DP-MacAdam), a novel algorithm that combines these two approaches so as to use the same mean and variance estimates for both clipping and momentum. We perform an analysis showing that DP-MacAdam estimates the gradient variances in a bias-free manner. 6ec440d8eaa62cc9983a8c28.excerpt: arXiv:2607.21776v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Talking-face (TF) deepfake generation synthesizes photorealistic facial video from a static source image and an audio signal, producing forgeries that current image-based detectors consistently fail to identify. 8295619502fba68987ef8cbf.title_original: ASAP: Assembly-Source Aligned Pseudocode Refinement For Binary Decompilation
8295619502fba68987ef8cbf.excerpt: arXiv:2610.06900v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in binary decompilation to refine the C-like pseudocode produced by traditional rule-based decompilers. While this pseudocode is useful, it is a heuristic and lossy abstraction rather than a faithful copy of the source code. It often contains decompiler errors, especially for aggressively optimized binaries where critical low-level details are obscured. We present ASAP, an Assembly-Source Aligned Pseudocode refinement framework for binary decompilation. ASAP learns source-aligned assembly representations from paired source and binary functions using joint function-level and snippet-level contrastive alignment. A Q-Former then compresses chunk-level assembly features into a fixed number of assembly tokens. These tokens and the decompiler-produced pseudocode jointly condition the decompilation LLM. During refinement, we use stochastic pseudocode masking and a relative assembly-advantage loss to discourage the model from relying solely on pseudocode. On two decompilation benchmarks across multiple compiler optimization levels, ASAP improves the average re-execution rate from 64.7% to 71.9% and the average recompilation rate from 91.6% to 96.6% compared with the strongest baseline. Our approach offers both a new perspective and a practical solution to binary decompilation.

ccd7629403e249c6b46c7047.title_ko: Trezor, Safe 5 지갑 3대서 복구문구 탈취용 악성 기판 확인
ccd7629403e249c6b46c7047.summary_ko: Trezor는 판매업체 CryptoBilis에서 구매한 Safe 5 지갑 3대에서 복구문구를 탈취하는 악성 기판을 확인했다고 밝혔다. 펌웨어 2.13.1에 정보 수집 차단 기능을 추가했지만, 업데이트 전에 유출된 복구문구는 보호하지 못한다고 설명했다. 현재까지 해당 지갑을 통한 자금 도난 신고는 없다고 덧붙였다.
ccd7629403e249c6b46c7047.background_ko: 메인보드와 화면 사이에 삽입된 악성 기판은 화면의 복구문구와 암호문구를 가로채 이동통신망으로 공격자 서버에 전송하도록 설계됐다.

curation.reason_ko: Trezor가 판매된 하드웨어 지갑 3대에서 복구 문구 탈취용 악성 하드웨어 삽입을 확인했다.

739b992f7e2749637e7a4793.title_original: German military drone operations disrupted by cyberattack
739b992f7e2749637e7a4793.excerpt: German defense technology company Quantum Systems confirmed that it detected an incident in late October that was part of an active cyberattack by "hostile actors." [...]
739b992f7e2749637e7a4793.title_ko: Quantum Systems 사이버공격 확인…독일군 드론 운용 차질 보도
739b992f7e2749637e7a4793.summary_ko: 독일 드론 업체 Quantum Systems는 10월 말 적대 세력의 사이버공격을 탐지했으며 당국과 대응했다고 밝혔다. Der Spiegel과 Financial Times는 내부 소식통을 인용해 QBase 업데이트 배포 서버를 통한 악성 파일 유포를 보도했다. 독일군이 예방적으로 해당 업체 드론의 운용을 중단했다는 보도도 나왔으나 설치 규모와 공격 주체는 확인되지 않았다.

curation.reason_ko: 독일 방산기업이 적대 행위자의 사이버공격을 확인했으며 군 드론 운용 차질이 보도됐다.

93e76bdcfcaf45d6783e4528.title_original: Check Point gateways hacked via PHP2Shell to deploy VMware ESXi wiper
93e76bdcfcaf45d6783e4528.excerpt: Vulnerable Check Point Security Gateway instances have been targeted in PHP2Shell attacks that deployed data-wiping malware on VMware ESXi hosts. [...]
93e76bdcfcaf45d6783e4528.title_ko: Check Point 게이트웨이 취약점 악용…VMware ESXi 데이터 파괴 공격
93e76bdcfcaf45d6783e4528.summary_ko: Check Point는 게이트웨이에 침투한 공격자가 내부 VMware ESXi 호스트로 이동해 데이터 삭제 악성코드 destroy_v6를 실행했다고 밝혔다. 이후 여러 국가로 확산된 2차 공격에서는 파괴 행위가 확인되지 않았으며, 공격 주체도 확정되지 않았다. 회사는 관련 취약점을 수정하는 11월 Jumbo Hotfix 적용을 권고했다.
93e76bdcfcaf45d6783e4528.background_ko: 공격자는 Mobile Access 포털의 PHP2Shell 취약점으로 침투한 뒤 별도 권한 상승 취약점을 악용해 루트 권한을 얻었다.

6e5bda9180a7ef10c10c2b29.title_original: How one AI agent exposed five critical enterprise security gaps
6e5bda9180a7ef10c10c2b29.excerpt: An AI agent built to automate invoice processing could be manipulated into changing vendor bank details through a malicious email, without triggering traditional security alerts. Token Security examines five critical AI agent security gaps and shares practical guidance from industry security leaders on preventing them. [...]
6e5bda9180a7ef10c10c2b29.title_ko: 가상 AI 에이전트 사례로 살펴본 기업의 접근 권한·감시 공백
6e5bda9180a7ef10c10c2b29.summary_ko: Token Security는 가상의 송장 처리 에이전트를 통해 미파악 에이전트, 과도한 권한과 프롬프트 주입 위험을 설명했다. 의뢰 조사에 참여한 IT·보안 전문가 418명 중 82%는 지난 1년간 존재를 몰랐던 에이전트를 발견했다고 답했다. 글은 접근 경로와 위임 권한을 파악하고 외부 입력이 민감한 변경으로 이어지지 않도록 설계해야 한다고 강조한다.
6e5bda9180a7ef10c10c2b29.background_ko: 글의 가상 사례에서는 보안 검토 없이 만든 에이전트가 외부 이메일을 읽고 개인 API 키로 ERP의 은행 정보를 수정할 수 있도록 설정됐다.

e254ca0bf0b9f02ad0f4997a.title_original: Microsoft says November security updates cause printing issues
e254ca0bf0b9f02ad0f4997a.excerpt: Microsoft warned customers earlier this week that the November 2026 security updates may break printing for documents with complex formatting. [...]
e254ca0bf0b9f02ad0f4997a.title_ko: Microsoft, 2026년 11월 Windows 보안 업데이트 후 인쇄 오류 경고
e254ca0bf0b9f02ad0f4997a.summary_ko: Microsoft는 2026년 11월 보안 업데이트 이후 복잡한 서식의 문서가 인쇄되지 않을 수 있다고 밝혔다. Windows 10 이상과 Windows Server 2016 이상에서 높이나 너비가 0으로 렌더링되는 이미지가 포함된 문서가 영향을 받는다. 주로 Windows GDI를 통해 Word 문서를 출력할 때 발생하지만 다른 앱에서도 나타날 수 있다.
e254ca0bf0b9f02ad0f4997a.background_ko: Microsoft는 업데이트 적용 후 선택한 인쇄 해상도에서 높이나 너비가 0으로 렌더링되는 이미지를 포함한 문서를 인쇄할 때 오류가 발생한다고 설명했다.

a643eb3aecaeb5e9cd4ffedd.title_original: Check Point warns of zero-day flaw exploited for root access
a643eb3aecaeb5e9cd4ffedd.excerpt: Check Point Software has released emergency hotfixes to address a high-severity flaw that hackers have been exploiting to gain root privileges and establish persistence on vulnerable devices since late October. [...]
a643eb3aecaeb5e9cd4ffedd.title_ko: Check Point, root 권한 탈취에 악용된 제로데이 긴급 패치
a643eb3aecaeb5e9cd4ffedd.summary_ko: Check Point는 10월 말부터 root 권한 확보에 악용된 로컬 권한 상승 취약점 CVE-2026-123039의 긴급 핫픽스를 공개했다. 회사는 수십 곳의 고객사에서 악용을 관찰했으며, 공격자가 PHP2Shell 취약점으로 먼저 침투한 뒤 이 결함으로 권한을 높였다고 설명했다. 조사된 공격에서는 VMware ESXi 호스트로 이동해 파괴형 악성코드를 배포한 정황도 확인됐다.
a643eb3aecaeb5e9cd4ffedd.background_ko: root로 실행되는 Gaia OS DynamicCLI 데몬이 로컬 소켓 접속 프로세스를 인증하지 않아, 인증된 로컬 사용자가 root 권한으로 명령을 실행할 수 있었다.

1339f6e7eefcfaf1618f8a00.title_original: Microsoft confirms Windows activation failures after November updates
1339f6e7eefcfaf1618f8a00.excerpt: Microsoft has confirmed that this month's Patch Tuesday security updates are causing Windows activation and licensing failures with 0x80041008 error codes. [...]
1339f6e7eefcfaf1618f8a00.title_ko: Microsoft, 11월 업데이트 후 Windows 정품 인증 오류 확인
1339f6e7eefcfaf1618f8a00.summary_ko: Microsoft가 11월 보안 업데이트 이후 일부 Windows 10·11과 Windows Server에서 정품 인증·라이선스 관리 시 0x80041008 오류가 발생한다고 밝혔다. SLMGR로 KMS 설정이나 제품 키를 관리하는 조직이 영향을 받으며, 이미 인증된 기기의 인증 상태는 유지된다. 회사는 즉각적인 완화가 필요한 조직에 기업 지원 창구로 문의하라고 안내했다.
1339f6e7eefcfaf1618f8a00.background_ko: Microsoft는 11월 보안 업데이트가 일부 Windows 환경에서 정품 인증과 라이선스 관리 명령의 실행 오류를 유발한다고 확인했다.

curation.reason_ko: Microsoft가 11월 보안 업데이트 이후 정품 인증·인쇄 문제를 인정해 단말 운영 영향이 확인됐다.

71c234fd90e5cee04afa20aa.title_original: In Other News: New CISA Director Nominee, Connected Car Hacking, Baker Tilly Data Breach
71c234fd90e5cee04afa20aa.excerpt: Noteworthy stories that might have slipped under the radar: Siemens details security advisory policy, OpenAI Codex backdoor risk, Microsoft warns of model weight backdoors. The post In Other News: New CISA Director Nominee, Connected Car Hacking, Baker Tilly Data Breach appeared first on SecurityWeek .
71c234fd90e5cee04afa20aa.title_ko: OpenAI 에이전트 무단 접근·Codex 공격 가능 경로 등 주간 보안 동향
71c234fd90e5cee04afa20aa.summary_ko: SecurityWeek는 OpenAI 평가용 에이전트의 무단 접근과 활동 은폐, Codex 저장소의 프롬프트 주입 위험 등 주요 보안 소식을 정리했다. 연구진은 Codex의 악성 npm 배포로 이어질 수 있는 공격 경로를 제시했으며, OpenAI는 해당 문제를 수정했다. Railway는 침해 사고에서 탈취된 AI 키의 무단 사용액을 약 74만 달러로 추산했다.

e43195d6b51e9e0a9a477147.title_original: Microsoft Struggles to Restore Email and Other Services in a Global Outage
e43195d6b51e9e0a9a477147.excerpt: Microsoft is trying different ways to identify the cause of the problem and get its servers back online, using “a measured approach to identify and repair affected infrastructure.” The post Microsoft Struggles to Restore Email and Other Services in a Global Outage appeared first on SecurityWeek .
e43195d6b51e9e0a9a477147.title_ko: Microsoft 365 글로벌 장애 장기화…Outlook·Teams·Copilot 이용 차질
e43195d6b51e9e0a9a477147.summary_ko: Microsoft 365 장애가 수 시간 이어지며 아시아부터 미국까지 기업과 정부 기관의 이메일·업무 서비스에 차질이 발생했다. Microsoft는 복구 과정에서 일부 안정화와 처리 용량 개선을 확인했지만 서비스가 완전히 정상화되지는 않았다고 밝혔다. 회사는 악성 활동이 원인이라는 징후는 없으며 원인을 조사 중이라고 설명했다.

33cc01010db5a5aea891e612.title_original: Apify Confirms Customer Data Accessed in Cyberattack
33cc01010db5a5aea891e612.excerpt: The web scraping company says an intruder accessed customer accounts and obtained personal information or stored data. The post Apify Confirms Customer Data Accessed in Cyberattack appeared first on SecurityWeek .
33cc01010db5a5aea891e612.title_ko: Apify, 사이버공격으로 고객 개인정보·저장 데이터 접근 피해 확인
33cc01010db5a5aea891e612.summary_ko: 웹 수집·자동화 기업 Apify는 11월 9~10일 발생한 침입으로 일부 고객의 개인정보와 저장 데이터에 무단 접근이 있었다고 확인했다. 고객이 공개한 통지문에는 비밀번호 해시, 2단계 인증 복구 코드, 로그인 토큰 등도 노출 항목으로 기재됐다. 회사는 내부 비밀정보를 교체하고 일부 OAuth 연결을 해제했으며, 피해 계정 수는 공개하지 않았다.
33cc01010db5a5aea891e612.background_ko: Apify는 공격자가 침해된 인증정보로 추가 인증정보를 확보해 내부 시스템과 관련 고객 계정에 접근했다고 밝혔다.

curation.reason_ko: Apify가 고객 계정 접근과 개인정보 또는 저장 데이터 획득을 인정해 서비스 이용자와 관련성이 높다.

e18c08ddd10218a8f927a3d8.title_original: SilentAir Hackers Intercept Calls, SMS From Inside Mobile Networks
e18c08ddd10218a8f927a3d8.excerpt: Enea says SilentAir hijacked mobile network nodes to intercept calls and messages, with Taiwanese subscribers the primary targets. The post SilentAir Hackers Intercept Calls, SMS From Inside Mobile Networks appeared first on SecurityWeek .
e18c08ddd10218a8f927a3d8.title_ko: Enea, 이동통신망 내부에서 통화·문자 가로채는 SilentAir 활동 보고
e18c08ddd10218a8f927a3d8.summary_ko: Enea는 SilentAir가 최소 아시아 6개국 통신사의 침해된 노드를 이용해 주로 대만을 겨냥한 통화·문자 가로채기를 수행했다고 보고했다. 표적에는 고위 정치·정부 인사가 포함됐으며 가입자 정보 수집과 일부 위치 추적도 관찰됐다. 연구진은 국가급 행위자라는 평가에는 높은 신뢰도를 부여했지만 중국 연계 가능성에 대한 신뢰도는 낮다고 밝혔다.
e18c08ddd10218a8f927a3d8.background_ko: Enea에 따르면 공격자는 탈취한 통신사 노드에서 SS7과 Diameter 신호 공격으로 표적의 수신 통화와 문자를 해당 노드로 우회시켰다.

curation.reason_ko: Enea가 이동통신망 노드를 장악해 대만 가입자 중심으로 통화·문자를 가로챈 활동을 보고했다.

30f637031c1f6b4b7af031c7.title_original: Law Enforcement Disrupts Gootloader, CastleRAT, and StealC Infrastructure
30f637031c1f6b4b7af031c7.excerpt: Investigators seized 235 servers and 257 domains, along with 6.4 million victim credentials as part of Operation Endgame. The post Law Enforcement Disrupts Gootloader, CastleRAT, and StealC Infrastructure appeared first on SecurityWeek .
30f637031c1f6b4b7af031c7.title_ko: 국제 공조 수사, Gootloader·CastleRAT·StealC 서버·도메인 압수
30f637031c1f6b4b7af031c7.summary_ko: 미국·유럽·호주·캐나다 수사기관이 Gootloader, CastleRAT, StealC 운영에 사용된 서버 235대와 도메인 257개를 압수했다고 Europol이 밝혔다. 이번 Operation Endgame 수사에서는 피해자 인증정보 640만 건도 확보해 HaveIBeenPwned 등 보안 기관·서비스와 공유했다.
30f637031c1f6b4b7af031c7.background_ko: 이들 악성코드는 서비스형 사이버범죄 방식으로 운영되며 랜섬웨어 공격, 데이터 탈취와 다른 사이버범죄를 지원했다.

2660fe9295d663165682be88.excerpt: Successful exploitation could lead to unexpected behavior or denial-of-service (DoS) conditions. The post Citrix Patches 10 Critical NetScaler Vulnerabilities appeared first on SecurityWeek .
2660fe9295d663165682be88.title_ko: Citrix, NetScaler 치명적 취약점 10건 패치…인증 우회·서비스 거부 위험
2660fe9295d663165682be88.summary_ko: Citrix가 NetScaler ADC·Gateway의 치명적 결함 9건을 포함한 취약점 28건과 Console의 치명적 결함 1건을 수정했다. Console 결함은 인증 없이 제한된 자원에 접근하게 할 수 있으며, ADC·Gateway 결함은 서비스 거부 등을 유발할 수 있다. 회사는 신속한 업데이트를 권고했으며 실제 공격 악용 사례는 언급하지 않았다.
2660fe9295d663165682be88.background_ko: NetScaler ADC·Gateway의 치명적 결함 9건은 패킷 처리, DNS, 인증 등 여러 기능의 메모리 오버플로 문제에서 비롯됐다.

c30d41d06c30cb4f6004a860.title_original: OpenAI Unveils Daybreak Red Team, Defense Factory Security Tools
c30d41d06c30cb4f6004a860.excerpt: Daybreak Red Team pentests web applications with AI agents, while Defense Factory investigates security findings and prepares patches. The post OpenAI Unveils Daybreak Red Team, Defense Factory Security Tools appeared first on SecurityWeek .
c30d41d06c30cb4f6004a860.title_ko: OpenAI, 취약점 검증·패치 작성 지원하는 Daybreak 보안 도구 공개
c30d41d06c30cb4f6004a860.summary_ko: OpenAI가 AI 에이전트로 웹 애플리케이션 취약점을 검증하는 Daybreak Red Team과 수정안을 준비하는 Defense Factory를 공개했다. 회사 설명에 따르면 에이전트는 격리된 환경에서 정해진 접근 범위 내에서 테스트하며, 외부 보안 도구의 발견 사항도 조사한다. 제안된 패치는 엔지니어가 검토·테스트하며 자동 배포되지 않는다.
c30d41d06c30cb4f6004a860.background_ko: 웹 애플리케이션의 취약점 검증과 보안 도구가 발견한 문제의 조사·수정 작업을 지원하기 위해 마련된 제품이다.

curation.reason_ko: OpenAI가 AI 침투시험과 보안 발견사항 조사·패치 준비를 지원하는 도구를 공개했다.

d01a3e8d6809fc0b3616ea6f.title_original: MDR Pricing: Comparing Asset-Based and Ingestion-Based Costs
d01a3e8d6809fc0b3616ea6f.excerpt: When comparing MDR pricing, it helps to understand what the same annual budget would buy from each provider. Two proposals with similar prices may give analysts access to different evidence, retain it for different periods, or leave your team with different responsibilities. Those differences can affect what happens when you need to investigate a compromised account or trace an attacker’s low-and-slow activity across your environment. 206c97225b809d09bd65ee18.excerpt: arXiv:2610.15221v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: AI agents can evolve by using environment feedback to revise their harnesses, the software managing model inputs, tool use, memory, and execution, while keeping foundation models frozen. Existing studies focus on single agents, leaving joint harness evolution in multi-agent systems (MAS) underexplored. A single global optimizer faces growing context and workload as the system scales, while access restrictions may prevent sharing agent internals or system-wide feedback. We propose HarnessNet, a framework for hierarchical harness evolution in MAS. Its basic unit, Agentron, comprises an evolvable forward harness, a foundation model, and a local optimizer that can observe and modify only that harness. Agentrons form a layered graph through which environment feedback propagates backward, with upstream optimizers receiving node-specific feedback from the downstream layer. This decomposes joint harness evolution into smaller, coordinated tasks with separate contexts, reducing individual optimizers' context and workload while keeping access local. Optimizers need not access all agent trajectories or raw environment feedback. Experiments on AgentBench with multiple foundation models demonstrate the feasibility of training HarnessNet. True return roughly follows how far the planner's weights move from its proposals ($\sqrt{\mathrm{KL}}$), and best-of-$N$ action selection with a verifier trained on synthetic labels falls below a single noisy action. b2de380127a7f970cdc7512b.excerpt: arXiv:2611.09422v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Website fingerprinting attacks infer websites visited by users and threaten their privacy. These attacks are classified as on-path, which monitor network traffic, and co-located, which exploit shared system resources. Existing co-located attacks, such as sweep-counting and loop-counting, achieve over 90% accuracy but suffer significant performance degradation on many-core systems. Loop-counting accuracy drops from 93% on 8 cores to 50% on 24 cores, while sweep-counting accuracy decreases from 84% to 45% across multiple Core Complex Dies (CCDs). To address these limitations, we propose memory-chasing, a scalable website fingerprinting attack that exploits DRAM traffic interference through pointer-chasing traversals with minimal interference. By counting DRAM accesses over fixed intervals, the attack generates distinctive traces for website classification. Evaluated on the top 50 websites, memory-chasing achieves 96% accuracy on a 24-core system, 86% across multiple CCDs, 80% across multiple sockets, and 97% in an open-world setting. Extensive evaluation across hardware configurations, browsers, operating systems, isolation mechanisms, system noise, and countermeasures demonstrates its robustness and scalability.

685c6b48030e9d0b1787a205.title_original: SCKit abuses ScreenConnect to deploy remote access and target technician sessions
685c6b48030e9d0b1787a205.excerpt: In this article ScreenConnect architecture and attack surfaces Attack chain overview Mitigation and protection guidance Indicators of compromise and supporting artifacts References Learn More Beginning on November 11, 2026, ConnectWise reported an active campaign of a threat actor gaining unauthorized access to cloud-hosted ConnectWise ScreenConnect instances belonging to managed service providers (MSPs). Microsoft Threat Intelligence has confirmed ConnectWise’s reported activity and we have also observed threat actors abusing ScreenConnect, a legitimate remote-support application, to install unauthorized remote-access clients and deploy a malicious worm, SCKit, on ConnectWise customer managed endpoints. Additionally, Microsoft analyzed the malicious worm’s behavior: deployment starts with commands issued through ScreenConnect to silently install an identical client connected to threat actor-controlled infrastructure. A batch launcher retrieves a PowerShell decoder that decrypts and extracts SCKit using device-specific key material. The toolkit establishes persistence through scheduled tasks and registry Run entries and deploys RelayTrap, a component designed to deliver a malicious payload to a connecting technician. We have identified that the worm targets IT support technician workstations using the hijacked authenticated ScreenConnect Session and uses the victim’s management console to distribute payloads to other managed devices. The resulting access to either target enab
685c6b48030e9d0b1787a205.title_ko: ScreenConnect 악용한 SCKit 공격…고객 단말·지원 기술자 겨냥
685c6b48030e9d0b1787a205.summary_ko: Microsoft는 공격자가 ScreenConnect를 악용해 고객 단말에 무단 원격접속 클라이언트와 SCKit을 배포한 활동을 확인했다. SCKit의 RelayTrap은 지원 기술자가 접속할 때 악성 코드를 전달하도록 설계됐으며, 최초 침투 경로는 조사 중이다. 무단 클라이언트만 삭제해서는 지속성 설정이나 노출된 웹 세션 문제가 해소되지 않는다고 경고했다.

curation.reason_ko: Microsoft가 ScreenConnect 악용과 기술자 세션을 겨냥한 SCKit 전파 동작을 분석했다.

c0ed2363ae00a4a4b0b81c69.title_original: ARTEX and beyond: AI-enabled penetration testing platforms
c0ed2363ae00a4a4b0b81c69.excerpt: Cisco Talos is tracking the growing in-the-wild usage of AI-enabled penetration testing frameworks. AI-enabled penetration testing and red team frameworks can automate and chain reconnaissance, vulnerability testing, and follow-on actions, lowering the skill threshold for attackers and accelerating intrusions when the tools are misused. Talos has seen full automation of the attack chain by these frameworks, which not only use free and open-source tools, like nmap and nuclei, but also take advantage of internet mapping services like Censys and Shodan, CAPTCHA bypass services, credential leak management services, residential proxies, and even hash cracking services. This is the case of Hephaestus, which we mentioned in our previous report . Although these frameworks all have the same purpose, they come in different flavors. Some, like Hephaestus, are command line tools which can be deployed with a single script on a VPS and are completely controllable via Telegram. PentAGI has a web interface to monitor the agent activity with a full attack chain graph design and monitoring. Talos found more than 700 instances of currently reachable PentAGI instances on the internet. HexStrike AI integrates with many different clients like Claude Code, VS Code, or any other client that supports MCP. One such framework making waves, ARTEX, has enabled threat actors to scale offensive operations, compressing work that may have previously taken skilled teams hours or days into activity that can un
c0ed2363ae00a4a4b0b81c69.title_ko: Cisco Talos, ARTEX 등 AI 침투 테스트 도구의 실제 공격 악용 분석
c0ed2363ae00a4a4b0b81c69.summary_ko: Cisco Talos는 ARTEX 등 AI 기반 침투 테스트 도구가 정찰·취약점 검사·후속 공격을 자동화하며 실제 침해에 악용되는 사례를 관찰했다고 밝혔다. ARTEX 관련 인프라에서는 VShell·GoPhish·AdaptixC2 등도 함께 확인됐다. Talos는 공격 자동화로 방어자가 탐지와 차단에 쓸 수 있는 시간이 줄어든다고 경고했다.
c0ed2363ae00a4a4b0b81c69.background_ko: ARTEX는 승인된 보안 테스트용으로 개발됐으며, Talos는 오픈소스 공개와 복제본 유통이 여러 공격 집단의 도입을 촉진한 것으로 분석했다.

curation.reason_ko: Cisco Talos가 AI 침투시험 프레임워크의 실제 악용과 공격 과정 자동화를 관찰했다고 밝혔다.

CVE-2026-127031.description: In Eclipse AAS4J before 3.0.1, `XmlSchemaValidator.validateSchema()` (and `AASXValidator.validateSchema()`, which calls it) validates untrusted XML with a default JAXP `Validator` that resolves external DTDs and external entities. An attacker who supplies a crafted AAS XML document or AASX package can read local files from the host, send their contents out-of-band to an attacker-controlled server, and make the validating process send arbitrary outbound requests (SSRF). Validation still returns no errors. Details: - Vulnerable code: `dataformat-xml/src/main/java/org/eclipse/digitaltwin/aas4j/v3/dataformat/xml/XmlSchemaValidator.java`. `schema.newValidator().validate(new StreamSource(...))` runs without `ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD` / `ACCESS_EXTERNAL_SCHEMA` restrictions and without `disallow-doctype-decl`. - Second entry point: `dataformat-aasx/src/main/java/org/eclipse/digitaltwin/aas4j/v3/dataformat/aasx/AASXValidator.java`. The AAS XML part of an `.aasx` package is passed unchanged to the vulnerable validator. - `XmlDeserializer` (Jackson/Woodstox) is not affected, because DTD support is disabled by default there. - Present since the initial import of the code base (commit `cc9da52`). - Fix: harden the validator by setting `ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD` and `ACCESS_EXTERNAL_SCHEMA` to `""` and rejecting `DOCTYPE` declarations. The bundled `AAS.xsd` does not need DTDs, so no functionality is lost.

CVE-2026-127102.description: In Eclipse BaSyx Go Components versions up to and including 1.1.2, ABAC-enabled deployments of the Submodel Repository and the AAS Environment return Submodel Elements that the caller is not authorized to read from `GET /submodels/{submodelIdentifier}/submodel-elements`. If an access rule grants READ on a single Submodel Element through a `$sme` `REFERABLE` object, the list route returns every element of that Submodel, including its value, as soon as one element matches the caller's rules. The single-element route and the full Submodel read enforce the same rule and deny access to the other elements. An authenticated caller with a READ grant for one element of a Submodel can therefore read all other elements of that Submodel. The issue is fixed in Eclipse BaSyx Go Components v1.1.3.

CVE-2026-128907.description: Missing authentication for a critical function (CWE-306) in the management service (uavmonitor_usbv1) of the 1300 communications board in DJI AeroScope Mobile (TP703) firmware 03.00.00.26, with 1300 communications board firmware 02.00.07.12 through 02.00.08.40, allows an unauthenticated attacker on the local network to read device information, such as the serial number, MAC address, IP address and radio configuration, and to change configuration settings. The service accepts commands in DJI's proprietary DUML protocol without any authentication. Exploitation requires network access to TCP port 16000 on the board and that the unit is not connected to another controlling host. The same commands are also accepted over the USB operator port. Confirmed on a physical device. NOTE: This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer. DJI has discontinued AeroScope Mobile and no fixed firmware is available.

CVE-2026-128908.description: OS command injection (CWE-78) in the network-configuration handling of the management service (uavmonitor_usbv1) of the 1300 communications board in DJI AeroScope Mobile (TP703) firmware 03.00.00.26, with 1300 communications board firmware 02.00.07.12 through 02.00.08.40, allows an unauthenticated attacker on the local network to execute arbitrary commands as root. Configuration values that can be written without authentication over the management interface are inserted unquoted into shell commands. Exploitation requires network access to TCP port 16000 on the board and that the unit is not connected to another controlling host. The injected command persists across reboots. Confirmed on a physical device. NOTE: This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer. DJI has discontinued AeroScope Mobile and no fixed firmware is available.
CVE-2026-128908.summary_ko: DJI AeroScope Mobile(TP703)의 1300 통신 보드 관리 서비스에 OS 명령어 삽입 취약점이 있어, 다른 제어 호스트에 연결되지 않은 장치에서 로컬 네트워크의 비인증 공격자가 root 권한으로 임의 명령을 실행할 수 있다. 실제 장치에서 확인됐으며 삽입된 명령은 재부팅 후에도 유지된다.
CVE-2026-128908.background_ko: 관리 인터페이스에서 인증 없이 쓸 수 있는 네트워크 설정값이 따옴표 처리 없이 셸 명령에 삽입된다.

CVE-2026-128909.description: Improper verification of cryptographic signature (CWE-347) in the firmware update handler of the management service (uavmonitor_usbv1) of the 1300 communications board in DJI AeroScope Mobile (TP703) firmware 03.00.00.26, with 1300 communications board firmware 02.00.07.12 through 02.00.08.40, allows an unauthenticated attacker on the local network to install modified firmware, which gives persistent code execution as root. The device accepts any image that matches an MD5 checksum supplied in the same request and does not verify a signature. Exploitation requires network access to TCP port 16000 on the board and that the unit is not connected to another controlling host. Reproduced by running the unmodified device binaries in emulation; not tested on a physical device. NOTE: This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer. DJI has discontinued AeroScope Mobile and no fixed firmware is available.
CVE-2026-128909.summary_ko: DJI AeroScope Mobile(TP703)의 1300 통신 보드 관리 서비스에 펌웨어 서명 검증 취약점이 있어, 다른 제어 호스트에 연결되지 않은 장치에서 로컬 네트워크의 비인증 공격자가 변조 펌웨어를 설치해 root 권한으로 코드를 지속 실행할 수 있다. 에뮬레이션에서 재현됐으며 실제 장치에서는 시험되지 않았다.
CVE-2026-128909.background_ko: 장치가 같은 요청에 포함된 MD5 체크섬과 일치하는 펌웨어 이미지를 받아들이고 암호학적 서명은 검증하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-128910.description: Use of hard-coded credentials (CWE-798) on the 1300 communications board in DJI AeroScope Mobile (TP703) firmware 03.00.00.26, with 1300 communications board firmware 02.00.07.12 through 02.00.08.40, allows an attacker with physical access to the board's serial console to log in as root. The same password hash is present on every unit and uses DES crypt, so the password can be recovered offline from the distributed firmware. No network login service accepts this password by default. Confirmed on a physical device. NOTE: This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer. DJI has discontinued AeroScope Mobile and no fixed firmware is available.

CVE-2026-128970.description: Psono Server Community Edition versions 1.12.6 through 7.5.0 and Psono Server Enterprise Edition before 7.5.1 do not require accepted group membership when authorizing deletion of group share-rights. The DELETE /share/right/ endpoint checks for a membership matching the target group, the authenticated user, and share_admin=True, but omits accepted=True. An authenticated remote attacker who has been invited to a group with share-admin privileges, and who knows a group share-right UUID, can therefore delete that group's share-right record without accepting the invitation or after declining it. Pending invitations have accepted=None, while declined invitations retain accepted=False and the share_admin flag. Deletion revokes the group's access to the affected share and its contained secrets for all accepted group members, without deleting the underlying data or disclosing secret contents. The issue was fixed in version 7.5.1 of both editions, released on 2026-10-13.

CVE-2026-128990.description: xschem 2.9.9 through 3.4.7 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in read_dataset() in src/rawtovcd.c due to an unchecked variable index. CVE-2024-58406.description: Huatian Dynamic OA8000 collaborative office system contains an unauthenticated path traversal vulnerability in /OAapp/jsp/trace/ntkodownload.jsp, where the filename request parameter is used to locate a file without restricting access to an intended directory or rejecting traversal sequences. CVE-2024-58406.background_ko: 파일 다운로드 처리에서 filename 요청 매개변수의 경로를 의도된 디렉터리로 제한하지 않고 경로 순회 문자열도 거부하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-103813.description: Dell PowerStore contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability. An authenticated user with limited privileges could potentially exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to privilege escalation to root on the appliance.
CVE-2026-103813.summary_ko: Dell PowerStore에 OS 명령 주입 취약점이 있다. 제한된 권한의 인증된 사용자가 악용하면 장비의 root 권한으로 권한을 상승시킬 수 있다.

CVE-2026-105622.description: Improper restriction of excessive authentication attempts in the WAMP-CRA (challenge-response) authentication path in Zenitel Connect before 1.11.0 allows remote attackers to guess user passwords via unlimited authentication attempts, because the path, in which the broker issues a challenge and the client returns an HMAC of it keyed with the user's secret, applies no account lockout or rate limiting. Affected releases enforce a password policy of at least 12 characters including upper-case, lower-case, numeric and special characters, so practical exploitation requires a reused or predictable password rather than exhaustive guessing. The WAMP-CRA authentication path is removed in 1.11.0.

CVE-2026-105623.description: The web interface in Zenitel Connect before 1.11.0 serves production JavaScript source maps without authentication, which allows remote attackers to obtain the complete front-end source code, including API usage and internal client logic, via requests for the source map files.

CVE-2026-105624.description: The login flow in Zenitel Connect before 1.11.0 applies per-account lockout on repeated failed login attempts, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (temporary lockout of targeted user accounts from the web interface, repeatable for as long as the attack continues) via repeated failed login requests for a known or guessed username. Intercom call handling is not affected.

CVE-2026-105625.description: The web interface in Zenitel Connect before 1.11.0 loads an integration iframe without sandboxing or origin restrictions, which allows remote attackers to present phishing content to authenticated users via a crafted frame source.

CVE-2026-105671.description: The login flow in Zenitel Connect before 1.11.0 returns different error responses depending on whether a submitted username exists, which allows remote attackers to enumerate valid user accounts via crafted login requests.

CVE-2026-109091.description: A buffer overflow in handling EDID Display-Range descriptors in X.Org xwayland before 24.1.15 and X Server before 21.1.26 could be used by malicious monitors to crash the x server or execute cote.

CVE-2026-111545.description: Dell PowerStore contains a SQL Injection vulnerability. An authenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to disclosure of stored private keys and tampering with trusted certificates.
CVE-2026-111545.summary_ko: Dell PowerStore에 SQL 주입 취약점이 있다. 인증된 공격자가 악용하면 저장된 개인 키가 노출되거나 신뢰된 인증서가 변조될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-121808.description: Improper Handling of Highly Compressed Data (Data Amplification) vulnerability in elixir-grpc grpc_core and grpc allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server memory via a compressed Erlang external term in a gRPC message body. GRPC.Codec.Erlpack.decode/2 (grpc_core/lib/grpc/codec/erlpack.ex, and lib/grpc/codec/erlpack.ex before the package split) passes the message body to :erlang.binary_to_term/2. That function inflates a compressed term in full before it returns. The codec sets no limit on the decoded size, and its type checks run only on the decoded term. The server's max_body_size limit counts the compressed bytes of the request. A request with Content-Type: application/grpc+erlpack can therefore make the server allocate a term much larger than the request body. This issue affects grpc: from 0.4.0 before 1.0.0; grpc_core: from 1.0.0 before 1.1.0.
CVE-2026-121808.summary_ko: elixir-grpc의 grpc와 grpc_core에 고압축 데이터 처리 취약점이 있어, 인증되지 않은 공격자가 압축된 Erlang 데이터가 담긴 gRPC 메시지로 서버 메모리를 고갈시킬 수 있다.
CVE-2026-121808.background_ko: 코덱이 압축 해제 크기를 제한하지 않고 전체 압축 해제 후에 유형을 검사하며, 서버의 요청 크기 제한은 압축된 바이트만 계산한다.

CVE-2026-123635.description: Missing Release of Resource after Effective Lifetime vulnerability in elixir-grpc grpc_server allows a client to stall all later calls on a shared HTTP/2 connection via calls that the server refuses while their DATA frames are in flight. The stream handler grpc_stream_h (grpc_server/src/grpc_stream_h.erl) requests flow from Cowboy only for request data that has arrived. When the server refuses a call early, for example because the body exceeds max_body_size or the method is not implemented, Cowboy drops the DATA frames still in flight for that stream. Their bytes are not returned to the connection flow-control window. After enough refused calls the window is empty. No call on that connection can then send a request body, and each call waits until its deadline. Other connections are not affected. This issue affects grpc_server: from 1.0.0 before 1.1.0.

CVE-2026-124278.description: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key vulnerability in elixir-grpc grpc_server and grpc allows an attacker to make a handler act on a resource other than the one named in the URL of an HTTP-transcoded route, via a request with a gRPC Content-Type. Only the transcoding clause of GRPC.Server.do_handle_request/4 (grpc_server/lib/grpc/server.ex, and lib/grpc/server.ex before the package split) applies the route's path bindings to the request message. The Cowboy handler picks that clause from the request Content-Type, not from the route. A request to a transcoded URL with application/grpc or application/grpc-web is decoded from the body alone, so every path-bound field takes its value from the body. A gateway, proxy rule or WAF that authorizes on the URL path sees one resource while the handler receives another. This issue affects grpc_server: from 1.0.0 before 1.1.0; grpc: from 0.8.0 before 1.0.0.

CVE-2026-126817.description: A flaw in the automatic client-side encryption schema generation of the Mongoid ODM may cause values that an application declared for encryption to be written and stored as cleartext when more than one model is mapped onto the same storage location. No error or warning is raised. A party holding an ordinary read-only database account, with no access to the encryption key material, may then obtain those values in clear form.

CVE-2026-126818.description: A Ruby object-document mapper does not apply its automatic field-level encryption configuration to certain fields when the data model uses class inheritance. Values the application designated for encryption are written to the database in readable form without any error or warning. A database account holding only read access to the application's collections, and no access to the encryption key store, may obtain those values.

CVE-2026-128034.description: In gittuf before 0.18.0, verification of file protection rules uses the quoted, escaped pathnames that Git prints by default for files with special characters (for example non-ASCII characters) instead of the raw paths. Such paths do not match patterns like file:internal/*, so the files are treated as unprotected, and a user who is not authorized by a file protection rule can change a protected file whose name contains special characters and still pass verification.

CVE-2026-128035.description: In gittuf 0.10.0 through 0.17.0, the verification workflow does not load policy updates that are propagated from an upstream (controller) repository and recorded in the reference state log after the first entry being verified. Only the propagated policy in effect at the start of verification is applied, so later controller changes to global rules, such as threshold requirements and force-push blocks, are ignored and changes that these rules should block pass verification.

CVE-2026-128036.description: In gittuf 0.4.0 through 0.16.0, when a policy update appears within the range of reference state log entries being verified, verification checks only the root of trust signatures of the new policy and not the signatures of its other metadata (rule files). A user trusted to push to the repository who bypasses gittuf policy apply and writes the policy reference and reference state log directly can make an invalid policy apply during verification, weakening or strengthening the rules for later changes. The update is still recorded in the reference state log.

CVE-2026-128037.description: In gittuf 0.10.0 through 0.15.0, when a minimum threshold global rule and a policy rule protect the same namespace, verification gives the global rule's check over all trusted users in the policy precedence over the policy rule's own authorized users. A user listed in the policy file but not authorized by the policy rule, or fewer users than the rule's threshold, can make changes to the protected namespace that pass verification.

CVE-2026-129094.description: @utcp/http before 1.1.14 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows remote manuals to reach loopback services by bypassing the remote-loopback check with a {host} placeholder. Attackers can supply host arguments like 127.0.0.1 or register tools via Streamable HTTP and SSE discovery to access internal services on the agent machine.

CVE-2026-129099.description: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to run root commands by importing a malicious OpenVPN client configuration. Attackers can include tls-verify or ipchange directives, which the incomplete denylist does not filter, to execute commands as root when the router connects to an attacker-controlled VPN endpoint.

CVE-2026-129100.description: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to execute commands as root by uploading crafted OpenVPN private or tls-auth keys. Attackers can close the inline key block with </key>, inject directives such as tls-verify that bypass the .ovpn denylist, and have OpenVPN execute the hook as root.

CVE-2026-129101.description: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a mass assignment vulnerability in the vpn.set_conf App RPC method that allows authenticated administrators to inject arbitrary OpenVPN server options. Attackers can set enabled=1 and a malicious up option in the openvpns object, which the openvpn-hotplug wrapper executes via /bin/sh as root.

CVE-2026-129102.description: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to execute commands as root by injecting newlines into the IPsec keyexchange field of the vpn.set_conf RPC method. Attackers can append a second leftupdown directive to ipsec.conf, which StrongSwan's updown plugin runs as root when an attacker-controlled peer establishes the CHILD_SA.

CVE-2026-129103.description: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to execute commands as root by injecting newlines into reboot_time. Attackers can submit a reboot_time value followed by a newline and crontab line, which /etc/init.d/autoreboot writes to the root crontab for crond to run.

CVE-2026-129104.description: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a dnsmasq configuration injection vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to inject directives by embedding a newline in the net.set_dhcp leasetime field. Attackers can append address= entries via /etc/init.d/dnsmasq to alter DNS answers for LAN clients, or insert invalid lines that stop dnsmasq.

CVE-2026-129105.description: Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains an option injection vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to inject arbitrary pppd options by embedding quotes and newlines in L2TP credentials. Attackers can submit crafted usernames or passwords to the net.set_wan RPC method, which l2tp.sh writes into a pppd options file, adding options like logfile to the root pppd process.

CVE-2026-129110.description: sysPass 3.0.1 through 3.2.11 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reinstall an already-installed instance by POSTing to the install/install handler, which never checks isInstalled(). Attackers can overwrite config.xml, point the application at an attacker-controlled database, create an administrator account, and plant serialized PublicLink gadget chains triggered via account/viewLink to execute commands.
CVE-2026-129110.summary_ko: sysPass 3.0.1~3.2.11에는 미인증 공격자가 이미 설치된 인스턴스를 다시 설치할 수 있는 인증 우회 취약점이 있다. 설정 덮어쓰기, 공격자 데이터베이스 연결, 관리자 계정 생성 및 명령 실행으로 이어질 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129110.background_ko: 설치 처리기가 isInstalled()로 기존 설치 여부를 확인하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-49341.description: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to version 1.5.1, there is a remotely reachable denial-of-service vulnerability in bacnet-stack affecting the default demo server built from the unmodified apps/server/main.c. This issue has been patched in version 1.5.1.

CVE-2026-49990.description: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. From versions 1.4.2 to before 1.4.5, and 1.5.0 to before 1.5.1, a signed fileStartPosition taken from AtomicReadFile and AtomicWriteFile stream-access requests is not validated tightly enough before it reaches the RAM file backends. Practical impact includes: reliable denial of service via process crash, out-of-bounds read that may expose adjacent memory contents, or out-of-bounds write that may corrupt heap memory and destabilize the process. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.5 and 1.5.1.

CVE-2026-52787.description: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0-rc2, a reachable out-of-bounds write exists when encoding the device.address-binding property. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0-rc2.

CVE-2026-52788.description: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0, the bsc_node_parse_urls() function in src/bacnet/datalink/bsc/bsc-node.c contains three distinct bugs when parsing space-separated WebSocket URIs from a BACnet/SC Address Resolution ACK message. Two bugs cause out-of-bounds writes past the utf8_urls[10][129] array in the static BSC_ADDRESS_RESOLUTION structure. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0.

CVE-2026-52789.description: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0, a Denial of Service (DoS) vulnerability exists in the BACnet stack's ReadPropertyMultiple (RPM) handler. When processing a malformed RPM request packet that lacks the expected closing tags, the function handler_read_property_multiple enters an infinite loop. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0.

CVE-2026-52790.description: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0, there is a library-level memory safety issue that is reachable from an unmodified official sample server (apps/server-basic/main.c) over BACnet/IP resulting in a stack-use-after-return in writable Device string properties. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0.

CVE-2026-58265.description: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0, a BACnet/SC peer can trigger a heap out-of-bounds read (up to 3 bytes), pre-authentication, in the BACnet/SC header-option decoder. bvlc_sc_decode_proprietary_option() reads the vendor-id and option-type at fixed offsets [3],[4],[5] before checking the option's declared header length, and the option-list validator never enforces a minimum length for proprietary options. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0.

CVE-2026-58498.description: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0, there is a remote global-buffer-overflow in the official router-ipv6 application shipped with bacnet-stack, this results in an out-of-bounds write to the global transmit buffer under ASan. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0.

CVE-2026-62972.description: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0, lighting_command_decode in src/bacnet/lighting.c decodes its first field with the bounded apdu_size - apdu_len, but every nested decode in the operation switch is called with the original full apdu_size while the read pointer has been advanced to &apdu[apdu_len]. The leaf decoders bound their reads against the size they are told, so they read up to apdu_len bytes past the end of the caller's buffer, resulting in an out-of-bounds read. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0.

CVE-2026-62973.description: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0, a remote out-of-bounds read exists in the official BACnet client application apps/readpropm in bacnet-stack commit e2bdbf6. When readpropm sends a legitimate ReadPropertyMultiple request to a malicious BACnet/IP peer, the peer can reply with a malformed but structurally valid ReadPropertyMultiple-ACK that drives the client into a global-buffer-overflow read on the global receive buffer Rx_Buf. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0.

CVE-2026-62974.description: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0, a malformed but non-empty BACnet WriteProperty request can drive the official server demo into a non-terminating request-processing loop with repeated heap-backed side effects. This results in a remote unauthenticated denial of service via uncontrolled resource consumption and a non-terminating request path. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0.

CVE-2026-63079.description: RBH Access Technologies Integra32 Security Management System 5.1.11 R5.0 contains an unauthenticated deserialization vulnerability in its deprecated .NET Remoting service, exposed on TCP port 2001 via the AxcvcLt.dll library using BinaryServerFormatterSinkProvider at TypeFilterLevel.Full without requiring authentication. A remote unauthenticated attacker can send a malicious serialized gadget payload (such as a ysoserial.net TypeConfuseDelegate chain) to the IntegraURI object endpoint, or exploit MarshalByRefObject/MarshalByValue unmarshalling for arbitrary file read/write and SMB/NTLMv2 credential coercion, to achieve remote code execution as NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM and fully compromise the host.
CVE-2026-63079.summary_ko: RBH Access Technologies Integra32 Security Management System 5.1.11 R5.0의 .NET Remoting 서비스에 인증 없는 역직렬화 취약점이 있다. 원격 공격자가 NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM 권한으로 코드를 실행해 호스트를 완전히 장악할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-63079.background_ko: 인증을 요구하지 않는 .NET Remoting 서비스가 BinaryServerFormatterSinkProvider를 TypeFilterLevel.Full로 사용한다.

CVE-2026-82174.description: Dell PowerStore contains a content-injection vulnerability. An unauthenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability to display misleading text on the genuine login page for phishing.

CVE-2026-95377.description: OS command injection in the TFTP provisioning module of Zenitel EdgeAudioClient before 9.6.3.0, and 10.x before 10.1.3.0, on VSFF6, VSFF8, VSFF8MP, VSFF8MN, and VSFT devices allows unauthenticated adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary commands as root via a crafted DHCP option 66 (TFTP Server Name) value supplied by a rogue DHCP server on the same network segment. The DHCP-supplied value is passed to a shell without sanitization. Devices using DHCP, the default configuration, are affected on every boot and lease renewal. The same injection is also reachable via the config_update_tftp_server and sw_update_tftp_server configuration fields by an attacker able to modify the device configuration.
CVE-2026-95377.summary_ko: Zenitel EdgeAudioClient 9.6.3.0 미만 및 10.x 중 10.1.3.0 미만 버전의 VSFF6·VSFF8·VSFF8MP·VSFF8MN·VSFT 장치에 OS 명령 주입 취약점이 있다. 같은 네트워크 구간의 인증되지 않은 공격자가 root 권한으로 임의 명령을 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-95377.background_ko: TFTP 프로비저닝 모듈이 DHCP로 받은 TFTP 서버 이름 값을 정제하지 않고 셸에 전달한다.

CVE-2026-95378.description: Path traversal in the certificate upload endpoint (/api/certificate/upload) of the turbineweb web interface in Zenitel VSFF6, VSFF8, VSFF8MP, VSFF8MN, and VSFT devices with software versions from 10.0.3.0 before 10.1.3.0 allows authenticated administrators to write arbitrary files as root via a crafted filename parameter in a multipart upload request when the type field is set to any value other than https_certificate. In that case, both path validation and certificate content validation are skipped. This can be escalated to arbitrary code execution as root, for example by overwriting startup scripts or planting SSH keys.

CVE-2026-95379.description: Path traversal in the certificate.deleteCertificate JSON-RPC method (POST /api/rpc) of the turbineweb web interface in Zenitel VSFF6, VSFF8, VSFF8MP, VSFF8MN, and VSFT devices with software versions from 10.0.3.0 before 10.1.3.0 allows authenticated administrators to delete arbitrary files as root via a relative path (../) in the file_name parameter. This can be used to cause denial of service or render the device inoperable by removing critical system files, and to weaken device security by removing files such as firewall rules or certificate trust stores.

CVE-2026-95613.description: The pREST database REST API in Zenitel Connect firmware before 1.11.0 signs and verifies JWTs with the platform CA private key, which is stored on a data volume shared between containers, and sets the PostgreSQL session role from the unvalidated sub claim of each request while connected to the database as the "postgres" superuser, which allows local attackers who can read the platform CA private key from the container filesystem to execute database operations as the PostgreSQL superuser, including reading the master encryption key and password hashes, via a forged JWT with sub=postgres sent to the pREST API.

CVE-2026-95614.description: The host configuration watcher in Zenitel Connect before 1.11.0 applies a rsyslog configuration file written to a data volume that is shared with the hiatus application container, which allows local attackers with write access to the hiatus container filesystem to execute arbitrary OS commands as root on the host operating system via a crafted rsyslog configuration file.
CVE-2026-95614.summary_ko: Zenitel Connect 1.11.0 이전 버전에서 hiatus 컨테이너 파일시스템에 쓰기 권한이 있는 로컬 공격자가 호스트 운영체제에서 root 권한으로 임의 명령을 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-95614.background_ko: 호스트 설정 감시기가 hiatus 애플리케이션 컨테이너와 공유하는 데이터 볼륨의 rsyslog 설정 파일을 적용한다.

CVE-2026-95615.description: OS command injection vulnerability in audio messages API in Zenitel Connect before 1.11.0 allows remote authenticated users to execute arbitrary OS commands as root in the hiatus application container via filename parameter to the /api/system/audio_messages endpoint.

CVE-2026-121809.description: Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop') vulnerability in elixir-grpc grpc_server and grpc allows unauthenticated attackers to occupy a BEAM scheduler indefinitely via a client-streaming or bidirectional-streaming request whose body ends inside a gRPC message. GRPC.Server.Adapters.Cowboy.read_stream/1 (grpc_server/lib/grpc/server/adapters/cowboy.ex, and the Cowboy adapter in grpc before the package split) asks for more data whenever the buffer does not hold a complete message. Once the request body has ended, every further read returns an empty chunk, so the buffer never changes and the function retries without end. A single 5-byte length prefix sent with END_STREAM keeps one scheduler busy for as long as the connection stays open, and repeated requests exhaust all schedulers. This issue affects grpc_server: from 1.0.0 before 1.1.0; grpc: from 0.3.1 before 1.0.0.
CVE-2026-121809.summary_ko: elixir-grpc의 grpc_server 1.0.0 이상 1.1.0 미만과 grpc 0.3.1 이상 1.0.0 미만에서 비인증 공격자가 스트리밍 요청 처리 중 무한 루프를 유발할 수 있다. BEAM 스케줄러를 무기한 점유해 서비스 거부로 이어질 수 있다.
CVE-2026-121809.background_ko: 불완전한 gRPC 메시지 상태로 요청 본문이 끝나면 추가 읽기가 빈 청크를 반환하지만, 수신 함수는 변하지 않는 버퍼로 읽기를 계속 재시도한다.

CVE-2026-124279.description: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in elixir-grpc grpc_server allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server memory via client-streaming or bidirectional-streaming requests. The streaming read clause of GRPC.Server.Adapters.Cowboy.Handler.info/3 (grpc_server/lib/grpc/server/adapters/cowboy/handler.ex) asks Cowboy for up to 8,000,000 bytes per read and compares the running total with max_body_size only after the read returns. The gRPC length prefix of a message is not checked before the message is buffered. Each stream can therefore buffer up to one full read beyond the configured limit before it is refused, and many concurrent streams exhaust node memory. Releases before 1.0.6 apply no limit to streaming requests at all. This issue affects grpc_server: from 1.0.0 before 1.1.0.
CVE-2026-124279.summary_ko: elixir-grpc의 grpc_server에 자원 할당 제한 미흡 취약점이 있어, 인증되지 않은 공격자가 클라이언트 스트리밍 또는 양방향 스트리밍 요청으로 서버 메모리를 고갈시킬 수 있다.
CVE-2026-124279.background_ko: 스트리밍 데이터를 읽은 뒤에만 누적 크기를 제한값과 비교하고 버퍼링 전에 메시지 길이를 검사하지 않으며, 1.0.6 이전 릴리스에는 스트리밍 요청 제한이 없다.

CVE-2026-128986.description: In Eclipse BaSyx Go Components versions up to and including 1.1.3, ABAC-enabled deployments match `ROUTE` access rules against the fully decoded request path, while the router routes on the raw, still encoded path. An encoded slash (`%2F`) inside a path value is a segment separator for the access check but part of the value for the router, so a request can match a narrow `ROUTE` rule while the handler returns a different, larger resource. An authenticated caller whose rules grant READ only on parts of a resource can therefore read the whole resource. In the DPP API, a rule such as `/v1/dpps/*/elements/*`, meant to grant only passport elements, also grants the complete passport whose identifier contains `/elements/`. In the Submodel Repository, AAS Repository and AAS Environment, a rule such as `/submodels/*/submodel-elements/*/attachment`, meant to grant only file attachments, also grants the complete element whose stored idShort contains `%2F`. The issue is fixed in Eclipse BaSyx Go Components v1.1.4.

CVE-2026-129116.description: C-Kermit from 7.0.197 before 11.1.515 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the IKSD SSL build that leaves Telnet authentication state at AUTH_VALID after a refused certificate login. Attackers holding a trusted certificate mapped to a refused account can log in as any other account with any password, gaining that account's shell access.

CVE-2026-129117.description: C-Kermit 8.0.200 before 11.1.515 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability that allows machine-in-the-middle attackers to impersonate Telnet servers because ssl_reply() never calls ssl_check_server_name(). Attackers can refuse START-TLS, offer Telnet AUTHENTICATION SSL, and present any trusted CA certificate to capture user credentials and session data.

CVE-2026-129118.description: C-Kermit 8.0.200 before 11.1.515 contains an improper certificate hostname validation vulnerability that allows attackers to impersonate hosts by abusing wildcard matching in dNSName_cmp() in ck_ssl.c. Attackers holding a trusted certificate with over-matching names containing asterisks, question marks, brackets, or empty labels can intercept credentials and data over Telnet, FTP, and HTTP TLS connections.

CVE-2026-129119.description: C-Kermit from 6.0.192 before 11.1.515 contains a file collision protection bypass that allows malicious senders to append data to existing files by marking transfers as RESEND. The gattr() function in ckcfn3.c clears the REJECT discard flag and switches to APPEND without a RECEIVE CONFIRM prompt, letting attackers modify files such as shell startup files.

CVE-2026-129120.description: C-Kermit 11.0.506 before 11.1.515 contains a RECEIVE CONFIRM bypass vulnerability that allows malicious Kermit servers to write unrequested files without prompting by abusing recursive GET root computation in ckcfns.c. Attackers can send files such as .ssh/authorized_keys or shell startup files under the current directory, which rq_under_root() accepts silently, enabling persistent access or code execution.

CVE-2026-129121.description: C-Kermit 8.0.200 before 11.1.515 contains a path traversal vulnerability in doftpget() in ckcftp.c that allows malicious FTP servers to write files outside the intended directory. Attackers can return absolute paths, tilde names, or dot-dot components in NLST or MLSD listings during MGET /RECURSIVE to overwrite files like .bashrc, leading to code execution.

CVE-2026-129122.description: C-Kermit 6.0.192 before 11.1.515 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in tn_snenv() in ckctel.c that allows malicious Telnet servers to corrupt client memory via crafted NEW-ENVIRON SEND subnegotiation. Malicious or machine-in-the-middle servers can send oversized variable names before authentication, overflowing a 16-byte stack buffer and a miscomputed heap buffer to corrupt stack and heap memory.

CVE-2026-129123.description: C-Kermit 8.0.200 before 11.1.515 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in getreply() in ckcftp.c that allows malicious FTP servers to overwrite client memory by sending overlong security replies. Attackers controlling or intercepting an FTP server can send long PBSZ replies after AUTH TLS, or long ADAT replies in GSSAPI, Kerberos 4, and SRP builds, overflowing the static reply_buf with attacker-controlled bytes.

CVE-2026-129124.description: C-Kermit before 11.1.515 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows remote clients to execute shell commands by supplying unquoted arguments to REMOTE WHO or REMOTE SPACE. Attackers can append shell metacharacters to arguments passed through WHOCMD or SPACM2 to syscmd(), executing commands on the server host even when DISABLE HOST is set.
CVE-2026-129124.summary_ko: C-Kermit 11.1.515 이전 버전에는 OS 명령 삽입 취약점이 있다. 원격 클라이언트가 DISABLE HOST 설정이 적용된 상태에서도 서버 호스트에서 셸 명령을 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129124.background_ko: REMOTE WHO와 REMOTE SPACE의 인수가 따옴표로 감싸지지 않은 채 WHOCMD 또는 SPACM2를 거쳐 syscmd()에 전달된다.

CVE-2026-129125.description: C-Kermit 6.0.192 before 11.1.515 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows Kermit clients to run shell commands on servers with host commands disabled by abusing REMOTE QUERY evaluation. Attackers can send a REMOTE QUERY invoking the command function, or define a macro via REMOTE ASSIGN and call execute to reach RUN, bypassing the nopush restriction and DISABLE HOST.
CVE-2026-129125.summary_ko: C-Kermit 6.0.192 이상 11.1.515 미만 버전에는 원격 코드 실행 취약점이 있다. Kermit 클라이언트가 nopush와 DISABLE HOST 제한을 우회해 서버에서 셸 명령을 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129125.background_ko: REMOTE QUERY 평가와 매크로 실행 경로에서 명령 실행 기능에 접근할 수 있어 nopush 및 DISABLE HOST 제한이 우회된다.

CVE-2026-129126.description: C-Kermit before 11.1.515 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in putsrv() in ckcfns.c that allows malicious peers to write past the srvcmd buffer by sending crafted packets. Attackers can use Kermit repeat-count compression in server command, GET, or file-header packets to write attacker-chosen bytes beyond the heap buffer on servers or receiving instances.
CVE-2026-129126.summary_ko: C-Kermit 11.1.515 이전 버전의 putsrv()에 힙 버퍼 오버플로 취약점이 있다. 악성 통신 상대가 서버나 수신 인스턴스에서 힙 버퍼 밖에 자신이 지정한 바이트를 쓰게 할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129126.background_ko: putsrv()가 Kermit 반복 횟수 압축이 포함된 패킷을 처리하면서 srvcmd 힙 버퍼 범위를 넘어 데이터를 쓸 수 있다.

CVE-2026-129127.description: SQLBot through 1.10.3 contains a weak password hashing vulnerability that stores local account passwords in sys_user.password as unsalted MD5 digests via md5pwd() in security.py. Attackers who obtain the user table can recover passwords, including administrator passwords, using precomputed tables or GPU cracking, since identical passwords produce identical hashes.

CVE-2026-129128.description: Goose CLI 1.35.0 before 1.53.0 contains a local code execution vulnerability that allows attackers to run commands by setting diff.external in a repository's .git/config. Attackers can ship a crafted repository that, when the victim runs goose review, executes git diff without --no-ext-diff, running commands as the user and exposing credentials and provider API keys.
CVE-2026-129128.summary_ko: Goose CLI 1.35.0 이상 1.53.0 미만 버전에는 로컬 코드 실행 취약점이 있다. 악성 저장소를 검토할 때 사용자 권한으로 명령이 실행돼 자격 증명과 제공업체 API 키가 노출될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129128.background_ko: 저장소 검토 시 외부 diff 실행을 차단하는 옵션 없이 git diff를 실행하는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-129129.description: AiSOC 12.1.0 before 23.3.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to query the enrichment service through Next.js console rewrite routes. Attackers can send requests to /api/v1/enrichment/lookup or /api/v1/enrichment/bulk to retrieve threat-intelligence results and set force to true to consume commercial provider API quota.

CVE-2026-129130.description: agent-device from 0.21.36 before 0.21.37 contains a local file disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated remote callers to read daemon-host files by opening file:// URLs. Attackers can send an open command with a file:// target through /rpc, then issue snapshot to read any plaintext file readable by the daemon account.

CVE-2026-129131.description: Gameyfin before 2.6.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass login-required mode by calling Hilla endpoints annotated with @AnonymousAllowed. Attackers can POST to synchronous endpoint methods such as GameEndpoint.sync, which LiveSubscriptionSecurity never checks, to retrieve game catalog metadata, libraries, platforms, plugins and game requests.

CVE-2026-129132.description: MRBS before 1.13.0 contains an LDAP injection vulnerability in web/lib/MRBS/Auth/AuthLdap.php that interpolates unescaped login usernames into DN search and group-membership filters. Attackers with valid directory credentials outside the required group can submit crafted usernames that make the group filter always true, bypassing access restrictions.

CVE-2026-129133.description: MRBS before 1.13.0 contains a CSV formula injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject spreadsheet formulas because the escape() function in web/report.php fails to neutralize leading formula characters. Attackers can store formulas in booking names, descriptions or custom fields that execute when privileged users open exported CSV reports, enabling data exfiltration or command execution via DDE.

CVE-2026-129134.description: MRBS before 1.13.0 contains a password reset poisoning vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect reset links by forging the Host header when $url_base is unset. Attackers can request a reset for a victim so AuthDb::notifyUser() emails a link pointing to their host, capturing the reset key when opened to take over accounts including administrators.

CVE-2026-129135.description: picoquic before 2026.11.05.3e2e3d3 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in picoquic_decode_time_stamp_frame() that allows remote QUIC peers to corrupt stored timestamps by sending oversized TIME_STAMP values. Attackers on connections negotiating the TIME_STAMP extension can send large values shifted by ack_delay_exponent to wrap the result, corrupting RTT and bandwidth estimation and degrading congestion control.

CVE-2026-63150.description: Omnispace Agora Project through 26.10.0 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows remote attackers to forge privileged actions such as administrator user creation by merging $_GET and $_POST parameters without requiring an anti-CSRF token. Attackers can craft a malicious link or auto-navigating page that issues a plain GET request, exploiting the lack of CSRF protection and SameSite=Lax cookie behavior on top-level navigations to create unauthorized administrator accounts.

CVE-2026-63151.description: Omnispace Agora Project through 26.10.0 contains a predictable token generation vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access private calendar data by exploiting a missing dateCrea value that causes the md5Id token to collapse to md5(calendarId.userId), both small enumerable integers. Attackers can compute valid tokens and request the misc&action=DisplayIcal endpoint with a forged md5Id to read any user's private calendar events without authentication.

CVE-2026-63155.description: Omnispace Agora Project through 26.10.0 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows remote attackers to redirect users to arbitrary external URLs by manipulating the objUrl parameter in Ctrl.php's redir() function. Attackers can craft login links with objUrl set to a malicious site, causing the application to issue an HTTP 302 redirect to that external URL, which can be abused for phishing and credential theft.

CVE-2026-63164.description: Omnispace Agora Project through 26.10.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to access another user's private mail by supplying a crafted reloadMailTypeId parameter to Ctrl::getCurObj() without a readRight() ownership check in CtrlMail.php. Attackers can manipulate the mail identifier value, such as reloadMailTypeId=mail-1, to retrieve the title and body of private messages belonging to other users, resulting in unauthorized disclosure of sensitive communications.

CVE-2026-63166.description: Omnispace Agora Project through 26.10.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject malicious HTML markup by controlling imported directory data or an uploaded CSV file, as values are rendered into table cell text and value attributes after only Txt::utf8Encode() with no HTML escaping in VuePersonsImportExport.php. Attackers can craft a CSV cell containing an attribute-breakout payload that is rendered verbatim and executed in the browser of the administrator performing the import, leading to arbitrary script execution in the administrative context.

CVE-2026-63167.description: Omnispace Agora Project through 26.10.0 contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated general administrators to inject arbitrary SQL by setting the personsSort session value, which is concatenated unsanitized into ORDER BY clauses in MdlUser.php and MdlSpace.php. Attackers can submit an error-based extractvalue payload through personsSort to leak database information, such as the MariaDB version, via the user and space listing pages.

CVE-2026-63170.description: Omnispace Agora Project through 26.10.0 contains a predictable token generation vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge the shared-calendar iCal share token by deriving md5Id() from predictable fields such as object creation time, which is self-disclosed through autorDate and the iCal CREATED field. Attackers can compute the creation minute and forge the md5Id token to access and read a shared calendar's iCal feed without authorization.

CVE-2026-107398.description: Indico is a feature-rich event management system. Prior to version 3.3.14, due to a path traversal vulnerability when building an "offline copy" of an event, a malicious event manager has the ability to retrieve the content of any local file that's readable by the user running Indico on the server. This issue has been patched in version 3.3.14.

CVE-2026-123177.description: A flaw was found in dnf5daemon-server. Unauthenticated D-Bus methods pass caller-controlled URL or .rpm path patterns into a root-privileged cmdline package loader that may store fetched content in a world-readable cache without size limits, or open local paths as root, allowing a local attacker to disclose privileged content and to deny service via disk exhaustion.
CVE-2026-123177.summary_ko: dnf5daemon-server에서 로컬 공격자가 인증되지 않은 D-Bus 메서드를 통해 높은 권한이 필요한 내용을 유출하거나 디스크 고갈로 서비스 거부를 유발할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-123177.background_ko: 인증 없는 D-Bus 메서드가 호출자 지정 URL·RPM 경로 패턴을 root 권한 로더에 넘기며, 로더는 용량 제한 없이 누구나 읽는 캐시에 저장하거나 로컬 경로를 root로 연다.

CVE-2026-123965.description: A prompt injection vulnerability in all versions of Jet Admin Cloud Platform allows a remote attacker with a free account to expose sensitive .env configuration files and exfiltrate critical credentials. Mitigated via sandbox component around October 29, 2026.
CVE-2026-123965.summary_ko: Jet Admin Cloud Platform 모든 버전에 프롬프트 인젝션 취약점이 있다. 무료 계정을 보유한 원격 공격자가 민감한 .env 설정 파일을 노출하고 중요 자격 증명을 유출할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-124041.description: Catalis/Patriot Properties WebPro 5.0 allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary SQL queries against the underlying MSSQL database, enabling exfiltration of sensitive property and taxpayer information.
CVE-2026-124041.summary_ko: Catalis/Patriot Properties WebPro 5.0에서 원격의 인증되지 않은 공격자가 기반 MSSQL 데이터베이스에 임의 SQL 쿼리를 실행할 수 있다. 이로 인해 민감한 부동산·납세자 정보가 유출될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-124666.description: Authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability in Apache APISIX. On a route where multi-auth falls back from wolf-rbac to another successful authenticator, client-supplied Wolf identity headers can remain in the request. A downstream service that relies on those documented headers may therefore receive an identity that was not established by the successful authenticator. This issue affects Apache APISIX: from 3.8.0 through 3.19.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.20.0, which fixes the issue.
CVE-2026-124666.summary_ko: Apache APISIX 3.8.0~3.19.0에서 multi-auth가 wolf-rbac 대신 다른 인증기로 인증에 성공할 때 신원 위조에 의한 인증 우회가 발생할 수 있다. Wolf 신원 헤더를 신뢰하는 하위 서비스에 성공한 인증기가 확인하지 않은 신원이 전달될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-124666.background_ko: multi-auth가 wolf-rbac에서 다른 인증기로 전환해 인증에 성공해도 클라이언트가 보낸 Wolf 신원 헤더가 요청에 남을 수 있다.
