CVE-2026-124679.description: Authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability in Apache APISIX. On routes using jwe-decrypt with strict: false and a forward_header distinct from the token header an unauthenticated client can supply the value the upstream treats as gateway-decrypted plaintext. Similar can happen when forward-auth is configured with allow_degradation: true, and the auth service is unavailable. This issue affects Apache APISIX: from 3.18.0 through 3.19.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.20.0, which fixes the issue.
CVE-2026-124679.summary_ko: Apache APISIX 3.18.0~3.19.0에 스푸핑을 통한 인증 우회 취약점이 있다. 특정 jwe-decrypt 설정이나 인증 서비스 장애 시의 forward-auth 설정에서, 인증되지 않은 클라이언트가 업스트림이 게이트웨이 복호화 결과로 신뢰하는 값을 제공할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-124679.background_ko: jwe-decrypt에서 strict가 false이고 forward_header가 토큰 헤더와 다르거나, forward-auth에서 allow_degradation이 true인 상태로 인증 서비스가 중단되면 문제가 발생한다.

CVE-2026-124680.description: Interpretation Conflict, resulting in (Incorrect Authorization) vulnerability in Apache APISIX. An unauthenticated client can reach upstream paths protected by a route-level auth plugin when a route without auth exists on the same upstream and the upstream does not collapse encoded dot segments. This issue affects Apache APISIX: from 0.9 through 3.19.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.20.0, which fixes the issue.
CVE-2026-124680.summary_ko: Apache APISIX 0.9~3.19.0에 경로 해석 불일치로 인한 인가 오류 취약점이 있다. 특정 경로 구성에서는 인증되지 않은 클라이언트가 경로 수준 인증 플러그인으로 보호된 업스트림 경로에 접근할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-124680.background_ko: 동일 업스트림에 인증 없는 경로가 있고 업스트림이 인코딩된 점 세그먼트를 정규화하지 않을 때 경로 해석이 불일치한다.

CVE-2026-124716.description: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Apache APISIX. An authenticated user who holds any one of a route's required permissions or scopes can reach the protected upstream without the others, including HTTP methods the authorization server denied. This issue affects Apache APISIX: from 1.4.0 through 3.19.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.20.0, which fixes the issue.
CVE-2026-124716.summary_ko: Apache APISIX 1.4.0~3.19.0의 잘못된 인가 처리로, 인증된 사용자가 경로의 필수 권한·범위 중 하나만 보유해도 보호된 업스트림에 접근할 수 있다. 인가 서버가 거부한 HTTP 메서드도 사용할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-124716.background_ko: 경로에 필요한 권한이나 범위 중 하나만 보유해도 나머지 요건을 충족하지 않은 상태에서 접근이 허용된다.

CVE-2026-124719.description: Authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability in Apache APISIX. When a Route's configured headers carry a caller identity and the OpenAPI document declares the same header, a caller can act as another identity against the upstream API. This issue affects Apache APISIX: from 3.19.0 before 3.20.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.20.0, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-124723.description: Interpretation Conflict, leading to Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Apache APISIX. With match_uri_encoded_slash enabled and skip_mtls_uri_regex configured, a client without a certificate can reach an upstream behind a route that requires one, limited to request paths that decode to an exempted URI. This issue affects Apache APISIX: from 3.18.0 through 3.19.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.20.0, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-124726.description: Relative Path Traversal, with Unintended Proxy vulnerability in Apache APISIX. A caller of the MCP endpoint can invoke endpoints the OpenAPI document never declared, under the declared tool's HTTP method, using the credentials the Route adds. This issue affects Apache APISIX: from 3.19.0 before 3.20.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.20.0, which fixes the issue.
CVE-2026-124726.summary_ko: Apache APISIX 3.19.0 이상 3.20.0 미만에 상대 경로 탐색 및 의도하지 않은 프록시 취약점이 있다. MCP 엔드포인트 호출자가 선언된 도구의 HTTP 메서드와 Route가 추가한 자격 증명으로 OpenAPI 문서에 없는 엔드포인트를 호출할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-126091.description: Dental practice sites hosted with iDentalSoft send a JSON response to any user who loads certain pages containing sensitive information, including OAuth credentials, password hashes, and PII. Fixed in iDentalSoft 14.0.3.
CVE-2026-126091.summary_ko: iDentalSoft로 호스팅되는 치과 웹사이트는 특정 페이지에 접속한 모든 사용자에게 민감정보가 담긴 JSON 응답을 보낸다. OAuth 자격 증명, 비밀번호 해시, 개인정보가 노출되며 iDentalSoft 14.0.3에서 수정됐다.

CVE-2026-128068.description: rails-html-sanitizer is responsible for sanitizing HTML fragments in Rails applications. From 1.0.3 through 1.7.1, Rails::HTML::PermitScrubber checks SVG href and xlink:href local references with a pattern whose line-start anchor and whitespace class cause an all-whitespace value to be rescanned from each line start. An attacker who supplies HTML can cause quadratic CPU consumption when an application customizes its allowed tags to include an SVG reference element such as use and permits href or xlink:href. The default allowed tag configuration is not affected. CRuby 3.2 and later uses linear-time regular expression matching for this pattern, while CRuby 3.1 and earlier and JRuby are affected. This issue is fixed in version 1.7.2.

CVE-2026-128069.description: rails-html-sanitizer is responsible for sanitizing HTML fragments in Rails applications. Before 1.7.2, the HTML4 and HTML5 variants of Rails::HTML::SafeListSanitizer reuse one Rails::HTML::PermitScrubber across calls and mutate its tags and attributes without synchronization. In a multithreaded process, concurrent sanitize calls using different tags: or attributes: options can interleave and cause one call to use the other call's allowlist. If a permissive call admits a script element or event-handler attribute, output expected to be sanitized under a stricter policy can retain it and cause cross-site scripting when rendered. Applications that are single-threaded, use one identical allowlist everywhere, or provide a separate scrubber: are not affected. This issue is fixed in version 1.7.2.

CVE-2026-128070.description: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. From 3.5.0 until 4.6.4, Nuxt can choose a parent directory as the default workspaceDir in either of two cases: a stray parent lockfile when the project is outside a Git repository and has no workspace file above it, or a parent pnpm or Deno settings file that does not declare packages or a workspace, including when the project is inside a Git repository. When the development server is reachable from an untrusted network, Vite permits /_nuxt/@fs/ requests beneath that widened directory, allowing unauthenticated clients to read files such as credentials and SSH keys. The issue affects the development server only; production builds and projects whose parent directories contain no qualifying files are unaffected. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.4.

CVE-2026-128071.description: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. Nuxt from 3.0.0 until 4.6.4, @nuxt/nitro-server from 3.20.0 until 4.6.4, and @nuxt/vite-server from 4.6.0 until 4.6.4, routeRules matching leaves an encoded slash (%2F) in the request path while a catch-all page such as app/pages/[...slug].vue or a custom multi-segment page route decodes it into a route parameter. The getRouteRules result is therefore incomplete, and an unauthenticated request can render the page without the redirect, headers, proxy, SSR, noScripts, appMiddleware, or appLayout rules configured for the decoded path. Protected content is resolved only when the page interprets the decoded parameter accordingly: a custom multi-segment parameter can contain the decoded path, while a repeatable catch-all must join the slash-containing array element; route.path remains encoded and does not resolve that resource. Static pages, single-segment parameters, server/api handlers, and server/routes handlers are not affected because they do not have the same encoded-path mismatch. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.4.

CVE-2026-128072.description: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. From @nuxt/webpack-builder 3.0.0 and @nuxt/rspack-builder 3.12.2 until 4.6.4, the development middleware trusts Origin, Referer, or Sec-Fetch-Site when the Host header names the same attacker-controlled hostname. After DNS rebinding changes that hostname to a loopback address, a malicious page opened by a developer can read /_nuxt/*.js client chunks and inline source maps, exposing compiled application source, local filesystem paths, and developer-controlled values embedded in the client bundle. The attacker must know or guess the development-server port and induce the developer to open the malicious page; Chrome 142 and later and other Chromium-based browsers that enforce Local Network Access restrictions prompt before a public page can reach the loopback address. The default Vite builder and production builds are unaffected. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.4.

CVE-2026-128074.description: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. From 4.6.0 until 4.6.4, _payload.json URL generation and the experimental early-404 path use a trailing-slash regular expression whose work grows quadratically with a long run of slash characters. An unauthenticated request can synchronously occupy the Node.js event loop and delay other requests when server-side rendering uses isr, swr, or cache route rules, or when experimental.early404 is enabled. Applications without those route rules and without experimental.early404, fully prerendered applications, and client-only applications are unaffected; the impact is limited to availability. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.4.

CVE-2026-128075.description: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. From 3.0.0 until 4.6.4, Nuxt wraps non-HTTP errors thrown during server rendering with createError and incorrectly treats the result as an error deliberately exposed by the application. In production, the error page payload (__NUXT_DATA__) and JSON error response can therefore disclose the original message and data, including an upstream $fetch URL, query-string secrets, response bodies, database hosts, or similar sensitive details, regardless of what a custom error.vue renders. Errors deliberately created with createError or showError, errors returned by useFetch or useAsyncData, and server/api routes are not affected because their client-visible behavior is intentional or follows a different path. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.4.

CVE-2026-128076.description: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. From 3.21.6 to before 4.0.0 and from 4.4.6 until 4.6.4, the /__nuxt_island path hash uses ohash serialization that does not escape quotes in string values or delimiters in object keys, allowing different island-prop tuples to produce the same path. For prerendering, substituted content is written into the generated page only if the crawler reaches a colliding URL before rendering the page with the legitimate props. Separately, a CDN or reverse proxy that keys island responses by path alone can be primed with the colliding response. If the substituted prop reaches v-html, innerHTML, or another unsafe HTML sink, the response can execute script in the application origin; otherwise the impact is content substitution. Applications that do not use server components or NuxtIsland, islands without attacker-influenced string props, and responses not cached by path alone are unaffected. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.4.

CVE-2026-128077.description: Nuxt is an open-source web development framework for Vue.js. From 4.6.0 until 4.6.4, Nuxt parses a request path beginning with // as a URL host before rendering a page, while Nitro server/middleware and routeRules continue to evaluate the original path. An unauthenticated request such as //x/admin can therefore resolve to the /admin page without route-scoped serverHandlers, server/middleware path checks, redirects, or security headers configured for /admin. API handlers in server/api and server/routes, appMiddleware, page middleware are unaffected. This issue is fixed in version 4.6.4.
CVE-2026-128077.summary_ko: Nuxt 4.6.0 이상 4.6.4 미만에서 비인증 요청이 경로 해석 불일치로 페이지별 서버 처리기, 미들웨어 경로 검사, 리디렉션 및 보안 헤더를 우회할 수 있다. API 처리기와 앱·페이지 미들웨어는 영향을 받지 않는다.
CVE-2026-128077.background_ko: 이중 슬래시로 시작하는 요청 경로를 Nuxt는 URL 호스트로 해석하지만 Nitro 서버·미들웨어와 routeRules는 원래 경로로 평가한다.

CVE-2026-128078.description: GLPI is a free asset and IT management software package. From 9.5.0 until 10.0.27 and 11.0.9, authenticated users could access ITIL followups, tasks, or solutions generated from templates without a read-permission check on the parent ticket, problem, or change. Depending on the template configuration, this could reveal information from parent items the user could not otherwise read. This issue is fixed in versions 10.0.27 and 11.0.9.

CVE-2026-128079.description: envd provides reproducible development environments for humans and agents. In versions starting with 0.3.38 and before 1.3.6, insufficient containment of host-side requirements-file reads in install.python_packages(requirements=...) could allow access to files outside the build context. An attacker able to influence build input could cause file contents interpreted as dependency entries to appear in debug logs or build-step metadata, subject to the envd process’s permissions. Exploitation in version 1.3.5 additionally requires concurrent modification of relevant filesystem paths. This issue is fixed in version 1.3.6.

CVE-2026-129139.description: paicoding from commit b8206b9 through commit 903adce uses predictable credentials for accounts created via ZSXQ login, because loginByZsxq derives both the username and password solely from the member's ZSXQ number. Unauthenticated attackers can read that number from the victim's /user/{userId} profile page, compute the credentials, and log in via /login/username to take over the account.

CVE-2026-129140.description: paicoding 1.0.0 through 1.0.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in image upload because ImageServiceImpl.validateStaticImg accepts SVG files, which are then served from the site origin when local storage is used. Authenticated attackers can upload script-bearing SVG images that execute when victims view them, stealing the non-HttpOnly f-session cookie to hijack accounts.

CVE-2026-129141.description: paicoding 1.0.0 through 1.0.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because SeoInjectService embeds user profile text without escaping in an inline JSON-LD script element. Authenticated attackers can add a closing script tag followed by HTML to their profile, executing scripts for visitors of their profile page and stealing the non-HttpOnly f-session cookie.

CVE-2026-129142.description: paicoding commit 766c48b through commit 903adce contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in payment notifications, where NotifyMsgListener inserts the payer's display name unescaped and notify-system-item.html renders it via th:utext. Authenticated attackers can set a malicious display name and start a pending payment on a paid article, executing script in the author's browser when the author views notifications.

CVE-2026-129143.description: paicoding 1.0.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the ArticleRestController article detail endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to read restricted articles. Attackers can enumerate article IDs via GET /article/api/data/detail/{articleId} to retrieve full content of paid, login-only, member-only and draft articles.

CVE-2026-129144.description: paicoding 1.0.3 contains a payment bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to unlock paid articles by guessing weak payment confirmation codes. Attackers can start a payment, enumerate roughly 2000 IdUtil.genPayCode counter values, and submit the matching verifyCode to the unauthenticated callback to mark it paid.

CVE-2026-129151.description: SurveyKing 1.13.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in result lookup: the anonymous survey view leaks the lookup configuration, including its password, and the lookup password check is skipped when no answer is sent. Unauthenticated attackers with a public survey link can inject a % wildcard into the MyBatis LIKE condition to match all responses, then call loadProject with an answerId to read complete responses including hidden fields.

CVE-2026-129152.description: SurveyKing 1.12.0 through 1.13.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to submit survey responses because AnswerServiceImpl.saveAnswer skips login-required and survey password checks. Attackers can submit responses to protected surveys and set createBy in the request body to impersonate other users, corrupting survey results.

CVE-2026-129153.description: SurveyKing 1.12.0 through 1.13.2 contains an authorization bypass in the linked survey feature that fails to verify the referenced linkSurveyId belongs to the caller's own project. Authenticated attackers can point a linked option at another user's survey so that loadLinkResult and updateLinkSurveyAnswer read, rewrite, or create responses in that survey.

CVE-2026-129154.description: SurveyKing 1.13.0 through 1.13.2 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because the server accepts a respondent-supplied survey snapshot and the frontend renders its titles via innerHTML. Anonymous respondents can submit a forged snapshot embedding event handlers such as img onerror that execute in an administrator's browser session when the response is viewed.

CVE-2026-129155.description: DjangoBlog 2.0.0.0 through 2.1.0.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because the class_filter comment sanitizer passes event-handler attributes on span, div, pre and code tags. Authenticated commenters can post a div with autofocus and onfocus attributes, executing script without interaction for every visitor, including administrators.

CVE-2026-129156.description: DjangoBlog commit d186b1c through commit 6134ed6 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated OAuth users to inject script via an unescaped nickname in comment reactions. Attackers can set their OAuth display name to a payload closing the single-quoted data-reactions attribute, then react to a comment to execute script in article visitors' browsers.

CVE-2026-129157.description: ragent 1.0.0 through 1.1.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in RagTraceController that allows any logged-in user to view all users' RAG traces. Attackers can page through /rag/traces/runs and related node endpoints to read other users' usernames, user ids, conversation ids, questions, and per-node execution details.

CVE-2026-129158.description: ragent 1.1.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject scripts by uploading SVG knowledge-base documents served inline as image/svg+xml. Attackers can upload a script-bearing SVG via /knowledge-base/{kb-id}/docs/upload so that victims opening /knowledge-base/docs/{docId}/file execute it in the application origin, enabling account takeover.

CVE-2026-129160.description: free-fs 2.0.1 through 2.3.1 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in FileShareServiceImpl.getPages, which passes the orderBy parameter of the /apis/share/pages endpoint verbatim into the ORDER BY clause via MyBatis-Flex without a column whitelist. Authenticated users can supply CASE WHEN subquery expressions that use share ordering as a boolean oracle to read arbitrary database contents, such as share codes.

CVE-2026-129161.description: Dromara free-fs 2.0.1 through 2.3.1 contains an improper restriction of authentication attempts vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to brute-force six-digit password reset codes via PUT /apis/user/forget-password. Attackers can request a code for a known email and submit unlimited guesses during its 300-second lifetime to set a chosen password and take over the account.

CVE-2026-129162.description: Dromara free-fs 2.0.1 through 2.3.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in FileStreamController.preview that allows unauthenticated attackers to download stored files. Attackers who obtain a file ID from share listings or preview links can request /api/file/stream/preview/{fileId} to download any user's or workspace's files.

CVE-2026-129163.description: Dromara free-fs 2.0.1 through 2.3.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows registered users to run script by uploading HTML files served inline as text/html. Attackers can send a victim the /api/file/stream/preview/{fileId} link to execute script in the application origin, calling /apis endpoints to expose the victim's files and account.

CVE-2026-129164.description: Dromara free-fs 2.0.1 through 2.3.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to access code-protected shares because share codes are enforced only client-side. Attackers knowing a share ID can call the share items and download endpoints to list and download files without the code, even on preview-only shares.

CVE-2026-129165.description: Tactical RMM 0.17.0 through 1.6.1 contains an arbitrary file read in the /reporting/templates/preview/ endpoint because WeasyPrint resolves file:// links in user-supplied template_md and embeds the files in the returned PDF. Users with report management permission can read the Django SECRET_KEY, reused as the NATS password, and publish runscript commands to every managed agent.
CVE-2026-129165.summary_ko: Tactical RMM 0.17.0~1.6.1의 보고서 템플릿 미리보기 기능에 임의 파일 읽기 취약점이 있다. 보고서 관리 권한이 있는 사용자는 NATS 비밀번호로 재사용되는 Django SECRET_KEY를 읽고 모든 관리 에이전트에 스크립트 실행 명령을 발행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129165.background_ko: WeasyPrint가 사용자 제공 template_md의 로컬 파일 링크를 해석해 해당 파일을 반환 PDF에 포함한다.

CVE-2026-129166.description: Keep 0.34.10 through 0.55.0 contains a blind SQL injection vulnerability in its CEL-to-SQL converter, which inserts bracket-indexed JSON keys from CEL filters unescaped into JSON path expressions for SQLite, PostgreSQL, and MySQL. Authenticated users with read:alert permission can submit crafted CEL expressions to /alerts/query or the cel parameter of /incidents, using result counts as a boolean oracle to extract other tenants' alerts and password hashes.

CVE-2026-129167.description: Seafile SeaDoc converter 2.0.4 before 2.0.11 and 3.0.0 before 3.0.8 contains an absolute path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers holding a public share token to execute code. Attackers supply an absolute filename to /api/v1/confluence-to-wiki/ to extract a ZIP from download_url into the Python library path, then trigger the module's import via a file-convert request.
CVE-2026-129167.summary_ko: Seafile SeaDoc converter 2.0.4 이상 2.0.11 미만 및 3.0.0 이상 3.0.8 미만 버전에는 절대 경로 순회 취약점이 있다. 공개 공유 토큰을 가진 미인증 공격자가 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129167.background_ko: ZIP 압축 해제 시 절대 파일 경로를 허용해 Python 라이브러리 경로에 파일을 쓸 수 있다.

CVE-2026-129168.description: PMail 2.9.1 through 2.9.8 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because the /attachments/{id}/{cid} endpoint returns email attachments verbatim with the sender-supplied Content-Type after cid: references are rewritten into attachment links. Unauthenticated SMTP senders can email a text/html attachment and a page-covering cid link, so a recipient who clicks the message runs script in their webmail session to change passwords, including the administrator's.

CVE-2026-129169.description: PMail 2.5.0 through 2.9.8 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject scripts by sending unsanitized HTML through /api/email/send. Attackers can embed event-handler payloads like img onerror that execute when administrators view the message, enabling privileged API calls such as password changes for account takeover.

CVE-2026-129170.description: FileCodeBox 2.2.1 through 2.8.4 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in renderMarkdownPreview, which returns unsanitized text when the marked parser throws. Unauthenticated attackers can share text with thousands of nested blockquote markers followed by HTML payloads, executing script that steals the admin token from localStorage.

CVE-2026-129171.description: NginxPulse 1.5.0 before 1.6.26 contains an unauthenticated sql injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to append SQL via the id and locationType parameters of /api/stats/:type. Attackers can close the quoted table-name identifier and use error-based output to read database contents, and read or write server files via PostgreSQL superuser functions.
CVE-2026-129171.summary_ko: NginxPulse 1.5.0 이상 1.6.26 미만 버전에는 인증 없이 악용 가능한 SQL 삽입 취약점이 있다. 원격 공격자가 데이터베이스 내용을 읽거나 PostgreSQL 슈퍼유저 기능을 통해 서버 파일을 읽고 쓸 수 있다.
CVE-2026-129171.background_ko: 통계 API의 id와 locationType 매개변수로 SQL에서 따옴표로 둘러싼 테이블명 식별자를 조작할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-129172.description: EdgeEver 1.9.0 before 2.13.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the backup restore endpoint PUT /api/v1/restores/json/resources/:id, which accepts a resource kind of image paired with a text/html MIME type without checking consistency. Authenticated members can share the note and send the public blob link to a victim, whose browser executes the script to mint a non-expiring API token granting read and write access to the victim's notes.

CVE-2026-63173.description: Omnispace Agora Project through 26.10.0 contains a broken access control vulnerability in which the isAutor() function in MdlObject.php grants accessRight=3 based solely on object authorship without verifying the user still belongs to the object's space. Attackers who were previously members and authored objects can retain unauthorized read access to space objects even after being removed from the space, leading to persistent information disclosure.

CVE-2026-97357.description: An Out-Of-Bounds Write due to missing input validation is possible in the autoprogramming interface of SpaceCom and Space Battery pack with WiFi which could lead to a denial of service of the affected communication device.

CVE-2026-97358.description: An inclusion of web functionality from an untrusted source could allow remote code execution on SpaceCom

CVE-2026-97361.description: There exists an improper privilege management vulnerability that could cause privilege escalation at the SpaceCom and Space Battery pack SP with WiFi.

CVE-2026-100403.description: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.6, 1.5.2, and 1.6.1, the BACnet/SC hub's Linux WebSocket server reassembles fragmented WebSocket messages into a per-connection fragment_buffer. It grows that buffer with realloc() on every non-final frame, with no upper bound. A peer that streams binary continuation fragments and never sets FIN keeps the hub reallocating until the box runs out of memory or the process is OOM-killed. The buffer starts at the maximum legal BVLC-SC NPDU size, but nothing after that ties its growth back to that limit. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.6, 1.5.2, 1.6.1, and 1.7.0.

CVE-2026-102537.description: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.6, 1.5.2, and 1.6.1, bws_cli_connect() in ports/linux/websocket-cli.c loads the trusted CA cert into the libwebsockets context, then always sets LCCSCF_ALLOW_SELFSIGNED in the connection flags. So lws accepts any self-signed hub certificate, whether or not it chains to the loaded CA. A BACnet/SC node finishes the TLS handshake to a rogue hub that presents a self-signed cert. It then hands the attacker its identity (VMAC, UUID) and all later BACnet traffic. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.6, 1.5.2, 1.6.1, and 1.7.0.
CVE-2026-102537.summary_ko: BACnet Stack의 1.4.6·1.5.2·1.6.1 이전 버전에서는 자체 서명 인증서를 사용하는 악성 허브에 TLS 연결이 성립할 수 있다. 이로 인해 BACnet/SC 노드의 식별 정보와 이후 모든 BACnet 트래픽이 공격자에게 노출될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-102537.background_ko: bws_cli_connect()가 신뢰할 CA 인증서를 불러온 뒤에도 자체 서명 인증서를 항상 허용하도록 연결 플래그를 설정한다.

CVE-2026-102612.description: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.6, 1.5.2, and 1.6.1, bws_srv_start() in ports/linux/websocket-srv.c builds the libwebsockets server context with a CA certificate loaded but never sets LWS_SERVER_OPTION_REQUIRE_VALID_OPENSSL_CLIENT_CERT, so the hub accepts TLS connections from clients presenting no certificate at all. Any network-reachable host can join the BACnet/SC mesh without credentials. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.6, 1.5.2, 1.6.1, and 1.7.0.
CVE-2026-102612.summary_ko: BACnet Stack의 BACnet/SC 허브가 클라이언트 인증서가 없는 TLS 연결을 허용하는 취약점이다. 네트워크로 접근 가능한 호스트는 자격 증명 없이 BACnet/SC 메시 네트워크에 참여할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-102612.background_ko: 서버 컨텍스트에 CA 인증서를 로드하지만 유효한 클라이언트 인증서를 요구하는 옵션을 설정하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-104204.description: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to version 1.6.1, there is a server-side denial-of-service issue affecting the Structured View object implementation. This issue has been patched in versions 1.6.1 and 1.7.0.

CVE-2026-128080.description: OpenTelemetry JavaScript is the OpenTelemetry JavaScript client. From 0.204.0 until 0.222.0, @opentelemetry/instrumentation-http writes the raw query string from incoming HTTP requests to the url.query server-span attribute without applying the redactedQueryParams protection used for outgoing spans. Services receiving signed URLs or other credentials in query parameters can therefore export still-valid secrets to tracing backends, where observability infrastructure and users with span-read access may read them. The redactedQueryParams option does not protect incoming spans in affected versions. This issue is fixed in version 0.222.0.
CVE-2026-128080.summary_ko: OpenTelemetry JavaScript의 @opentelemetry/instrumentation-http에서 수신 HTTP 요청의 쿼리에 담긴 유효한 자격 증명이 추적 백엔드로 유출될 수 있다. 관측 인프라와 스팬 읽기 권한이 있는 사용자가 이를 열람할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-128080.background_ko: 수신 요청에는 redactedQueryParams 보호를 적용하지 않고 원본 쿼리 문자열을 서버 스팬의 url.query 속성에 기록한다.

CVE-2026-128081.description: AutoMapper is a convention-based object-object mapper in .NET. Prior to 15.1.4 and from 16.0.0 until 16.3.0, AutoMapper can recurse without an effective MaxDepth limit when mapping polymorphic graphs through Include or IncludeBase, runtime-typed object or interface members, nested Dictionary<string, object> or ExpandoObject sources, or recursive ConvertUsing type converters. Deep attacker-influenced graphs on these paths can throw an uncatchable StackOverflowException and terminate the process. This issue is fixed in versions 15.1.4 and 16.3.0.
CVE-2026-128081.summary_ko: AutoMapper 15.1.4 미만 및 16.0.0 이상 16.3.0 미만에서 일부 다형성·재귀 매핑에 MaxDepth 제한이 적용되지 않을 수 있다. 공격자의 영향을 받은 깊은 그래프를 처리하면 포착할 수 없는 StackOverflowException으로 프로세스가 종료될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-128081.background_ko: Include·IncludeBase 기반 다형성 매핑, 런타임 형식 멤버, 중첩 사전·ExpandoObject, 재귀 ConvertUsing 경로에서 MaxDepth가 효과적으로 적용되지 않는다.

CVE-2026-128082.description: AutoMapper is a convention-based object-object mapper in .NET. Prior to 15.1.4 and from 16.0.0 until 16.3.0, AutoMapper increments type depth only after creating the destination, so recursive mapping performed through constructor parameters occurs before MaxDepth is counted. Destinations built through positional records or other constructors, and recursive ConstructUsing mappings that call context.Mapper, can therefore bypass explicit MaxDepth values and the default limit of 64. Deep attacker-influenced input can throw an uncatchable StackOverflowException and terminate the process. This issue is fixed in versions 15.1.4 and 16.3.0.
CVE-2026-128082.summary_ko: AutoMapper 15.1.4 미만 및 16.0.0 이상 16.3.0 미만에서 생성자를 통한 재귀 매핑이 명시적 MaxDepth와 기본 제한 64를 우회할 수 있다. 공격자의 영향을 받은 깊은 입력으로 포착할 수 없는 StackOverflowException이 발생해 프로세스가 종료될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-128082.background_ko: 대상 객체를 생성한 뒤에야 타입 깊이를 증가시키므로, 생성자 매개변수를 통한 재귀 매핑은 MaxDepth 집계 전에 실행된다.

CVE-2026-128083.description: Laravel is a web application framework. Prior to 12.71.0 and 13.40.0, Laravel's Concurrency::run process driver can treat a forged internal result message in child standard output as framework output. An application route must invoke Concurrency::run, and a task must write attacker-controlled bytes at the start of the child's standard output that form a complete JSON document followed by gzip magic bytes. Under those application-specific conditions, an attacker can forge the internal result message and achieve remote code execution. The affected behavior is not exposed by default and requires application code that routes untrusted input into task output. This issue is fixed in versions 12.71.0 and 13.40.0.

CVE-2026-128084.description: sqlite3 provides Ruby bindings for the SQLite3 embedded database. Prior to 2.10.2, sqlite3-ruby casts Ruby string lengths to int before passing SQL through Database#prepare, bound String or Blob values through Statement#bind_param, and String or Blob results from Ruby-defined SQL functions and aggregates through Database#create_function and Database#create_aggregate. On 64-bit platforms, a string of 4 GiB (2^32 bytes) or larger can wrap the length so SQLite processes only a prefix. A truncated SQL string can drop trailing clauses such as a WHERE condition, while a truncated bound value matters only when the application validated the full value before binding it. Exploitation requires the application and server to accept and retain the unusually large attacker-controlled string. If a dropped SQL clause contained a bind placeholder, binding raises SQLite3::RangeException instead of running the query. This issue is fixed in version 2.10.2.

CVE-2026-128085.description: OpenTelemetry-Go is the Go implementation of OpenTelemetry. From SDK version 1.33.0, SDK log version 0.9.0, and trace version 1.35.0 until version 1.47.0, the AttributeValueLengthLimit and WithAttributeValueLengthLimit truncation paths in sdk/internal/attrnorm, sdk/log/internal/attrnorm, and trace/auto.go do not count valid U+FFFD replacement characters. This is a distinct incomplete-fix defect in the replacement truncation code introduced by the remediation for CVE-2026-81869. Values composed of or dominated by those characters can therefore exceed the configured character and memory bound in span, log-record, and auto-instrumentation trace attributes. Attacker-controlled telemetry attributes can increase retained memory and pipeline pressure, while confidentiality and integrity are not affected. This issue is fixed in version 1.47.0.

CVE-2026-128086.description: OpenTelemetry-Go is the Go implementation of OpenTelemetry. From version 1.0.0-RC1 until version 1.47.0, baggage.Parse and propagation.Baggage.Extract eagerly materialize every W3C baggage property through parseMember, grow property slices, serialize members, and copy properties into internal/baggage.Item. A valid densely populated baggage header can therefore cause allocation traffic and retained memory disproportionate to its bounded input size. Remote impact requires baggage extraction to be enabled, attacker-controlled input to reach it, and extraction to run before authentication or on a public route; the evidence establishes increased allocation and garbage-collection pressure but not reliable process termination. This issue is fixed in version 1.47.0.

CVE-2026-128087.description: russh is a Rust SSH client and server library that includes an SSH agent protocol implementation. From version 0.55.0 until version 0.65.1, the initial key exchange invokes client::Handler::kex_done() with the raw shared secret before check_server_key() accepts the server host key or certificate. A malicious SSH server can therefore trigger application-defined secondary-channel initialization or early data handling even when the server identity is subsequently rejected. Ordinary clients that keep the callback's no-op default or independently defer callback-derived actions until trust is confirmed are not affected. This issue is fixed in version 0.65.1.

CVE-2026-128088.description: russh is a Rust SSH client and server library that includes an SSH agent protocol implementation. Prior to version 0.65.1, try_sign() captures an Arc<PrivateKey> before awaiting Agent::confirm() and does not revalidate the shared lock state or key presence after the await. This is a distinct residual defect in the remediation for CVE-2026-116794. A peer, including a remote SSH server using agent forwarding, can begin a confirmation-constrained signature request while the agent is unlocked and receive the signature after another connection locks the agent if the stale confirmation returns true. New post-lock requests are rejected and private key material is not disclosed, but the pending operation bypasses the current lock state. This issue is fixed in version 0.65.1.

CVE-2026-129217.description: In FRRouting (FRR) 8.3 through 10.5.1, bgp_notify_decapsulate_hard_reset() in bgpd/bgp_packet.c does not validate the length of the data field of a received BGP NOTIFICATION Cease/Hard Reset message (RFC 8538). When the data field is exactly one byte long, the function reads one byte past the end of a heap buffer and the 16-bit length of the encapsulated data underflows to 65535, causing a 65535-byte out-of-bounds heap read followed by an assertion failure. A remote BGP peer that has established a session and negotiated the Graceful Restart capability with the Notification (N) bit can send such a message to crash the bgpd daemon, terminating all BGP sessions (denial of service). This is fixed in 10.0.5, 10.1.5, 10.2.6, 10.3.4, 10.4.3, 10.5.2 and 10.6.0.
CVE-2026-129217.summary_ko: FRRouting(FRR)에서 세션을 맺고 Graceful Restart의 Notification(N) 비트를 협상한 원격 BGP 피어가 메시지 처리 취약점으로 bgpd를 충돌시킬 수 있다. 모든 BGP 세션이 종료되는 서비스 거부로 이어진다.
CVE-2026-129217.background_ko: BGP NOTIFICATION Cease/Hard Reset 메시지의 데이터 길이를 검증하지 않아 힙 경계 밖 읽기와 길이 값의 언더플로가 발생한다.

CVE-2026-62975.description: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to version 1.5.1, the RAMFS-backed FILE implementation accepts AtomicWriteFile(record-access) requests that replace existing records with caller-controlled content. If a client replaces a record with shorter data, the backend can shrink the heap allocation and then continue processing with a trailing-copy length derived from the old layout. During that replace path, the RAMFS backend computes the trailing-copy length from the old file layout, then shrinks the heap allocation, and finally uses the stale length in memmove(). As a result, the source range of that memmove() can extend beyond the end of the reallocated heap buffer, producing a heap out-of-bounds read. This issue has been patched in versions 1.5.1 and 1.6.0.

CVE-2026-62976.description: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to version 1.5.1, the RAMFS-backed FILE object implementation stores appended records as NUL-terminated strings, but its record-counting logic later walks the buffer as if an additional terminating empty record were present. As a result, two consecutive AtomicWriteFile(record-access) append requests can cause record_count() to call bacnet_strnlen() on a pointer that is already one byte past the end of the heap allocation. This issue has been patched in versions 1.5.1 and 1.6.0.

CVE-2026-62977.description: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to version 1.5.1, the BACnet FILE object implementation allows remote WriteProperty(PROP_FILE_SIZE) requests to change the size of a stream-access FILE object without checking whether that FILE is marked Read_Only. When the FILE backend is RAMFS, enlarging the file only performs realloc() and updates the stored size; the newly exposed tail region is not initialized before later reads. As a result, a remote client can enlarge a read-only RAMFS-backed stream-access FILE and then immediately retrieve the newly exposed region with AtomicReadFile(stream-access). Depending on the allocator and build configuration, the returned data may contain sanitizer fill bytes, stale heap contents, or other unintended process memory. Shrinking the file through the same path can also remotely truncate content that was intended to be read-only. This issue has been patched in versions 1.5.1 and 1.6.0.

CVE-2026-64675.description: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.5 and 1.5.1, a single unauthenticated BACnet/IP UDP datagram (port 47808) triggers an out-of-bounds read in xy_color_decode() (src/bacnet/lighting.c), reachable pre-authentication through two default-registered service handlers: the UnconfirmedRequest WriteGroup service (0x0A) and Confirmed WriteProperty on a BACnetXYColor-typed property. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.5, 1.5.1, and 1.6.0.

CVE-2026-67444.description: Hubleys is a dashboard for self-hosted services. Prior to version 0.5.2, any authenticated (non-admin) Hubleys user can upload a file with an arbitrary extension as their dashboard "background image," and the server will later serve that file back with a Content-Type derived straight from the attacker's chosen extension - so uploading an .html file gets it served as text/html. Because the endpoint that serves it returns a manually-constructed response rather than going through SvelteKit's normal page-rendering pipeline, the app's configured Content-Security-Policy never gets attached to it either, so a script embedded in the upload runs unrestricted. This issue has been patched in version 0.5.2.

CVE-2026-68510.description: bit-vec is a compact vector of bits. Prior to version 0.10.0, there is undefined behavior if a user performs deserialize from an untrusted source and unsafe get_unchecked. A user of this library may be impacted by incorrect behavior if they perform deserialize from an untrusted source and run operations on the deserialized BitVec. This issue has been patched in version 0.10.0.

CVE-2026-68541.description: PolicyPress is a compliance policy management tool for small and mid-size teams. Prior to version 1.4.1, sensitive content is disclosed via CSS-only web redaction and insecure starter workflow defaults. This issue has been patched in version 1.4.1.

CVE-2026-82414.description: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. From versions 1.4.0 to before 1.4.6, 1.5.0 to before 1.5.1, and 1.6.0 to before 1.6.1, the BACnet MS/TP receive path decodes COBS frames into an output pointer inside the same fixed input buffer, but passes the full input-buffer size as the decode capacity. A long valid COBS payload can therefore write past the end of the actual remaining buffer. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.6, 1.5.1, 1.6.1, and 1.7.0.
CVE-2026-82414.summary_ko: 임베디드 시스템용 C 라이브러리 BACnet Stack의 MS/TP 수신 처리에 버퍼 경계 밖 쓰기 취약점이 있다. 긴 정상 COBS 데이터를 디코딩할 때 실제 남은 버퍼 공간을 넘어 데이터를 기록할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-82414.background_ko: 고정 입력 버퍼 내부를 출력 위치로 사용하면서 실제 남은 공간이 아닌 전체 입력 버퍼 크기를 디코딩 용량으로 전달한다.

CVE-2026-97692.description: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. Prior to versions 1.4.6, 1.5.2, and 1.6.1, the BACnet/SC message decoder walks the header-option list by following each option's MORE bit. Nothing rejects a list whose last option still has the MORE bit set, and the decode walk has no upper bound on how many options it processes. A single crafted BVLC-SC frame makes the walk advance one option past the end of the message and read message[message_len], one byte out of bounds. When the bytes after the message carry more MORE-set option markers, the walk keeps going: it runs past the fixed 4-entry option array and writes decoded option fields out of bounds. On the server that decode array is the static global bsc_dm, so the out-of-bounds write lands in adjacent BSS. Both faults are reachable before authentication, from the first frame a peer sends on a BACnet/SC connection, and the bytes that follow the message are the same peer's prior-frame data. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.6, 1.5.2, 1.6.1, and 1.7.0.
CVE-2026-97692.summary_ko: BACnet Stack의 BACnet/SC 메시지 디코더에 경계 밖 읽기·쓰기 취약점이 있다. 인증 전 첫 프레임 처리부터 도달할 수 있으며, 서버에서는 경계 밖 쓰기가 인접한 BSS 영역에 발생한다.
CVE-2026-97692.background_ko: 마지막 헤더 옵션의 MORE 비트가 설정된 목록을 거부하지 않고, 처리할 옵션 수에도 상한을 두지 않는다.

CVE-2026-127213.description: LearnPress Course Wishlist Add-on before 4.1.2 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows remote attackers to manipulate any user's course wishlist by supplying an arbitrary user_id parameter to the render_button callback instead of relying on the session identity. Attackers can exploit the publicly accessible load_content_via_ajax REST route, which only requires a public wp_rest nonce, to add or remove courses from any user's wishlist and determine whether a given course is wishlisted by iterating user_id and course_id values.

CVE-2026-127214.description: Flowise through 3.1.4 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers with chatflows or agentflows create/update permissions to bypass the Custom Function sandbox's SSRF protection by requiring a module subpath inside an allowlisted package, such as axios/dist/node/axios.cjs or node-fetch/lib/index.js, which evades the vm2 mock table and returns an unwrapped HTTP client that skips the checkDenyList validation. Attackers can issue arbitrary GET and POST requests with attacker-controlled bodies via POST /api/v1/node-custom-function to reach loopback and internal-network addresses or the cloud metadata endpoint, enabling network mapping, credential disclosure, and state changes on internal services.

CVE-2026-127215.description: Kanbanz by Softaculous plugin for WordPress before 1.0.3 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows authenticated Kanban Staff users to access and modify boards they are not members of by exploiting admin-ajax handlers that fail to call kanbanz_user_can_access_board() or per-task edit checks on attacker-supplied board_id or task_id parameters. Attackers can supply arbitrary board IDs to read sensitive task data, overwrite status columns, subtasks, and labels, inject comments, upload or delete attachments, and create tasks or set WIP limits on boards owned by other teams.

CVE-2026-128089.description: dnspython is a DNS toolkit for Python. Prior to version 2.9.2, the from_text() parser for WKS records does not require the service number to be between 0 and 65535 before using it as a bitmap offset. An attacker-controlled zone file can supply a larger number, causing the service bitmap to grow to an extremely large size through inefficient repeated extension, consuming excessive memory and CPU and potentially terminating the process. Applications are affected only when they parse zone-file text whose record type and rdata are attacker controlled. This issue is fixed in version 2.9.2.

CVE-2026-128100.description: Vault Community Edition and Vault Enterprise did not apply explicit ACL policy deny rules to letter case variants of user and group names in auth methods that treat these names as case-insensitive. This may allow an authenticated user with delegated permissions to modify a protected user or group, potentially leading to privilege escalation. This vulnerability (CVE-2026-128100) is fixed in Vault Community Edition 2.2.2 and Vault Enterprise 2.2.2, 1.21.14, and 1.19.25.

CVE-2026-128116.description: SvelteKit is a framework for rapidly developing robust, performant web applications using Svelte. Prior to versions 2.70.4 and 3.1.1, apps configured with router.resolution: 'server' could treat a pathname beginning with // as a protocol-relative module specifier during client-side navigation. A socially engineered link could therefore make server-side route resolution import and execute JavaScript from another origin in the user's browser. This issue is fixed in 2.70.4 and 3.1.1.

CVE-2026-128117.description: SvelteKit is a framework for rapidly developing robust, performant web applications using Svelte. Prior to versions 2.70.4 and 3.1.1, the reroute hook could rewrite an invalid percent-encoded pathname into a valid route and reach a comparison that decoded the original malformed pathname outside the guarded decoding operation. The resulting unhandled URIError could crash an adapter-node server and deny service to other requests. This issue is fixed in 2.70.4 and 3.1.1.

CVE-2026-128118.description: SvelteKit is a framework for rapidly developing robust, performant web applications using Svelte. From version 3.0.0 until 3.1.1, the build-time server-only module guard did not treat src/params.js as a client entry point even though parameter matchers can run in the browser. Server-only modules imported through src/params.js could consequently enter the client bundle, where statically replaced private environment values or other server secrets could be exposed. This issue is fixed in 3.1.1.
CVE-2026-128118.summary_ko: SvelteKit 3.0.0부터 3.1.1 이전 버전에서는 서버 전용 모듈이 클라이언트 번들에 포함될 수 있다. 이로 인해 정적으로 치환된 비공개 환경 변수 값이나 다른 서버 비밀정보가 노출될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-128118.background_ko: 빌드 시 서버 전용 모듈 보호 기능이 브라우저에서 실행될 수 있는 매개변수 매처의 src/params.js를 클라이언트 진입점으로 취급하지 않았다.

CVE-2026-128119.description: SvelteKit is a framework for rapidly developing robust, performant web applications using Svelte. From version 2.60.1 until 3.1.1, applications using the experimental remote functions flag could assign the same generated identifier to separate non-exported query.batch functions. When those private functions shared a request batch, arguments intended for one function could be passed to another function, causing unexpected cross-function processing and possible disclosure of function arguments. This issue is fixed in 3.1.1.

CVE-2026-128120.description: SvelteKit is a framework for rapidly developing robust, performant web applications using Svelte. From version 2.42.0 until 3.1.1, applications using the experimental remote functions flag and a remote form function could perform quadratic synchronous work while parsing a specially crafted request with many form entries. The parsing work could block the event loop for an extended period and deny service. This issue is fixed in 3.1.1.

CVE-2026-128121.description: SvelteKit is a framework for rapidly developing robust, performant web applications using Svelte. Prior to @sveltejs/adapter-vercel 6.3.5 and 7.0.2 and @sveltejs/adapter-static 3.0.11 and 4.0.1, an attacker-influenced link crawled during prerendering could be emitted into the generated Vercel routing configuration without escaping regular-expression metacharacters. The configuration could consequently interpret the path as regular-expression syntax, match unintended application paths, and expose content or behavior outside the intended path. This issue is fixed in @sveltejs/adapter-vercel 6.3.5 and 7.0.2 and @sveltejs/adapter-static 3.0.11 and 4.0.1.

CVE-2026-128122.description: SvelteKit is a framework for rapidly developing robust, performant web applications using Svelte. From version 4.7.0 until versions 7.2.10 and 8.0.2, @sveltejs/adapter-cloudflare allowed an attacker-influenced link crawled during prerendering to place whitespace, control characters, wildcards, or placeholders into a prerendered redirect path. The adapter wrote those paths into the Cloudflare _redirects output without output-context validation, allowing a path to create unintended routing rules that could redirect or expose requests beyond the intended prerendered route. This issue is fixed in 7.2.10 and 8.0.2.

CVE-2026-128123.description: SvelteKit is a framework for rapidly developing robust, performant web applications using Svelte. From version 5.5.7 until versions 5.5.8 and 6.0.1, , @sveltejs/adapter-node can attempt to add a header to an immutable request in a context that causes the server to crash, denying service to any other requests routed to that server. This issue is fixed in 5.5.8 and 6.0.1.

CVE-2026-68551.description: Budget Board is an app for tracking monthly spending and working towards financial goals. Prior to version 3.6.2, Budget Board's OIDC login flow finds and signs into an existing local account purely by matching the email address asserted in the identity provider's token - it never checks the standard email_verified claim. If the configured OIDC provider ever allows a user to register or display an email address without proving they own it , an attacker can register there using a victim's email and get signed into the victim's existing Budget Board account - including all their linked bank data. This issue has been patched in version 3.6.2.

CVE-2026-68905.description: Hugo Blog is a tech blog site. In commit 744ca15 and prior, the AI assistant proxy exposes three HTTP endpoints (POST /api/blog-assistant, POST /api/blog-search-embedding, POST /api/blog-search-rerank) without any authentication check. When deployed following the documented Nginx reverse-proxy setup, any unauthenticated remote attacker can send arbitrary requests that the proxy forwards to the upstream LLM/embedding/rerank API using the operator's server-side API key (OPENAI_API_KEY / AI_SEARCH_API_KEY). This enables unlimited quota consumption, cost exhaustion, and potential service unavailability for the operator. At time of publication, there are no publicly available patches.

CVE-2025-43867.description: - Dependency on Vulnerable Third-Party Component vulnerability in Johnson Controls FX Server, Johnson Controls FX80, and Johnson Controls FX90 allows CAPEC‑17: Accessing, Modifying or Deleting Files. This issue affects FX Server: before 14.10.10 and before 14.14.1; FX80: before 14.14.10 and before 14.14.1; FX90: before 14.10.10 and before 14.14.1.

CVE-2026-127216.description: Injection Guard plugin for WordPress before 1.4.0 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to trigger password hash export by tricking a logged-in administrator into loading a crafted link, since the ig_settings admin page in templates/dashboard.php processes GET parameters without nonce verification. Attackers can exploit this to cause the plugin to write WooCommerce customer email hashes and password hashes to an unprotected file at wp-content/plugins/injection-guard/ab-hash.dat, which can then be downloaded without authentication to obtain customer password hashes for offline cracking.

CVE-2026-127217.description: Post to Google My Business plugin for WordPress before 3.5.7 contains a blind server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users with Contributor-level privileges or higher to make the server send requests to arbitrary hosts by supplying an unvalidated mbp_post_attachment URL that reaches a raw getimagesize() call in validate_external_image_size() via the preview REST route. Attackers can exploit this to perform internal port scanning, probe internal-only services and cloud metadata endpoints, and trigger GET-based side effects on internal systems, bypassing network perimeter controls since the request originates from the web server.

CVE-2026-128124.description: AIOHTTP is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. Prior to 3.14.4, Application.add_domain() converts every asterisk wildcard in a domain mask into a greedy regular-expression fragment, so a mask containing two or more wildcards can take polynomial time to reject a long Host header that does not match. A remote attacker can repeatedly send such headers to a server configured with a multi-wildcard domain mask and stall the event loop. This issue is fixed in version 3.14.4.

CVE-2026-128125.description: AIOHTTP is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. Prior to 3.14.4, Set-Cookie parsing treats unrecognized name=value attributes as additional cookies, while CookieJar does not limit the number of cookies stored or sent. A malicious server can make an aiohttp client accumulate a very large cookie set, consume memory and CPU repeatedly across redirects, and construct an excessively large Cookie header for later requests to the same domain. This issue is fixed in version 3.14.4.

CVE-2026-128126.description: AIOHTTP is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. Prior to 3.14.4, Request.post() does not limit the number of fields in a URL-encoded form body, and inserting many repeated keys into MultiDict takes quadratic time on the event loop. A remote attacker can send a form POST within client_max_size to a handler that calls Request.post() and block the event loop. This issue is fixed in version 3.14.4.
CVE-2026-128126.summary_ko: AIOHTTP 3.14.4 이전 버전에는 URL 인코딩 폼 처리 중 이벤트 루프가 차단될 수 있는 취약점이 있다. Request.post()를 호출하는 서버는 허용된 요청 크기 이내의 원격 요청으로도 영향을 받을 수 있다.
CVE-2026-128126.background_ko: Request.post()가 폼 필드 수를 제한하지 않고, MultiDict에 반복된 키를 삽입할 때 처리 시간이 제곱 수준으로 증가한다.

CVE-2026-128127.description: AIOHTTP is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. Prior to 3.14.4, BodyPartReader.read_chunk() processing a multipart part with Content-Transfer-Encoding set to base64 keeps reading until the chunk length is a multiple of four without enforcing a byte limit. A short Content-Length or a long run of whitespace can cause one call to read the remaining body into memory before the size check or spin on the event loop. A remote attacker can send such a multipart request to a handler that reads multipart data and bypass client_max_size. This issue is fixed in version 3.14.4.
CVE-2026-128127.summary_ko: AIOHTTP 3.14.4 이전 버전의 멀티파트 데이터 처리에는 요청 크기 제한을 우회할 수 있는 취약점이 있다. 원격 공격자는 메모리 사용량을 늘리거나 이벤트 루프를 과도하게 점유할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-128127.background_ko: BodyPartReader.read_chunk()가 base64 파트의 청크 길이를 4의 배수로 맞추는 동안 바이트 제한 없이 읽기를 계속한다.

CVE-2026-128128.description: AIOHTTP is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. Prior to 3.14.4, the C WebSocket reader adds a declared frame length to the size of an already buffered partial message using signed 64-bit arithmetic. A length near two to the power of 63 can overflow, allowing the max_msg_size check to pass. A remote peer can send a small non-final fragment followed by an oversized message and cause unbounded memory consumption. The Python WebSocket reader is unaffected. This issue is fixed in version 3.14.4.

CVE-2026-128129.description: AIOHTTP is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. Prior to 3.14.4, aiohttp buffers all additional connection data received while a request marked for upgrade, such as a WebSocket handshake, is being handled, without a size limit or flow control. A remote attacker can stream data behind an upgrade request to a handler that does not immediately accept or reject the upgrade and cause unbounded memory consumption. This issue is fixed in version 3.14.4.

CVE-2026-128130.description: AIOHTTP is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. Prior to 3.14.4, when the pipelined request queue is full, the pure-Python parser stores the unparsed remainder internally and also returns the same data to its caller. After a handler declines an upgrade request, the caller feeds the remainder back to the parser, causing the buffer to grow with each handled request and dispatching already-handled requests to the application again. The issue affects deployments using AIOHTTP_NO_EXTENSIONS or otherwise running without the standard C-extension wheel, and can cause excessive memory use and repeated request processing. This issue is fixed in version 3.14.4.

CVE-2026-128131.description: AIOHTTP is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. Prior to 3.14.4, aiohttp decompresses each member of a payload containing many concatenated gzip, deflate, or zstd streams by passing the entire remaining input to a new decompressor, causing quadratic CPU use. Empty members produce no output, so client_max_size and output backpressure do not limit the work. A remote attacker can block a server event loop with a crafted compressed request body or WebSocket message, and a malicious server can similarly block a client. This issue is fixed in version 3.14.4.
CVE-2026-128131.summary_ko: AIOHTTP 3.14.4 이전 버전에는 연결된 압축 스트림 처리 시 CPU 사용량이 과도하게 증가하는 취약점이 있다. 원격 공격자는 서버의 이벤트 루프를 차단할 수 있고, 악성 서버는 클라이언트에도 같은 영향을 줄 수 있다.
CVE-2026-128131.background_ko: 각 압축 스트림을 풀 때 새 압축 해제기에 남은 입력 전체를 전달해 CPU 작업량이 제곱 수준으로 증가하며, 빈 스트림은 출력 기반 제한을 받지 않는다.

CVE-2026-128132.description: AIOHTTP is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. Prior to 3.14.4, the WebSocket reader continues parsing frames already received after the receive queue pauses the transport, and empty messages are not counted toward the queue size. With permessage-deflate, one read of compressed frames can add many megabytes of decompressed messages to the receive queue. A remote peer can send many small or compressed messages faster than the application consumes them and cause excessive memory use in a server or client. This issue is fixed in version 3.14.4.
CVE-2026-128132.summary_ko: AIOHTTP 3.14.4 이전 버전에는 WebSocket 수신 처리 취약점이 있다. 원격 통신 상대가 서버나 클라이언트의 메모리 사용량을 과도하게 늘릴 수 있다.
CVE-2026-128132.background_ko: 전송이 일시 중지된 뒤에도 이미 받은 프레임을 계속 파싱하고 빈 메시지를 대기열 크기에 포함하지 않아, 압축 해제된 메시지가 수신 대기열에 누적될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-128885.description: A flaw was found in D-Bus. In configurations where the daemon falls back to using the Unix select() mechanism for event monitoring, it does not verify whether file descriptor numbers exceed allocated limits. A local attacker can exploit this flaw by opening a large number of concurrent connections to trigger an out-of-bounds write on the stack. This can cause the daemon to crash, resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS).

CVE-2026-128987.description: A flaw was found in dbus. A local attacker can exploit this vulnerability by connecting to an affected service, requesting a response, and stopping socket reads while keeping the connection open. Because the socket transport handles broken pipe write errors as retryable, the application enters a continuous retry loop. This can lead to excessive CPU consumption, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) for the target process.

CVE-2026-82504.description: VITEC EZ TV Platform Server before 8.5.0 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in the upload handler that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to upload arbitrary files by supplying a target filename in the X-FILENAME request header with no authentication or file type validation required. Attackers can upload a malicious ASPX file directly to the web-accessible uploads directory, where it is immediately executable by the web server, achieving remote code execution in the context of the web server process. Patches are available for versions 8.3.0, 8.3.1, 8.4.0, and 8.4.1. Users running releases prior to 8.3.0 should upgrade to 8.5.0+.
CVE-2026-82504.summary_ko: VITEC EZ TV Platform Server 8.5.0 이전 버전에는 비인증 원격 공격자가 임의 파일을 업로드할 수 있는 취약점이 있다. 업로드된 파일이 웹 서버에서 실행돼 웹 서버 프로세스 권한으로 원격 코드 실행이 가능하다.
CVE-2026-82504.background_ko: 업로드 처리기가 인증과 파일 형식 검증을 수행하지 않으며, 웹에서 접근 가능한 업로드 디렉터리의 파일을 웹 서버가 실행할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-89037.description: Dolibarr before 24.0.2 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the REST Documents API for the ticket module that allows authenticated API users to access ticket attachments belonging to other companies by omitting a company-scope check that is only applied via a session variable set during public ticket authentication, which REST API authentication never sets. Attackers with ticket read permission can enumerate predictable ticket identifiers and supply them to the documents endpoint or download path to retrieve sensitive attachments such as invoices and contracts belonging to other third parties.

CVE-2026-92738.description: Vault's Login MFA feature did not consistently enforce the lifetime of pending two-phase login requests. This may allow a user who previously completed the first authentication factor to complete MFA and obtain a Vault token after the pending request should have expired, including after the user's primary credential has been rotated. This vulnerability (CVE-2026-92738) is fixed in Vault Community Edition 2.2.2 and Vault Enterprise 2.2.2, 1.21.14, and 1.19.26.
CVE-2026-92738.summary_ko: Vault의 Login MFA 기능에는 대기 중인 2단계 로그인 요청의 만료가 제대로 적용되지 않는 취약점이 있다. 첫 인증을 마친 사용자는 요청 만료 후에도 MFA를 완료해 Vault 토큰을 받을 수 있으며, 기본 인증 정보를 교체한 뒤에도 이 문제가 발생할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-92738.background_ko: 대기 중인 2단계 로그인 요청의 유효기간을 일관되게 강제하지 않는다.

CVE-2025-43874.description: : Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command vulnerability in Johnson Controls iSTAR Ultra, Johnson Controls iSTAR Ultra SE, Johnson Controls iSTAR Ultra G2, Johnson Controls iSTAR Ultra G2 SE, and Johnson Controls iSTAR Edge G2 allows : OS Command Injection. This issue affects iSTAR Ultra: before 6.9.2.CU02; iSTAR Ultra SE: before 6.9.2.CU02; iSTAR Ultra G2: before 6.9.2.CU02; iSTAR Ultra G2 SE: before 6.9.2.CU02; iSTAR Edge G2: before 6.9.2.CU02.

CVE-2025-53697.description: Use of default credentials vulnerability in Johnson Controls iSTAR Ultra, Johnson Controls iSTAR Ultra SE, Johnson Controls iSTAR Ultra G2, Johnson Controls iSTAR Ultra G2 SE, and Johnson Controls iSTAR Edge G2 allows CAPEC‑560: Use of Default Credentials. This issue affects iSTAR Ultra: before 2.9.2.CU02; iSTAR Ultra SE: before 6.9.2.CU02; iSTAR Ultra G2: before 6.9.2.CU02; iSTAR Ultra G2 SE: before 6.9.2.CU02; iSTAR Edge G2: before 6.9.2.CU02.

CVE-2025-53698.description: Missing protection mechanism for alternate hardware interface vulnerability in Johnson Controls iSTAR Ultra and Johnson Controls iSTAR Ultra SE allows CAPEC‑554: Functionality Bypass. This issue affects iSTAR Ultra: before 6.9.2.CU02; iSTAR Ultra SE: before 6.9.2.CU02.

CVE-2025-53699.description: Missing protection mechanism for alternate hardware interface vulnerability in Johnson Controls iSTAR Ultra, Johnson Controls iSTAR Ultra SE, Johnson Controls iSTAR Ultra G2, Johnson Controls iSTAR Ultra G2 SE, and Johnson Controls iSTAR Edge G2 allows CAPEC‑554: Functionality Bypass. This issue affects iSTAR Ultra: before 6.9.2.CU02; iSTAR Ultra SE: before 6.9.2.CU02; iSTAR Ultra G2: before 6.9.2.CU02; iSTAR Ultra G2 SE: before 6.9.2.CU02; iSTAR Edge G2: before 6.9.2.CU02.

CVE-2025-53700.description: CWE‑922 Insecure Storage of Sensitive Information vulnerability in Johnson Controls iSTAR Ultra, Johnson Controls iSTAR Ultra SE, Johnson Controls iSTAR Ultra G2, Johnson Controls iSTAR Ultra G2 SE, and Johnson Controls iSTAR Edge G2 allows CAPEC‑15 File Manipulation. This issue affects iSTAR Ultra: before 6.9.2.CU02; iSTAR Ultra SE: before 6.9.2.CU02; iSTAR Ultra G2: before 6.9.2.CU02; iSTAR Ultra G2 SE: before 6.9.2.CU02; iSTAR Edge G2: before 6.9.2.CU02.

CVE-2026-102632.description: Incorrect privilege assignment in the app token management component in Devolutions PowerShell Universal 2026.3.4 and earlier allows an authenticated user with token creation or update permissions to escalate privileges to administrator, and allows a revoked app token to be reinstated in multi-node deployments, via crafted app token requests that set an arbitrary role or revocation state.

CVE-2026-108290.description: IBM Cyber Fraud 1.0.0 through 1.1.0 could allow an attacker with local access to a container to extract sensitive information due to unrestrictive network policies.

CVE-2026-109158.description: IBM App Connect Operator and IBM App Connect Enterprise Certified Containers Operands may allow the AI Agent to log sensitive information about the deployed environment within error messages.

CVE-2026-110178.description: IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway 1.0.0 through 1.0.11 is vulnerable to improper access control in the bulk import path. A remote authenticated attacker holding a team-scoped `admin.import` permission can overwrite the endpoint URL, request headers, and authentication credentials of public tools, resources, and prompts owned by other tenants by sending a crafted POST request to `/v1/import` with `conflict_strategy=update`, redirecting subsequent AI gateway invocations to an attacker-controlled host.

CVE-2026-110189.description: IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway 1.0.8 through 1.0.11, and v1.1.0 is vulnerable to denial of service due to an incomplete denylist in the jq filter guard module (CWE-184). An authenticated remote attacker can supply a crafted `jsonpath_filter` value containing `halt`, `halt_error`, or unbounded-loop built-ins that bypass the safety check, causing gateway worker process termination or sustained resource exhaustion.

CVE-2026-110194.description: IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway 1.0.0 through 1.0.11 is vulnerable to server-side request forgery (SSRF). This may allow an authenticated attacker to send unauthorized requests from the system, potentially leading to network enumeration or facilitating other attacks.

CVE-2026-110195.description: IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway 1.0.0 through 1.0.11 could allow an authenticated caller to bypass upstream credential-level authorization policies due to an insufficiently specific cache key in the RFC 8693 token exchange cache, enabling reuse of cached upstream bearer tokens across different credentials belonging to the same user.

CVE-2026-110199.description: IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway 1.0.0 through 1.0.11 is vulnerable to cross-site scripting. This vulnerability allows a privileged user to embed arbitrary JavaScript code in the Web UI thus altering the intended functionality potentially leading to credentials disclosure within a trusted session.

CVE-2026-110278.description: IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway 1.0.0 through 1.1.0 could allow an attacker to replay identity propagation claims signatures or expose sensitive user identity information to third-party MCP servers due to static signature payloads and missing per-gateway configuration checks during tool invocation.

CVE-2026-110279.description: IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway 1.0.0 through 1.1.0 is vulnerable to improper credential handling because the X-Upstream-Authorization request header can override the gateway-managed upstream credential for OAuth (authorization_code and client_credentials), bearer and basic authenticated gateways, which could allow an authenticated user to cause upstream requests to be made with a different credential and bypass per-user permission and audit attribution.

CVE-2026-110330.description: A flaw was found in abrt. abrt-server trusts a client-supplied PID when creating problem dumps over abrt.socket and, running as root, copies that process's /proc data (including environ) into a dump directory owned by the connecting unprivileged user. This allows a local attacker to read environment variables and related metadata of other users' or root processes when abrtd is running.

CVE-2026-110331.description: A flaw was found in abrt. The completeness check introduced to mitigate CVE-2026-54228 and CVE-2026-54229 only verifies that a dump directory contains a "count" element, which an unprivileged user can create. This allows a local attacker to bypass the guard and again poison elements in, or seize ownership of, dump directories while privileged ABRT handlers are processing them. Related Problems2 mutating methods remain ungated by the same check.

CVE-2026-114468.description: IBM App Connect Operator and App Connect Enterprise Certified Containers Operands could allow an attacker with the ability to run HTTP calls within the running container to can make administrative calls to a running IntegrationRuntime.

CVE-2026-115501.description: IBM i 7.3 7.4, 7.5, and 7.6 is vulnerable to a stack buffer overflow, caused by improper bounds checking in the QFileSvr.400 file system. By sending a command in the QFileSvr.400 file system, a local authenticated attacker could cause undefined behavior.

CVE-2026-115788.description: IBM App Connect Operator and IBM App Connect Enterprise Certified Containers Operands is vulnerable to Log Forging on a request to create a resource.

CVE-2026-123628.description: IBM webMethods Integration Server 10.15 and 11.1 could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information due to an exposure of sensitive server-side environment variables and Java runtime details.

CVE-2026-124020.description: Control Web Panel (CWP) before webpanel_version 1.30.6 contains a host header injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate the password-recovery reset URL by injecting the HTTP Host header into the /v1/lostpass/ route's token generation process. Attackers can lure an automated mail-security scanner into visiting the poisoned reset link to exfiltrate the live recovery token, replay it at /login/index.php?acc=newpass to set a new password, and subsequently abuse the File Manager and Crontab modules to achieve command execution as the targeted hosting account.
CVE-2026-124020.summary_ko: Control Web Panel(CWP) webpanel_version 1.30.6 이전 버전에는 호스트 헤더 주입 취약점이 있다. 비인증 공격자가 비밀번호 복구 토큰을 탈취해 계정을 장악하고 대상 호스팅 계정 권한으로 명령을 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-124020.background_ko: 비밀번호 복구 토큰 생성 과정에 HTTP Host 헤더가 반영돼 비밀번호 재설정 URL이 조작될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-124021.description: Control Web Panel (CWP) before webpanel_version 1.30.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the validate() function of api/v1/index.php that allows attackers holding a password-recovery token and a predictable legacy signature to obtain valid remote-API authorization without a proper API key. Attackers can exploit this flaw via the POST /cronjobsusers/ endpoint to add arbitrary cron commands and achieve command execution as the affected hosting account, and can also abuse the same token to access global account-list and account-detail routes exposing usernames, contact emails, and password hashes.
CVE-2026-124021.summary_ko: Control Web Panel(CWP) webpanel_version 1.30.6 이전 버전에는 원격 API 권한 검증 우회 취약점이 있다. 비밀번호 복구 토큰 등을 보유한 공격자는 호스팅 계정 권한으로 명령을 실행하거나 사용자명·연락처 이메일·비밀번호 해시를 열람할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-124021.background_ko: api/v1/index.php의 validate()가 비밀번호 복구 토큰과 예측 가능한 기존 서명만으로 정상 API 키 없이 원격 API 권한을 부여한다.

CVE-2026-128886.description: A flaw was found in dbus when configured with the nonce-tcp transport. An unauthenticated attacker able to connect to an exposed listener can cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by opening a connection and withholding the expected authentication token. Because the server processes this verification without enforcing a timeout, the stalled connection blocks the accept process and prevents legitimate clients from establishing new connections.

CVE-2026-129137.description: Incorrect default permissions in the agent configuration folder in Devolutions PowerShell Universal 2026.3.4 and earlier allows a local unprivileged user to execute arbitrary code as SYSTEM via a crafted agent configuration file that points the agent to an attacker-controlled server.

CVE-2026-19194.description: The HashiCorp cap JWT validation library before version 0.14.0 is vulnerable to a claims validation bypass that may cause downstream applications to make authorization decisions using claim values different from those validated. Exploitation requires attacker-controlled claims in a JWT signed by a key trusted by the application. This vulnerability (CVE-2026-19194) is fixed in cap 0.14.0.

CVE-2026-5514.description: IBM Bob 2.0.3 allows unauthorized extensions to retrieve session tokens via the authentication provider API. The token is exposed in the account identifier field during account enumeration, without requiring explicit user consent. This may allow malicious extensions to access sensitive session information and potentially perform unauthorized actions on behalf of the user.

CVE-2026-82102.description: IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data 5.4.0.0 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information due to a server-side request forgery vulnerability.

CVE-2026-91868.description: IBM Security QRadar EDR 3.12 through 3.12.26 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information due to improper access control.

CVE-2026-91869.description: IBM Security QRadar EDR 3.12 through 3.12.26 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to bypass security restrictions due to improper rate limiting on TOTP verification.

CVE-2026-94407.description: IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway 1.0.0 through 1.0.11 is potentially vulnerable to denial of service due to uncontrolled regular expression complexity (CWE-400 / ReDoS). An authenticated user with tool-registration privileges can embed catastrophically backtracking regex patterns in a tool's JSON Schema `pattern` field; when ContextForge validates arguments against that schema, the validation call may consume unbounded CPU, potentially degrading gateway availability.

CVE-2026-97683.description: IBM Cyber Fraud 1.0.0 through 1.1.0 could allow a local attacker to bypass security restrictions due to a missing or misconfigured security context.

CVE-2026-9661.description: Poste Italiane Postecert FIRMAOK! 1.6.29 on Windows contains a local privilege escalation vulnerability caused by an uncontrolled OpenSSL search path, where launcher.exe and dependent executables such as updater.exe and tslupdater.exe load OpenSSL configuration and library files from a hardcoded, user-writable directory that does not exist by default. A low-privileged local attacker can create this missing directory and place malicious OpenSSL configuration or library files inside it, causing the application to load and execute attacker-controlled code with the privileges of the user running it, enabling horizontal or, when a higher-privileged user runs the application, vertical privilege escalation up to full system compromise.

CVE-2026-9821.description: IBM Cyber Fraud 1.0.0 through 1.1.0 could allow an unauthorized user to inject data into log messages due to improper neutralization of special elements when written to log files.

CVE-2026-9870.description: IBM Cyber Fraud 1.0.0 through 1.1.0 is vulnerable to cross-site scripting. This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to embed arbitrary JavaScript code in the Web UI thus altering the intended functionality potentially leading to credentials disclosure within a trusted session.

CVE-2026-128134.description: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, nltk.parse.dependencygraph.dot2img resolves the Graphviz dot executable through PATH but invokes the resulting absolute executable without routing through spawn_trusted, so resolve_trusted_executable ownership and writability validation and safe_env loader environment scrubbing do not run. A local low-privileged attacker who can write to a directory on a POSIX victim's PATH can plant or replace dot, and code executes as the victim when dot2img is called directly or DependencyGraph.repr_svg renders a graph. The current-working-directory-only bare-name vector is blocked and is not this vulnerability; this issue is the residual writable absolute PATH element bypass after CVE-2026-78680. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

CVE-2026-129173.description: A security flaw has been discovered in Stirling-Tools Stirling-PDF up to 3.3.0. Affected is the function WorkflowParticipantController.getParticipantDetails of the file app/proprietary/src/main/java/stirling/software/proprietary/workflow/controller/WorkflowParticipantController.java of the component Participant Details Endpoint. Performing a manipulation results in insufficient session timeout value. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
